verses.sa:
दोषो गाय बृहद्गाय द्युमद्धेहि ।
आथर्वण स्तुहि देवं सवितारम् ॥
verses.rom:
dosho gaya brihadgaya dyumaddhehi |
atharvana stuhi devam savitaram ||
verses.en: Sing at evening; sing greatly; put clearly, O son of Atharvan; praise god Savitar.

verses.sa:
तमु ष्टुहि यो अन्तः सिन्धौ सूनुः ।
सत्यस्य युवानमद्रोघवाचं सुशेवम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamu shtuhi yo antah sindhau sunuh |
satyasya yuvanamadroghavacham sushevam ||
verses.en: Praise thou him who is within the river, son of truth (satyá), [him] the young, of unhateful speech, very propitious.

verses.sa:
स घा नो देवः सविता साविषदमृतानि भूरि ।
उभे सुष्टुती सुगातवे ॥
verses.rom:
sa gha no devah savita savishadamritani bhuri |
ubhe sushtuti sugatave ||
verses.en: May he, indeed, god Savitar, impel (sū) for us many amrtas, both the good praises, unto welfare.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सोममृत्विजः सुनोता च धावत ।
स्तोतुर्यो वचः शृणवद्धवं च मे ॥
verses.rom:
indraya somamritvijah sunota cha dhavata |
stoturyo vachah shrinavaddhavam cha me ||
verses.en: For Indra, O priests, press the soma, and add the water; [Indra] who shall hear the praiser's words and my call.

verses.sa:
आ यं विशन्तीन्दवो वयो न वृक्षमन्धसः ।
विरप्शिन् वि मृधो जहि रक्षस्विनीः ॥
verses.rom:
a yam vishantindavo vayo na vrikshamandhasah |
virapshin vi mridho jahi rakshasvinih ||
verses.en: Unto whom enter the drops of soma-plant (ándhas) as birds a tree; thou exuberant one, drive away the demon-possessed scorners.

verses.sa:
सुनोता सोमपाव्ने सोममिन्द्राय वज्रिणे ।
युवा जेतेशानः स पुरुष्टुतः ॥
verses.rom:
sunota somapavne somamindraya vajrine |
yuva jeteshanah sa purushtutah ||
verses.en: Press ye the soma for the soma-drinker, for the thunderbolt-bearing Indra; young, conqueror, lord [is] he, greatly praised.

verses.sa:
पातं न इन्द्रापूषणादितिः पान्तु मरुतः ।
अपां नपात्सिन्धवः सप्त पातन पातु नो विष्णुरुत द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
patam na indrapushanaditih pantu marutah |
apam napatsindhavah sapta patana patu no vishnuruta dyauh ||
verses.en: Protect us, O Indra-and-Pūshan; let Aditi, let the Maruts protect; O child of the waters, ye seven rivers, protect; let Vishṇu protect us, also the heaven.

verses.sa:
पातां नो द्यावापृथिवी अभिष्टये पातु ग्रावा पातु सोमो नो अंहसः ।
पातु नो देवी सुभगा सरस्वती पात्वग्निः शिवा ये अस्य पायवः ॥
verses.rom:
patam no dyavaprithivi abhishtaye patu grava patu somo no amhasah |
patu no devi subhaga sarasvati patvagnih shiva ye asya payavah ||
verses.en: Let heaven-and-earth protect us in order to assistance (abhíṣṭi); let the pressing-stone protect, let Soma protect us from distress; let the fortunate goddess Sarasvatī protect us; let Agni protect us—the propitious protections that are his.

verses.sa:
पातां नो देवाश्विना शुभस्पती उषासानक्तोत न उरुष्यताम् ।
अपां नपादभिह्रुती गयस्य चिद्देव त्वष्टर्वर्धय सर्वतातये ॥
verses.rom:
patam no devashvina shubhaspati ushasanaktota na urushyatam |
apam napadabhihruti gayasya chiddeva tvashtarvardhaya sarvatataye ||
verses.en: Let the divine Açvins, lords of beauty, protect us; let dawn-and-night also make broad for us; O child of the waters, in case of any detriment to [our] household; O divine Tvashṭar, increase [us] in order to our completeness.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा मे दैव्यं वचः पर्जन्यो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ।
पुत्रैर्भ्रातृभिरदितिर्नु पातु नो दुष्टरं त्रायमाणं सहः ॥
verses.rom:
tvashta me daivyam vachah parjanyo brahmanaspatih |
putrairbhratribhiraditirnu patu no dushtaram trayamanam sahah ||
verses.en: Tvashṭar [protect] my address (vácas) to the gods, [also] Parjanya, Brahmaṇaspati; with sons, with brothers, let Aditi now protect our hard to surpass [and] saving power.

verses.sa:
अंशो भगो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमादितिः पान्तु मरुतः ।
अप तस्य द्वेषो गमेदभिह्रुतो यावयच्छत्रुमन्तितम् ॥
verses.rom:
amsho bhago varuno mitro aryamaditih pantu marutah |
apa tasya dvesho gamedabhihruto yavayachchhatrumantitam ||
verses.en: Let Aṅça, Bhaga, Varuṇa, Mitra, Aryaman, Aditi—let the Maruts protect [us]; may the hatred of that injurer pass away; repel the foe from near by.

verses.sa:
धिये समश्विना प्रावतं न उरुष्या ण उरुज्मन्न् अप्रयुच्छन् ।
द्यौष्पितर्यावय दुच्छुना या ॥
verses.rom:
dhiye samashvina pravatam na urushya na urujmann aprayuchchhan |
dyaushpitaryavaya duchchhuna ya ||
verses.en: Unto knowledge (? dhī́), O Açvins, do ye aid us; make wide for us, O wide-goer, unremitting; O heaven, father, repel whatever misfortune.

verses.sa:
उदेनमुत्तरं नयाग्ने घृतेनाहुत ।
समेनं वर्चसा सृज प्रजया च बहुं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
udenamuttaram nayagne ghritenahuta |
samenam varchasa srija prajaya cha bahum kridhi ||
verses.en: Lead him up higher, O Agni, [thou] to whom oblations of ghee are made; unite him with splendor, and make him abundant with progeny.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेमं प्रतरं कृधि सजातानामसद्वशी ।
रायस्पोषेण सं सृज जीवातवे जरसे नय ॥
verses.rom:
indremam prataram kridhi sajatanamasadvashi |
rayasposhena sam srija jivatave jarase naya ||
verses.en: O Indra, put this man far forward; may he be controler of his fellows; unite him with abundance of wealth; conduct him unto life (jīvā́tu), unto old age.

verses.sa:
यस्य कृण्मो हविर्गृहे तमग्ने वर्धया त्वम् ।
तस्मै सोमो अधि ब्रवदयं च ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya krinmo havirgrihe tamagne vardhaya tvam |
tasmai somo adhi bravadayam cha brahmanaspatih ||
verses.en: In whose house we make oblation, him, O Agni, do thou increase; him may Soma bless, and this Brahmaṇaspati.

verses.sa:
योऽस्मान् ब्रह्मणस्पतेऽदेवो अभिमन्यते ।
सर्वं तं रन्धयासि मे यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
yo'sman brahmanaspate'devo abhimanyate |
sarvam tam randhayasi me yajamanaya sunvate ||
verses.en: Whatever godless one, O Brahmaṇaspati, plots against us—every such one mayest thou make subject to me the sacrificer, the soma-presser.

verses.sa:
यो नः सोम सुशंसिनो दुःशंस आदिदेशति ।
वज्रेणास्य मुखे जहि स संपिष्टो अपायति ॥
verses.rom:
yo nah soma sushamsino duhshamsa adideshati |
vajrenasya mukhe jahi sa sampishto apayati ||
verses.en: Whatever ill-famed one, O Soma, shall aim at us of good fame, smite upon his face with the thunderbolt; may he go away crushed (sam-piṣ).

verses.sa:
यो नः सोमाभिदासति सनाभिर्यश्च निष्ट्यः ।
अप तस्य बलं तिर महीव द्यौर्वधत्मना ॥
verses.rom:
yo nah somabhidasati sanabhiryashcha nishtyah |
apa tasya balam tira mahiva dyaurvadhatmana ||
verses.en: Whoever, O Soma, shall assail us, of the same kindred and also a stranger—draw (tṛ) away his strength, like the great sky, even now (?).

verses.sa:
येन सोमादितिः पथा मित्रा वा यन्त्यद्रुहः ।
तेना नोऽवसा गहि ॥
verses.rom:
yena somaditih patha mitra va yantyadruhah |
tena no'vasa gahi ||
verses.en: By what road, O Soma, Aditi or friends go, not hostile, by that do thou come to us with aid.

verses.sa:
येन सोम साहन्त्यासुरान् रन्धयासि नः ।
तेना नो अधि वोचत ॥
verses.rom:
yena soma sahantyasuran randhayasi nah |
tena no adhi vochata ||
verses.en: By what, O Soma, overpowering one, thou shalt make the Asuras subject to us, by that do ye bless us.

verses.sa:
येन देवा असुराणामोजांस्यवृणीध्वम् ।
तेना नः शर्म यच्छत ॥
verses.rom:
yena deva asuranamojamsyavrinidhvam |
tena nah sharma yachchhata ||
verses.en: By what, O gods, ye did repel (vṛ) the mights of the Asuras, by that do ye yield refuge unto us.

verses.sa:
यथा वृक्षं लिबुजा समन्तं परिषस्वजे ।
एवा परि ष्वजस्व मां यथा मां कामिन्यसो यथा मन् नापगा असः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha vriksham libuja samantam parishasvaje |
eva pari shvajasva mam yatha mam kaminyaso yatha man napaga asah ||
verses.en: As the creeper (líbujā) has completely embraced the tree, so do thou embrace me—that thou mayest be one loving me, that thou mayest be one not going away from me.

verses.sa:
यथा सुपर्णः प्रपतन् पक्षौ निहन्ति भूम्याम् ।
एवा नि हन्मि ते मनो यथा मां कामिन्यसो यथा मन् नापगा असः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha suparnah prapatan pakshau nihanti bhumyam |
eva ni hanmi te mano yatha mam kaminyaso yatha man napaga asah ||
verses.en: As the eagle, flying forth, beats down his wings upon the earth, so do I beat down thy mind—that thou etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथेमे द्यावापृथिवी सद्यः पर्येति सूर्यः ।
एवा पर्येमि ते मनो यथा मां कामिन्यसो यथा मन् नापगा असः ॥
verses.rom:
yatheme dyavaprithivi sadyah paryeti suryah |
eva paryemi te mano yatha mam kaminyaso yatha man napaga asah ||
verses.en: As the sun goeth at once about heaven-and-earth here, so do I go about thy mind—that thou etc. etc.

verses.sa:
वाञ्छ मे तन्वं पादौ वाञ्छाक्ष्यौ वाञ्छ सक्थ्यौ ।
अक्ष्यौ वृषण्यन्त्याः केशा मां ते कामेन शुष्यन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
vanchha me tanvam padau vanchhakshyau vanchha sakthyau |
akshyau vrishanyantyah kesha mam te kamena shushyantu ||
verses.en: Want (vāñch) thou the body of me, the feet; want the eyes; want the thighs; let the eyes, the hair of thee, lusting after me, dry up with love.

verses.sa:
मम त्वा दोषणिश्रिषं कृणोमि हृदयश्रिषम् ।
यथा मम क्रतावसो मम चित्तमुपायसि ॥
verses.rom:
mama tva doshanishrisham krinomi hridayashrisham |
yatha mama kratavaso mama chittamupayasi ||
verses.en: I make thee cling to my arm, cling to my heart; that thou mayest be in my power, mayest come unto my intent.

verses.sa:
यासां नाभिरारेहणं हृदि संवननं कृतम्।
गावो घृतस्य मातरोऽमूं सं वानयन्तु मे ॥
verses.rom:
yasam nabhirarehanam hridi samvananam kritam|
gavo ghritasya mataro'mum sam vanayantu me ||
verses.en: They whose navel is a licking, in [whose] heart is made conciliation—let the kine, mothers of ghee, conciliate her yonder to me.

verses.sa: पृथिव्यै श्रोत्राय वनस्पतिभ्योऽग्नयेऽधिपतये स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: prithivyai shrotraya vanaspatibhyo'gnaye'dhipataye svaha ||
verses.en: To earth, to hearing, to the forest-trees—to Agni [their] overlord, hail!

verses.sa: प्राणायान्तरिक्षाय वयोभ्यो वायवेऽधिपतये स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: pranayantarikshaya vayobhyo vayave'dhipataye svaha ||
verses.en: To breath, to the atmosphere, to the birds—to Vāyu [their] overlord, hail!

verses.sa: दिवे चक्षुषे नक्षत्रेभ्यः सूर्यायाधिपतये स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom: dive chakshushe nakshatrebhyah suryayadhipataye svaha ||
verses.en: To the sky, to sight, to the asterisms—to Sūrya [their] overlord, hail!

verses.sa:
शमीमश्वत्थ आरूढस्तत्र पुंसुवनं कृतम् ।
तद्वै पुत्रस्य वेदनं तत्स्त्रीष्वा भरामसि ॥
verses.rom:
shamimashvattha arudhastatra pumsuvanam kritam |
tadvai putrasya vedanam tatstrishva bharamasi ||
verses.en: The açvatthá [has] mounted upon the çamī́; there is made the generation of a male; that verily is the obtainment of a son; that we bring into women.

verses.sa:
पुंसि वै रेतो भवति तत्स्त्रियामनु षिच्यते ।
तद्वै पुत्रस्य वेदनं तत्प्रजापतिरब्रवीत् ॥
verses.rom:
pumsi vai reto bhavati tatstriyamanu shichyate |
tadvai putrasya vedanam tatprajapatirabravit ||
verses.en: In the male, indeed, grows (bhū) the seed; that is poured along into the woman; that verily is the obtainment of a son; that Prajāpati said.

verses.sa:
प्रजापतिरनुमतिः सिनीवाल्यचीकॢपत्।
स्त्रैषूयमन्यत्र दधत्पुमांसमु दधदिह ॥
verses.rom:
prajapatiranumatih sinivalyachiklipat|
straishuyamanyatra dadhatpumamsamu dadhadiha ||
verses.en: Prajāpati, Anumati, Sinīvālī hath shaped; may he put elsewhere woman-birth; but may he put here a male.

verses.sa:
परि द्यामिव सूर्योऽहीनां जनिमागमम् ।
रात्री जगदिवान्यद्धंसात्तेना ते वारये विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
pari dyamiva suryo'hinam janimagamam |
ratri jagadivanyaddhamsattena te varaye visham ||
verses.en: I have gone about the race of snakes, as the sun about the sky, as night about living creatures other than the swan (haṅsá); thereby do I ward off thy poison.

verses.sa:
यद्ब्रह्मभिर्यदृषिभिर्यद्देवैर्विदितं पुरा ।
यद्भूतं भव्यमासन्वत्तेना ते वारये विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadbrahmabhiryadrishibhiryaddevairviditam pura |
yadbhutam bhavyamasanvattena te varaye visham ||
verses.en: What was known of old by priests (brahmán), what by seers, what by gods; what is (bhūtá), is to be, that has a mouth—therewith do I ward off thy poison.

verses.sa:
मध्वा पृञ्चे नद्यः पर्वता गिरयो मधु ।
मधु परुष्णी शीपाला शमास्ने अस्तु शं हृदे ॥
verses.rom:
madhva prinche nadyah parvata girayo madhu |
madhu parushni shipala shamasne astu sham hride ||
verses.en: With honey I mix (pṛc) the streams; the rugged (? párvata) mountains [are] honey; honey is the Páruṣṇī, the Cī́pālā; weal be to thy mouth, weal to thy heart.

verses.sa:
नमो देववधेभ्यो नमो राजवधेभ्यः ।
अथो ये विश्यानां वधास्तेभ्यो मृत्यो नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
verses.rom:
namo devavadhebhyo namo rajavadhebhyah |
atho ye vishyanam vadhastebhyo mrityo namo'stu te ||
verses.en: Homage to the weapons (vadhá) of the gods; homage to the weapons of kings; likewise the weapons that are of the Vāiçyas—to them of thine, O death, be homage.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते अधिवाकाय परावाकाय ते नमः ।
सुमत्यै मृत्यो ते नमो दुर्मत्यै ते इदं नमः ॥
verses.rom:
namaste adhivakaya paravakaya te namah |
sumatyai mrityo te namo durmatyai te idam namah ||
verses.en: Homage to thy benediction; homage to thy malediction; homage to thy favor, O death; this homage to thy disfavor.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते यातुधानेभ्यो नमस्ते भेषजेभ्यः ।
नमस्ते मृत्यो मूलेभ्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्य इदं नमः ॥
verses.rom:
namaste yatudhanebhyo namaste bheshajebhyah |
namaste mrityo mulebhyo brahmanebhya idam namah ||
verses.en: Homage to thy sorcerers; homage to thy remedies; homage to thy roots, O death; this homage to the Brāhmans.

verses.sa:
अस्थिस्रंसं परुस्रंसमास्थितं हृदयामयम् ।
बलासं सर्वं नाशयाङ्गेष्ठा यश्च पर्वसु ॥
verses.rom:
asthisramsam parusramsamasthitam hridayamayam |
balasam sarvam nashayangeshtha yashcha parvasu ||
verses.en: The bone-dissolving, joint-dissolving, settled (ā́sthita) heart disease, all the balā́sa, cause thou to disappear, that is seated in the limbs and in the joints.

verses.sa:
निर्बलासं बलासिनः क्षिणोमि मुष्करं यथा ।
छिनद्म्यस्य बन्धनं मूलमुर्वार्वा इव ॥
verses.rom:
nirbalasam balasinah kshinomi mushkaram yatha |
chhinadmyasya bandhanam mulamurvarva iva ||
verses.en: The balā́sa of him that has balā́sa I destroy like a muṣkará; I cut its bond like the root of a gourd.

verses.sa:
निर्बलासेतः प्र पताशुङ्गः शिशुको यथा ।
अथो इत इव हायनोऽप द्राह्यवीरहा ॥
verses.rom:
nirbalasetah pra patashungah shishuko yatha |
atho ita iva hayano'pa drahyaviraha ||
verses.en: Fly out forth from here, O balā́sa, like a young āçuṁgá; then, like the [last] year's bulrush, scud away, innocuous to heroes.

verses.sa:
उत्तमो अस्योषधीनां तव वृक्षा उपस्तयः ।
उपस्तिरस्तु सोऽस्माकं यो अस्मामभिदासति ॥
verses.rom:
uttamo asyoshadhinam tava vriksha upastayah |
upastirastu so'smakam yo asmamabhidasati ||
verses.en: Thou art the highest of herbs; of thee the trees are subjects (upastí); let him be our subject who assails us.

verses.sa:
सबन्धुश्चासबन्धुश्च यो अस्मामभिदासति ।
तेषां सा वृक्षाणामिवाहं भूयासमुत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
sabandhushchasabandhushcha yo asmamabhidasati |
tesham sa vrikshanamivaham bhuyasamuttamah ||
verses.en: Whoever, both kindred and not of kin, assails us, of them may I be highest, as this one of trees.

verses.sa:
यथा सोम ओषधीनामुत्तमो हविषां कृतः ।
तलाशा वृक्षाणामिवाहं भूयासमुत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha soma oshadhinamuttamo havisham kritah |
talasha vrikshanamivaham bhuyasamuttamah ||
verses.en: As of herbs soma is made highest of oblations, as the talā́çā of trees, [so] may I be highest.

verses.sa:
आबयो अनाबयो रसस्त उग्र आबयो ।
आ ते करम्भमद्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
abayo anabayo rasasta ugra abayo |
a te karambhamadmasi ||
verses.en: O ābayu, non-ābayu! thy juice is sharp (ugrá), O ābayu! unto thy broth do we eat.

verses.sa:
विहह्लो नाम ते पिता मदावती नाम ते माता ।
स हिन त्वमसि यस्त्वमात्मानमावयः ॥
verses.rom:
vihahlo nama te pita madavati nama te mata |
sa hina tvamasi yastvamatmanamavayah ||
verses.en: Vihálha by name is thy father, madávatī ('intoxicated') by name is thy mother; for thou art he, not thyself, thou that didst consume thyself.

verses.sa:
तौविलिकेऽवेलयावायमैलब ऐलयीत्।
बभ्रुश्च बभ्रुकर्णश्चापेहि निराल ॥
verses.rom:
tauvilike'velayavayamailaba ailayit|
babhrushcha babhrukarnashchapehi nirala ||
verses.en: O tāuvilikā, quiet down; this racket hath quieted down; both the brown and the brown-eared one: go away, O nirāla!

verses.sa:
अलसालासि पूर्व सिलाञ्जालास्युत्तरा ।
नीलागलसाल ॥
verses.rom:
alasalasi purva silanjalasyuttara |
nilagalasala ||
verses.en: Alasálā art thou first; silā́njālā art thou after; nīlāgalasálā.

verses.sa:
यथेयं पृथिवी मही भूतानां गर्भमादधे ।
एवा ते ध्रियतां गर्भो अनु सूतुं सवितवे ॥
verses.rom:
yatheyam prithivi mahi bhutanam garbhamadadhe |
eva te dhriyatam garbho anu sutum savitave ||
verses.en: As this great earth receives the embryo of existences, so let thine embryo be maintained, in order to birth after pregnancy.

verses.sa:
यथेयं पृथिवी मही दाधारेमान् वनस्पतीन् ।
एवा ते ध्रियतां गर्भो अनु सूतुं सवितवे ॥
verses.rom:
yatheyam prithivi mahi dadhareman vanaspatin |
eva te dhriyatam garbho anu sutum savitave ||
verses.en: As this great earth maintains these forest-trees, so let thine etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथेयं पृथिवी मही दाधार पर्वतान् गिरीन् ।
एवा ते ध्रियतां गर्भो अनु सूतुं सवितवे ॥
verses.rom:
yatheyam prithivi mahi dadhara parvatan girin |
eva te dhriyatam garbho anu sutum savitave ||
verses.en: As this great earth maintains the rugged (párvata) mountains, so let thine etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथेयं पृथिवी मही दाधार विष्ठितं जगत्।
एवा ते ध्रियतां गर्भो अनु सूतुं सवितवे ॥
verses.rom:
yatheyam prithivi mahi dadhara vishthitam jagat|
eva te dhriyatam garbho anu sutum savitave ||
verses.en: As this great earth maintains the various (víṣṭhita) living beings, so let thine etc. etc.

verses.sa:
ईर्ष्याया ध्राजिं प्रथमां प्रथमस्या उतापराम् ।
अग्निं हृदय्यं शोकं तं ते निर्वापयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
irshyaya dhrajim prathamam prathamasya utaparam |
agnim hridayyam shokam tam te nirvapayamasi ||
verses.en: The first blast of jealousy, and the one after the first, the fire, the heat of the heart—this we extinguish for thee.

verses.sa:
यथा भूमिर्मृतमना मृतान् मृतमनस्तरा ।
यथोत मम्रुषो मन एवेर्ष्योर्मृतं मनः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha bhumirmritamana mritan mritamanastara |
yathota mamrusho mana evershyormritam manah ||
verses.en: As the earth [is] dead-minded, more dead-minded than a dead man, and as [is] the mind of one who has died, so of the jealous man the mind [be] dead.

verses.sa:
अदो यत्ते हृदि श्रितं मनस्कं पतयिष्णुकम् ।
ततस्त ईर्ष्यां मुञ्चामि निरूष्माणं दृतेरिव ॥
verses.rom:
ado yatte hridi shritam manaskam patayishnukam |
tatasta irshyam munchami nirushmanam driteriva ||
verses.en: That fluttering mind (manaská) that has found place in (çritá) thy heart—from it I set free thy jealousy, like the hot vapor from a bag of skin.

verses.sa:
पुनन्तु मा देवजनाः पुनन्तु मनवो धिया ।
पुनन्तु विश्वा भूतानि पवमानः पुनातु मा ॥
verses.rom:
punantu ma devajanah punantu manavo dhiya |
punantu vishva bhutani pavamanah punatu ma ||
verses.en: Let the god-folk purify me; let men (mánu) purify me with prayer (dhī́); let all beings purify me; let the purifying one purify me.

verses.sa:
पवमानः पुनातु मा क्रत्वे दक्षाय जीवसे ।
अथो अरिष्टतातये ॥
verses.rom:
pavamanah punatu ma kratve dakshaya jivase |
atho arishtatataye ||
verses.en: Let the purifying one purify me, in order to activity, dexterity, life, likewise unharmedness.

verses.sa:
उभाभ्यां देव सवितः पवित्रेण सवेन च ।
अस्मान् पुनीहि चक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
ubhabhyam deva savitah pavitrena savena cha |
asman punihi chakshase ||
verses.en: With both, O divine impeller (savitár), with purifier and with impulse, do thou purify us in order to seeing.

verses.sa:
अग्नेरिवास्य दहत एति शुष्मिण उतेव मत्तो विलपन्न् अपायति ।
अन्यमस्मदिच्छतु कं चिदव्रतस्तपुर्वधाय नमो अस्तु तक्मने ॥
verses.rom:
agnerivasya dahata eti shushmina uteva matto vilapann apayati |
anyamasmadichchhatu kam chidavratastapurvadhaya namo astu takmane ||
verses.en: Of him as of burning fire goeth the vehemence (?); likewise, as it were, shall he crying out go away from me; some other one than us let the ill-behaved one seek; homage be to the heat-weaponed fever.

verses.sa:
नमो रुद्राय नमो अस्तु तक्मने नमो राज्ञे वरुणाय त्विषीमते ।
नमो दिवे नमः पृथिव्यै नम ओषधीभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
namo rudraya namo astu takmane namo rajne varunaya tvishimate |
namo dive namah prithivyai nama oshadhibhyah ||
verses.en: Homage to Rudra, homage be to the fever, homage to king Varuṇa, the brilliant (tvíṣīmant), homage to the sky, homage to the earth, homage to the herbs.

verses.sa:
अयं यो अभिशोचयिष्णुर्विश्वा रूपाणि हरिता कृणोषि ।
तस्मै तेऽरुणाय बभ्रवे नमः कृणोमि वन्याय तक्मने ॥
verses.rom:
ayam yo abhishochayishnurvishva rupani harita krinoshi |
tasmai te'runaya babhrave namah krinomi vanyaya takmane ||
verses.en: Thou here who, scorching greatly, dost make all forms yellow—to thee here, the ruddy, the brown, the woody takmán, do I pay homage.

verses.sa:
इमा यास्तिस्रः पृथिवीस्तासां ह भूमिरुत्तमा ।
तासामधि त्वचो अहं भेषजं समु जग्रभम् ॥
verses.rom:
ima yastisrah prithivistasam ha bhumiruttama |
tasamadhi tvacho aham bheshajam samu jagrabham ||

verses.sa:
श्रेष्ठमसि भेषजानां वसिष्ठं वीरुधानाम् ।
सोमो भग इव यामेषु देवेषु वरुणो यथा ॥
verses.rom:
shreshthamasi bheshajanam vasishtham virudhanam |
somo bhaga iva yameshu deveshu varuno yatha ||

verses.sa:
रेवतीरनाधृषः सिषासवः सिषासथ ।
उत स्थ केशदृंहणीरथो ह केशवर्धनीः ॥
verses.rom:
revatiranadhrishah sishasavah sishasatha |
uta stha keshadrimhaniratho ha keshavardhanih ||

prose.en:
1. These three earths (pṛthivī́) that there are—of them earth (bhū́mi) is the highest; from off their skin have I seized a remedy.

2. Thou art the most excellent of remedies, the best of plants; as Soma, lord (? bhága) in the night-watches (yā́ma), like Varuṇa among the gods.

verses.sa:
कृष्णं नियानं हरयः सुपर्णा अपो वसाना दिवमुत्पतन्ति ।
त आववृत्रन्त्सदनादृतस्यादिद्घृतेन पृथिवीं व्यूदुः ॥
verses.rom:
krishnam niyanam harayah suparna apo vasana divamutpatanti |
ta avavritrantsadanadritasyadidghritena prithivim vyuduh ||
verses.en: Black the down-track, the yellow eagles, clothing themselves in waters, fly up to the sky; they have come hither from the seat of righteousness (ṛtá); then, forsooth, with ghee they deluged the earth.

verses.sa:
पयस्वतीः कृणुथाप ओषधीः शिवा यदेजथा मरुतो रुक्मवक्षसः ।
ऊर्जं च तत्र सुमतिं च पिन्वत यत्रा नरो मरुतः सिञ्चथा मधु ॥
verses.rom:
payasvatih krinuthapa oshadhih shiva yadejatha maruto rukmavakshasah |
urjam cha tatra sumatim cha pinvata yatra naro marutah sinchatha madhu ||
verses.en: Ye make the waters rich in milk, the herbs propitious, when ye bestir yourselves, O golden-backed Maruts; do ye lavish (pinv) both sustenance and good-will there, where, O manly Maruts, ye pour honey.

verses.sa:
उदप्रुतो मरुतस्तामियर्त वृष्टिर्या विश्वा निवतस्पृणाति ।
एजाति ग्लहा कन्येव तुन्नैरुं तुन्दाना पत्येव जाया ॥
verses.rom:
udapruto marutastamiyarta vrishtirya vishva nivatasprinati |
ejati glaha kanyeva tunnairum tundana patyeva jaya ||
verses.en: Water-swimming [are] the Maruts; send ye that rain which shall fill all the hollows; the gláhā shall bestir itself, like a girl that is thrust, thrusting the éru, like wife with husband.

verses.sa:
सस्रुषीस्तदपसो दिवा नक्तं च सस्रुषीः ।
वरेण्यक्रतुरहमपो देवीरुप ह्वये ॥
verses.rom:
sasrushistadapaso diva naktam cha sasrushih |
varenyakraturahamapo devirupa hvaye ||
verses.en: Flowing on, devoted to it; by day and by night flowing on; I, of desirable activity, call upon the heavenly waters.

verses.sa:
ओता आपः कर्मण्या मुञ्चन्त्वितः प्रणीतये ।
सद्यः कृण्वन्त्वेतवे ॥
verses.rom:
ota apah karmanya munchantvitah pranitaye |
sadyah krinvantvetave ||
verses.en: Let them release here the worked-in waters of the ceremony for conducting forward; let them at once make [them] to go.

verses.sa:
देवस्य सवितुः सवे कर्म कृण्वन्तु मानुषाः ।
शं नो भवन्त्वप ओषधीः शिवाः ॥
verses.rom:
devasya savituh save karma krinvantu manushah |
sham no bhavantvapa oshadhih shivah ||
verses.en: In the impulse (savá) of the divine impeller (savitár) let men do their [sacred] work; weal to us be the waters, the herbs propitious.

verses.sa:
हिमवतः प्र स्रवन्ति सिन्धौ समह सङ्गमः ।
आपो ह मह्यं तद्देवीर्ददन् हृद्द्योतभेषजम् ॥
verses.rom:
himavatah pra sravanti sindhau samaha sangamah |
apo ha mahyam taddevirdadan hriddyotabheshajam ||
verses.en: They flow forth from the snowy (mountain); in the Indus somewhere [is their] gathering; may the heavenly waters give to me that remedy for heart-burn.

verses.sa:
यन् मे अक्ष्योरादिद्योत पार्ष्ण्योः प्रपदोश्च यत्।
आपस्तत्सर्वं निष्करन् भिषजां सुभिषक्तमाः ॥
verses.rom:
yan me akshyoradidyota parshnyoh prapadoshcha yat|
apastatsarvam nishkaran bhishajam subhishaktamah ||
verses.en: Whatever hath burnt (ā-dyut) in my eyes, and what in my heels, my front feet; may the waters remove all that—they of physicians the most excellent physicians.

verses.sa:
सिन्धुपत्नीः सिन्धुराज्ञीः सर्वा या नद्य स्थन ।
दत्त नस्तस्य भेषजं तेना वो भुनजामहै ॥
verses.rom:
sindhupatnih sindhurajnih sarva ya nadya sthana |
datta nastasya bheshajam tena vo bhunajamahai ||
verses.en: Ye whose spouse is the Indus, whose king is the Indus, all ye streams that are—give us the remedy for this; for that would we enjoy you.

verses.sa:
पञ्च च याः पञ्चाशच्च संयन्ति मन्या अभि ।
इतस्ताः सर्वा नश्यन्तु वाका अपचितामिव ॥
verses.rom:
pancha cha yah panchashachcha samyanti manya abhi |
itastah sarva nashyantu vaka apachitamiva ||
verses.en: Both the five and the fifty that gather against those of the nape—let them all disappear from here, like the noises (? vāká) of the apacíts.

verses.sa:
सप्त च याः सप्ततिश्च संयन्ति ग्रैव्या अभि ।
इतस्ताः सर्वा नश्यन्तु वाका अपचितामिव ॥
verses.rom:
sapta cha yah saptatishcha samyanti graivya abhi |
itastah sarva nashyantu vaka apachitamiva ||
verses.en: Both the seven and the seventy that gather against those of the neck—let them all etc. etc.

verses.sa:
नव च या नवतिश्च संयन्ति स्कन्ध्या अभि ।
इतस्ताः सर्वा नश्यन्तु वाका अपचितामिव ॥
verses.rom:
nava cha ya navatishcha samyanti skandhya abhi |
itastah sarva nashyantu vaka apachitamiva ||
verses.en: Both the nine and the ninety that gather against those of the shoulders—let them all etc. etc.

verses.sa:
अव मा पाप्मन्त्सृज वशी सन् मृदयासि नः ।
आ मा भद्रस्य लोके पाप्मन् धेह्यविह्रुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ava ma papmantsrija vashi san mridayasi nah |
a ma bhadrasya loke papman dhehyavihrutam ||
verses.en: Let me go, O evil (pāpmán) being in control, mayest thou be gracious to us; set me uninjured in the world of the excellent, O evil.

verses.sa:
यो नः पाप्मन् न जहासि तमु त्वा जहिमो वयम् ।
पथामनु व्यावर्तनेऽन्यं पाप्मानु पद्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo nah papman na jahasi tamu tva jahimo vayam |
pathamanu vyavartane'nyam papmanu padyatam ||
verses.en: Thou who, O evil, dost not leave us, thee here do we leave; along at the turning apart of the ways, let evil go after another.

verses.sa:
अन्यत्रास्मन् न्युच्यतु सहस्राक्षो अमर्त्यः ।
यं द्वेषाम तमृच्छतु यमु द्विष्मस्तमिज्जहि ॥
verses.rom:
anyatrasman nyuchyatu sahasraksho amartyah |
yam dveshama tamrichchhatu yamu dvishmastamijjahi ||
verses.en: Elsewhere than [with] us let the thousand-eyed immortal one make its home; whomsoever we may hate, him let it come upon (ṛch); and whom we hate, just him do thou smite.

verses.sa:
देवाः कपोत इषितो यदिच्छन् दूतो निर्ऋत्या इदमाजगाम ।
तस्मा अर्चाम कृणवाम निष्कृतिं शं नो अस्तु द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे ॥
verses.rom:
devah kapota ishito yadichchhan duto nirritya idamajagama |
tasma archama krinavama nishkritim sham no astu dvipade sham chatushpade ||
verses.en: Seeking what, O gods, the sent dove, messenger of perdition, hath come hither, to it will we sing praises, make removal; weal be [it] to our bipeds, weal to our quadrupeds.

verses.sa:
शिवः कपोत इषितो नो अस्त्वनागा देवाः शकुनो गृहं नः ।
अग्निर्हि विप्रो जुषतां हविर्नः परि हेतिः पक्षिणी नो वृणक्तु ॥
verses.rom:
shivah kapota ishito no astvanaga devah shakuno griham nah |
agnirhi vipro jushatam havirnah pari hetih pakshini no vrinaktu ||
verses.en: Propitious to us be the sent dove, harmless, O gods, the hawk (çakuná) [sent] to our house; for let the inspired (vípra) Agni enjoy our oblation, let the winged missile avoid us.

verses.sa:
हेतिः पक्षिणी न दभात्यस्मान् आष्ट्री पदं कृणुते अग्निधाने ।
शिवो गोभ्य उत पुरुषेभ्यो नो अस्तु मा नो देवा इह हिंसीत्कपोत ॥
verses.rom:
hetih pakshini na dabhatyasman ashtri padam krinute agnidhane |
shivo gobhya uta purushebhyo no astu ma no deva iha himsitkapota ||
verses.en: May the winged missile not harm us; it maketh its track on the hearth, in the fire-holder; propitious be it unto our kine and men; let not the dove, O gods, injure us here.

verses.sa:
ऋचा कपोतं नुदत प्रणोदमिषं मदन्तः परि गां नयामः ।
संलोभयन्तो दुरिता पदानि हित्वा न ऊर्जं प्र पदात्पथिष्ठः ॥
verses.rom:
richa kapotam nudata pranodamisham madantah pari gam nayamah |
samlobhayanto durita padani hitva na urjam pra padatpathishthah ||
verses.en: With the praise-verse (ṛ́ç) drive ye the dove forth (praṇódam); reveling in food (íṣ) we lead a cow about, breaking up tracks hard to go in; leaving us (our ?) sustenance shall it fly forth, swift-flying.

verses.sa:
परीमेऽग्निमर्षत परीमे गामनेषत ।
देवेष्वक्रत श्रवः क इमामा दधर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
parime'gnimarshata parime gamaneshata |
deveshvakrata shravah ka imama dadharshati ||
verses.en: These have taken fire about; these have led the cow about; they have gained themselves fame (çrávas) among the gods—who shall venture to attack them?

verses.sa:
यः प्रथमः प्रवतमाससाद बहुभ्यः पन्थामनुपस्पशानः ।
योऽस्येशे द्विपदो यश्चतुष्पदस्तस्मै यमाय नमो अस्तु मृत्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
yah prathamah pravatamasasada bahubhyah panthamanupaspashanah |
yo'syeshe dvipado yashchatushpadastasmai yamaya namo astu mrityave ||
verses.en: He who first attained (ā-sad) the slope [of heaven], spying out the road for many, who is master of these bipeds, who of the quadrupeds—to that Yama, to death, be homage.

verses.sa:
अमून् हेतिः पतत्रिणी न्येतु यदुलूको वदति मोघमेतत्।
यद्वा कपोत पदमग्नौ कृणोति ॥
verses.rom:
amun hetih patatrini nyetu yaduluko vadati moghametat|
yadva kapota padamagnau krinoti ||
verses.en: Them yonder let the winged missile come upon; what the owl utters, [be] that to no purpose, or that the dove makes its track (padá) at the fire.

verses.sa:
यौ ते दूतौ निर्ऋत इदमेतोऽप्रहितौ प्रहितौ वा गृहं नः ।
कपोतोलूकाभ्यामपदं तदस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yau te dutau nirrita idameto'prahitau prahitau va griham nah |
kapotolukabhyamapadam tadastu ||
verses.en: Thy two messengers, O perdition, that come hither, not sent forth or sent forth, to our house—for the dove and owl be this no place.

verses.sa:
अवैरहत्यायेदमा पपत्यात्सुवीरताया इदमा ससद्यात्।
पराङेव परा वद पराचीमनु संवतम् ।
यथा यमस्य त्वा गृहेऽरसं प्रतिचाकशान् आभूकं प्रतिचाकशान् ॥
verses.rom:
avairahatyayedama papatyatsuvirataya idama sasadyat|
paraneva para vada parachimanu samvatam |
yatha yamasya tva grihe'rasam pratichakashan abhukam pratichakashan ||
verses.en: May it fly hither in order to non-destruction of heroes; may it settle (ā-sad) here in order to abundance of heroes; turned away, do thou speak away, toward a distant stretch (? saṁvát); so that in Yama's house they may look upon thee [as] sapless, may look upon [thee as] empty (ābhū́ka).

verses.sa:
देवा इमं मधुना संयुतं यवं सरस्वत्यामधि मणावचर्कृषुः ।
इन्द्र आसीत्सीरपतिः शतक्रतुः कीनाशा आसन् मरुतः सुदानवः ॥
verses.rom:
deva imam madhuna samyutam yavam sarasvatyamadhi manavacharkrishuh |
indra asitsirapatih shatakratuh kinasha asan marutah sudanavah ||
verses.en: This barley, combined with honey, the gods plowed much on the Sarasvatī, in behalf of Manu (?); Indra, of a hundred abilities, was furrow-master; the liberal (? sudā́nu) Maruts were the plowmen.

verses.sa:
यस्ते मदोऽवकेशो विकेशो येनाभिहस्यं पुरुषं कृणोषि ।
आरात्त्वदन्या वनानि वृक्षि त्वं शमि शतवल्शा वि रोह ॥
verses.rom:
yaste mado'vakesho vikesho yenabhihasyam purusham krinoshi |
arattvadanya vanani vrikshi tvam shami shatavalsha vi roha ||
verses.en: The intoxication that is thine, with loosened hair, with disheveled hair, wherewith thou makest a man to be laughed at—far from thee do I wrench [out] other woods; do thou, O çamī́, grow up with a hundred twigs.

verses.sa:
बृहत्पलाशे सुभगे वर्षवृद्ध ऋतावरि ।
मातेव पुत्रेभ्यो मृड केशेभ्यः शमि ॥
verses.rom:
brihatpalashe subhage varshavriddha ritavari |
mateva putrebhyo mrida keshebhyah shami ||
verses.en: O thou of great leaves, blessed one, rain-increased, righteous! as a mother to her sons, be thou gracious to the hair, O çamī́.

verses.sa:
आयं गौः पृश्निरक्रमीदसदन् मातरं पुरः ।
पितरं च प्रयन्त्स्वः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam gauh prishnirakramidasadan mataram purah |
pitaram cha prayantsvah ||
verses.en: Hither hath stridden this spotted steer, hath sat upon his mother in the east, and going forward to his father, the heaven (svàr).

verses.sa:
अन्तश्चरति रोचना अस्य प्राणादपानतः ।
व्यख्यन् महिषः स्वः ॥
verses.rom:
antashcharati rochana asya pranadapanatah |
vyakhyan mahishah svah ||
verses.en: He moves between the shining spaces, from the breath of this outbreathing [universe]; the bull (mahiṣá) hath looked forth unto the heaven (svàr).

verses.sa:
त्रिंशद्धामा वि राजति वाक्पतङ्गो अशिश्रियत्।
प्रति वस्तोरहर्द्युभिः ॥
verses.rom:
trimshaddhama vi rajati vakpatango ashishriyat|
prati vastorahardyubhih ||
verses.en: Thirty domains (dhā́man) he rules over; voice, the bird, hath set up, to meet the day with the lights of morning.

verses.sa:
अन्तर्दावे जुहुत स्वेतद्यातुधानक्षयणं घृतेन ।
आराद्रक्षांसि प्रति दह त्वमग्ने न नो गृहाणामुप तीतपासि ॥
verses.rom:
antardave juhuta svetadyatudhanakshayanam ghritena |
aradrakshamsi prati daha tvamagne na no grihanamupa titapasi ||
verses.en: Within the flame, pray, make ye this sorcerer-destroying libation with ghee; from afar, O Agni, do thou burn against the demons; mayest thou not be hot toward our houses.

verses.sa:
रुद्रो वो ग्रीवा अशरैत्पिशाचाः पृष्टीर्वोऽपि शृणातु यातुधानाः ।
वीरुद्वो विश्वतोवीर्या यमेन समजीगमत् ॥
verses.rom:
rudro vo griva asharaitpishachah prishtirvo'pi shrinatu yatudhanah |
virudvo vishvatovirya yamena samajigamat ||
verses.en: Rudra hath crushed (çṛ) your necks, O piçācás; let him crush in (api-çṛ) your ribs, O sorcerers; the plant of universal power hath made you go to Yama.

verses.sa:
अभयं मित्रावरुणाविहास्तु नोऽर्चिषात्त्रिणो नुदतं प्रतीचः ।
मा ज्ञातारं मा प्रतिष्ठां विदन्त मिथो विघ्नाना उप यन्तु मृत्युम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhayam mitravarunavihastu no'rchishattrino nudatam pratichah |
ma jnataram ma pratishtham vidanta mitho vighnana upa yantu mrityum ||
verses.en: Fearlessness, O Mitra-and-Varuṇa, be ours here; drive ye backward the devourers with your gleam; let them not find a knower, nor a foundation (pratiṣṭhā́); mutually destroying one another let them go unto death.

verses.sa:
यस्येदमा रजो युजस्तुजे जना नवं स्वः ।
इन्द्रस्य रन्त्यं बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
yasyedama rajo yujastuje jana navam svah |
indrasya rantyam brihat ||
verses.en: Of whom the welkin (rájas) here [is] the allies, [who] thrusts (?) people, the wood, the heaven—great [is] Indra's gladness.

verses.sa:
नाधृष आ दधृषते धृषाणो धृषितः शवः ।
पुरा यथा व्यथिः श्रव इन्द्रस्य नाधृषे शवः ॥
verses.rom:
nadhrisha a dadhrishate dhrishano dhrishitah shavah |
pura yatha vyathih shrava indrasya nadhrishe shavah ||
verses.en: [He is] not to be dared against; [his] might, dared, dares daring against [others]; as, of old, his fame [was] unwavering, Indra's might [is] not to be dared against.

verses.sa:
स नो ददातु तां रयिमुरुं पिशङ्गसंदृशम् ।
इन्द्रः पतिस्तुविष्टमो जनेष्वा ॥
verses.rom:
sa no dadatu tam rayimurum pishangasamdrisham |
indrah patistuvishtamo janeshva ||
verses.en: Let him give us that wide wealth, of reddish (piçán̄ga-) aspect; Indra [is] most powerful lord among the people.

verses.sa:
प्राग्नये वाचमीरय वृषभाय क्षितीनाम् ।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
pragnaye vachamiraya vrishabhaya kshitinam |
sa nah parshadati dvishah ||
verses.en: Send thou forth the voice for Agni, bull of people (kṣití): may he pass us over our haters.

verses.sa:
यो रक्षांसि निजूर्वत्यग्निस्तिग्मेन शोचिषा ।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
yo rakshamsi nijurvatyagnistigmena shochisha |
sa nah parshadati dvishah ||
verses.en: He who burns down the demons, Agni, with sharp heat (çocís): may he etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यः परस्याः परावतस्तिरो धन्वातिरोचते ।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
yah parasyah paravatastiro dhanvatirochate |
sa nah parshadati dvishah ||
verses.en: He who from distant distance shines over across the wastes: may he etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यो विश्वाभि विपश्यति भुवना सं च पश्यति ।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
yo vishvabhi vipashyati bhuvana sam cha pashyati |
sa nah parshadati dvishah ||
verses.en: Who looks forth upon and beholds together all beings: may he etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यो अस्य पारे रजसः शुक्रो अग्निरजायत ।
स नः पर्षदति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
yo asya pare rajasah shukro agnirajayata |
sa nah parshadati dvishah ||
verses.en: Who, the bright Agni, was born on the further shore of this firmament (rájas): may he etc. etc.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरो न ऊतय आ प्र यातु परावतः ।
अग्निर्नः सुष्टुतीरुप ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanaro na utaya a pra yatu paravatah |
agnirnah sushtutirupa ||
verses.en: Let Vāiçvānara, for our aid, come forth hither from the distance—Agni, unto our good praises.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरो न आगमदिमं यज्ञं सजूरुप ।
अग्निरुक्थेष्वंहसु ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanaro na agamadimam yajnam sajurupa |
agniruktheshvamhasu ||
verses.en: Vāiçvānara, our ally (sajū́s), hath come unto this our offering—Agni, at our songs, in our distresses.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरोऽङ्गिरसां स्तोममुक्थं च चाकॢपत्।
ऐषु द्युम्नं स्वर्यमत् ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanaro'ngirasam stomamuktham cha chaklipat|
aishu dyumnam svaryamat ||
verses.en: May Vāiçvānara shape the praise and song of the An̄girases; may he extend to them brightness (dyumná) [and] heaven (svàr).

verses.sa:
ऋतावानं वैश्वानरमृतस्य ज्योतिषस्पतिम् ।
अजस्रं घर्ममीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
ritavanam vaishvanaramritasya jyotishaspatim |
ajasram gharmamimahe ||
verses.en: To Vāiçvānara, the righteous, lord of right, of light, we pray for unfailing heat (gharmá).

verses.sa:
स विश्वा प्रति चाकॢप ऋतूंरुत्सृजते वशी ।
यज्ञस्य वय उत्तिरन् ॥
verses.rom:
sa vishva prati chaklipa ritumrutsrijate vashi |
yajnasya vaya uttiran ||
verses.en: He shaped himself unto all things; he, the controlling one, sends out the seasons, drawing out the vigor (váyas) of the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अग्निः परेषु धामसु कामो भूतस्य भव्यस्य ।
सम्रादेको वि राजति ॥
verses.rom:
agnih pareshu dhamasu kamo bhutasya bhavyasya |
samradeko vi rajati ||
verses.en: Agni, in distant domains, the desire of what is and is to be, bears rule as the one universal ruler.

verses.sa:
उप प्रागात्सहस्राक्षो युक्त्वा शपथो रथम् ।
शप्तारमन्विच्छन् मम वृक इवाविमतो गृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
upa pragatsahasraksho yuktva shapatho ratham |
shaptaramanvichchhan mama vrika ivavimato griham ||
verses.en: Hither hath come forth, having harnessed his chariot, the thousand-eyed curse, seeking after my curser, as a wolf the house of a sheepowner.

verses.sa:
परि णो वृङ्ग्धि शपथ ह्रदमग्निरिवा दहन् ।
शप्तारमत्र नो जहि दिवो वृक्षमिवाशनिः ॥
verses.rom:
pari no vringdhi shapatha hradamagniriva dahan |
shaptaramatra no jahi divo vrikshamivashanih ||
verses.en: Avoid us, O curse, as a burning fire a pond; smite our curser here, as the bolt from heaven a tree.

verses.sa:
यो नः शपादशपतः शपतो यश्च नः शपात्।
शुने पेष्ट्रमिवावक्षामं तं प्रत्यस्यामि मृत्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
yo nah shapadashapatah shapato yashcha nah shapat|
shune peshtramivavakshamam tam pratyasyami mrityave ||
verses.en: Whoever shall curse us not cursing, and whoever shall curse us cursing, him, withered (?), I cast forth for death, as a bone (?) for a dog.

verses.sa:
सिंहे व्याघ्र उत या पृदाकौ त्विषिरग्नौ ब्राह्मणे सूर्ये या ।
इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान सा न ऐतु वर्चसा संविदाना ॥
verses.rom:
simhe vyaghra uta ya pridakau tvishiragnau brahmane surye ya |
indram ya devi subhaga jajana sa na aitu varchasa samvidana ||
verses.en: What brilliancy (tvíṣi) is in lion, in tiger, and what in adder, in fire, in the Brāhman, what in the sun: the fortunate goddess that gave birth to Indra—let her come to us, in union with splendor.

verses.sa:
या हस्तिनि द्वीपिनि या हिरण्ये त्विषिरप्सु गोषु या पुरुषेषु ।
इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान सा न ऐतु वर्चसा संविदाना ॥
verses.rom:
ya hastini dvipini ya hiranye tvishirapsu goshu ya purusheshu |
indram ya devi subhaga jajana sa na aitu varchasa samvidana ||
verses.en: What brilliancy is in elephant, in leopard, what in gold, in waters, in kine, what in men (púruṣa): the fortunate goddess etc. etc.

verses.sa:
रथे अक्षेष्वृषभस्य वाजे वाते पर्जन्ये वरुणस्य शुष्मे ।
इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान सा न ऐतु वर्चसा संविदाना ॥
verses.rom:
rathe aksheshvrishabhasya vaje vate parjanye varunasya shushme |
indram ya devi subhaga jajana sa na aitu varchasa samvidana ||
verses.en: In chariot, in dice, in the bull's strength (vā́ja), in wind, in rain-god, in Varuṇa's vehemence (çúṣma): the fortunate goddess etc. etc.

verses.sa:
राजन्ये दुन्दुभावायतायामश्वस्य वाजे पुरुषस्य मायौ ।
इन्द्रं या देवी सुभगा जजान सा न ऐतु वर्चसा संविदाना ॥
verses.rom:
rajanye dundubhavayatayamashvasya vaje purushasya mayau |
indram ya devi subhaga jajana sa na aitu varchasa samvidana ||
verses.en: In a noble (rājanyà), in the drum, in the drawn [arrow], in the horse's vigor, in man's roar (?): the fortunate goddess etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यशो हविर्वर्धतामिन्द्रजूतं सहस्रवीर्यं सुभृतं सहस्कृतम् ।
प्रसर्स्राणमनु दीर्घाय चक्षसे हविष्मन्तं मा वर्धय ज्येष्ठतातये ॥
verses.rom:
yasho havirvardhatamindrajutam sahasraviryam subhritam sahaskritam |
prasarsranamanu dirghaya chakshase havishmantam ma vardhaya jyeshthatataye ||
verses.en: [As] glory (yáças) let [my] oblation increase, quickened by Indra, of thousand-fold might, well-brought, made with power; me, proceeding mightily onward unto long sight, [me] with my oblation, do thou increase unto chiefhood.

verses.sa:
अछा न इन्द्रं यशसं यशोभिर्यशस्विनं नमसाना विधेम ।
स नो रास्व राष्ट्रमिन्द्रजूतं तस्य ते रातौ यशसः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
achha na indram yashasam yashobhiryashasvinam namasana vidhema |
sa no rasva rashtramindrajutam tasya te ratau yashasah syama ||
verses.en: Unto our glorious Indra, rich in glory, would we, rendering homage, with glories pay worship; do thou bestow on us royalty quickened by Indra; in thy bestowal here may we be glorious.

verses.sa:
यशा इन्द्रो यशा अग्निर्यशाः सोमो अजायत ।
यशा विश्वस्य भूतस्य अहमस्मि यशस्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
yasha indro yasha agniryashah somo ajayata |
yasha vishvasya bhutasya ahamasmi yashastamah ||
verses.en: Glorious was Indra, glorious was Agni, glorious was Soma born; glorious, of all existence am I most glorious.

verses.sa:
अभयं द्यावापृथिवी इहास्तु नोऽभयं सोमः सविता नः कृणोतु ।
अभयं नोऽस्तूर्वन्तरिक्षं सप्तऋषीणां च हविषाभयं नो अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
abhayam dyavaprithivi ihastu no'bhayam somah savita nah krinotu |
abhayam no'sturvantariksham saptarishinam cha havishabhayam no astu ||
verses.en: Let fearlessness, O heaven-and-earth, be here for us; let Soma, Savitar, make us fearlessness; be the wide atmosphere fearlessness for us; and by the oblation of the seven seers be there fearlessness for us.

verses.sa:
अस्मै ग्रामाय प्रदिशश्चतस्र ऊर्जं सुभूतं स्वस्ति सविता नः कृणोतु ।
अशत्र्विन्द्रो अभयं नः कृणोत्वन्यत्र राज्ञामभि यातु मन्युः ॥
verses.rom:
asmai gramaya pradishashchatasra urjam subhutam svasti savita nah krinotu |
ashatrvindro abhayam nah krinotvanyatra rajnamabhi yatu manyuh ||
verses.en: For this village [let] the four directions—let Savitar make for us sustenance, well-being, welfare; let Indra make for us freedom from foes, fearlessness; let the fury of kings fall on (abhi-yā) elsewhere.

verses.sa:
अनमित्रं नो अधरादनमित्रं न उत्तरात्।
इन्द्रानमित्रं नः पश्चादनमित्रं पुरस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
anamitram no adharadanamitram na uttarat|
indranamitram nah pashchadanamitram puraskridhi ||
verses.en: Freedom from enemies for us below, freedom from enemies for us above; O Indra, make freedom from enemies for us behind, freedom from enemies in front.

verses.sa:
मनसे चेतसे धिय आकूतय उत चित्तये ।
मत्यै श्रुताय चक्षसे विधेम हविषा वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
manase chetase dhiya akutaya uta chittaye |
matyai shrutaya chakshase vidhema havisha vayam ||
verses.en: To mind, to thought, to device (dhī́), to design, and to intention, to opinion (matí), to instruction (çrutá), to sight, would we pay worship with oblation.

verses.sa:
अपानाय व्यानाय प्राणाय भूरिधायसे ।
सरस्वत्या उरुव्यचे विधेम हविषा वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
apanaya vyanaya pranaya bhuridhayase |
sarasvatya uruvyache vidhema havisha vayam ||
verses.en: To expiration, to perspiration (vyāná), to breath the much nourishing, to Sarasvatī the wide extending, would we pay worship with oblation.

verses.sa:
मा नो हासिषुर्ऋषयो दैव्या ये तनूपा ये नस्तन्वस्तनूजाः ।
अमर्त्या मर्त्यामभि नः सचध्वमायुर्धत्त प्रतरं जीवसे नः ॥
verses.rom:
ma no hasishurrishayo daivya ye tanupa ye nastanvastanujah |
amartya martyamabhi nah sachadhvamayurdhatta prataram jivase nah ||
verses.en: Let not the seers who are of the gods leave us, who are self (tanū́) protecting, self-born of our self; O immortal ones, attach yourselves to us mortals; grant life-time (ā́yus) in order to our further living.

verses.sa:
अव ज्यामिव धन्वनो मन्युं तनोमि ते हृदः ।
यथा संमनसौ भूत्वा सखायाविव सचावहै ॥
verses.rom:
ava jyamiva dhanvano manyum tanomi te hridah |
yatha sammanasau bhutva sakhayaviva sachavahai ||
verses.en: As the string from the bow, do I relax (ava-tan) fury from thy heart, that, becoming like-minded, we (two) may hold together (sac) like friends.

verses.sa:
सखायाविव सचावहा अव मन्युं तनोमि ते ।
अधस्ते अश्मनो मन्युमुपास्यामसि यो गुरुः ॥
verses.rom:
sakhayaviva sachavaha ava manyum tanomi te |
adhaste ashmano manyumupasyamasi yo guruh ||
verses.en: We (two) will hold together like friends; I relax thy fury; we cast in thy fury under a stone that is heavy.

verses.sa:
अभि तिष्ठामि ते मन्युं पार्ष्ण्या प्रपदेन च ।
यथावशो न वादिषो मम चित्तमुपायसि ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tishthami te manyum parshnya prapadena cha |
yathavasho na vadisho mama chittamupayasi ||
verses.en: I trample upon (abhi-sthā) thy fury, with heel and with front foot, that thou mayest speak not uncontrolled, mayest come unto my intent.

verses.sa:
अयं दर्भो विमन्युकः स्वाय चारणाय च ।
मन्योर्विमन्युकस्यायं मन्युशमन उच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
ayam darbho vimanyukah svaya charanaya cha |
manyorvimanyukasyayam manyushamana uchyate ||
verses.en: This darbhá [is] fury-removing, both for one's own man and for a stranger; and this is called a fury-removing fury-appeaser of fury.

verses.sa:
अयं यो भूरिमूलः समुद्रमवतिष्ठति ।
दर्भः पृथिव्या उत्थितो मन्युशमन उच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
ayam yo bhurimulah samudramavatishthati |
darbhah prithivya utthito manyushamana uchyate ||
verses.en: This that is many-rooted, [that] reaches down (ava-sthā) to the sea, the darbhá, arisen out of the earth, is called a fury-appeaser.

verses.sa:
वि ते हनव्यां शरणिं वि ते मुख्यां नयामसि ।
यथावशो न वादिषो मम चित्तमुपायसि ॥
verses.rom:
vi te hanavyam sharanim vi te mukhyam nayamasi |
yathavasho na vadisho mama chittamupayasi ||
verses.en: We conduct away the offense (? çaráṇi) of thy jaws, away that of thy mouth, that thou mayest not speak uncontrolled, mayest come unto my intent.

verses.sa:
अस्थाद्द्यौरस्थात्पृथिव्यस्थाद्विश्वमिदं जगत्।
अस्थुर्वृक्षा ऊर्ध्वस्वप्नास्तिष्ठाद्रोगो अयं तव ॥
verses.rom:
asthaddyaurasthatprithivyasthadvishvamidam jagat|
asthurvriksha urdhvasvapnastishthadrogo ayam tava ||
verses.en: The heaven hath stood; the earth hath stood; all this living world hath stood; the trees have stood, sleeping erect; may this disease of thine stand.

verses.sa:
शतं या भेषजानि ते सहस्रं संगतानि च ।
श्रेष्ठमास्रावभेषजं वसिष्ठं रोगनाशनम् ॥
verses.rom:
shatam ya bheshajani te sahasram samgatani cha |
shreshthamasravabheshajam vasishtham roganashanam ||
verses.en: What hundred remedies are thine, and [what] thousand, assembled—[with them thou art] the most excellent remedy for flux, the best effacer of disease.

verses.sa:
रुद्रस्य मूत्रमस्यमृतस्य नाभिः ।
विषाणका नाम वा असि पितॄणां मूलादुत्थिता वातीकृतनाशनी ॥
verses.rom:
rudrasya mutramasyamritasya nabhih |
vishanaka nama va asi pitrinam muladutthita vatikritanashani ||
verses.en: Rudra's urine art thou, the navel of the immortal (amṛ́ta); viṣāṇakā́ ('horny') by name art thou, arisen from the root of the Fathers, an effacer of the vātī́kṛta.

verses.sa:
परोऽपेहि मनस्पाप किमशस्तानि शंससि ।
परेहि न त्वा कामये वृक्षां वनानि सं चर गृहेषु गोषु मे मनः ॥
verses.rom:
paro'pehi manaspapa kimashastani shamsasi |
parehi na tva kamaye vriksham vanani sam chara griheshu goshu me manah ||
verses.en: Go far away, O mind-evil! why utterest (çaṅs) thou things unuttered? Go away; I desire thee not; do thou frequent (sam-cara) trees, woods; in houses, in kine [is] my mind.

verses.sa:
अवशसा निःशसा यत्पराशसोपारिम जाग्रतो यत्स्वपन्तः ।
अग्निर्विश्वान्यप दुष्कृतान्यजुष्टान्यारे अस्मद्दधातु ॥
verses.rom:
avashasa nihshasa yatparashasoparima jagrato yatsvapantah |
agnirvishvanyapa dushkritanyajushtanyare asmaddadhatu ||
verses.en: If (yát) by down-utterance, out-utterance, forth-utterance we have offended (upa-ṛ), waking or (yát) sleeping, let Agni put far away from us all disagreeable ill-deeds.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र ब्रह्मणस्पतेऽपि मृषा चरामसि ।
प्रचेता न आङ्गिरसो दुरितात्पात्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra brahmanaspate'pi mrisha charamasi |
pracheta na angiraso duritatpatvamhasah ||
verses.en: If (yát), O Indra, O Brahmaṇaspati, we also proceed falsely, let the Ān̄girasa, forethoughtful, protect us from difficulty, from distress.

verses.sa:
यो न जीवोऽसि न मृतो देवानाममृतगर्भोऽसि स्वप्न ।
वरुणानी ते माता यमः पिताररुर्नामासि ॥
verses.rom:
yo na jivo'si na mrito devanamamritagarbho'si svapna |
varunani te mata yamah pitararurnamasi ||
verses.en: Thou who art not alive, not dead, immortal-embryo of the gods art thou, O sleep; Varuṇāni is thy mother, Yama thy father; Araru by name art thou.

verses.sa:
विद्म ते स्वप्न जनित्रं देवजामीनां पुत्रोऽसि यमस्य करणः ।
अन्तकोऽसि मृत्युरसि तं त्वा स्वप्न तथा सं विद्म स नः स्वप्न दुष्वप्न्यात्पाहि ॥
verses.rom:
vidma te svapna janitram devajaminam putro'si yamasya karanah |
antako'si mrityurasi tam tva svapna tatha sam vidma sa nah svapna dushvapnyatpahi ||
verses.en: We know thy place of birth (janítra), O sleep; thou art son of the gods' sisters (-jāmí), agent of Yama; end-maker art thou; death art

verses.sa:
यथा कलां यथा शफं यथर्णं संनयन्ति ।
एवा दुष्वप्न्यं सर्वं द्विषते सं नयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yatha kalam yatha shapham yatharnam samnayanti |
eva dushvapnyam sarvam dvishate sam nayamasi ||
verses.en: As a sixteenth, as an eighth, as a [whole] debt they bring together, so do we bring together all evil-dreaming for him who hates us.

verses.sa:
अग्निः प्रातःसवने पात्वस्मान् वैश्वानरो विश्वकृद्विश्वशंभूः ।
स नः पावको द्रविणे दधात्वायुष्मन्तः सहभक्षाः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
agnih pratahsavane patvasman vaishvanaro vishvakridvishvashambhuh |
sa nah pavako dravine dadhatvayushmantah sahabhakshah syama ||
verses.en: Let Agni at the morning libation (sávana) protect us, he that belongs to all men (vāiçvānará), all-maker, all-wealful; let him, the purifier, set us in property (dráviṇa); may we be long-lived, provided with draughts.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवा मरुत इन्द्रो अस्मान् अस्मिन् द्वितीये सवने न जह्युः ।
आयुष्मन्तः प्रियमेषां वदन्तो वयं देवानां सुमतौ स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
vishve deva maruta indro asman asmin dvitiye savane na jahyuh |
ayushmantah priyamesham vadanto vayam devanam sumatau syama ||
verses.en: May all the gods, the Maruts, Indra, not leave us at this second libation; long-lived, speaking what is dear to them, may we be in the favor of the gods.

verses.sa:
इदं तृतीयं सवनं कवीनामृतेन ये चमसमैरयन्त ।
ते सौधन्वनाः स्वरानशानाः स्विष्टिं नो अभि वस्यो नयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
idam tritiyam savanam kavinamritena ye chamasamairayanta |
te saudhanvanah svaranashanah svishtim no abhi vasyo nayantu ||
verses.en: This third libation [is] of the poets (kaví), who rightfully (ṛténa) sent out the bowl; let those Sāudhanvanas, who have attained heaven, conduct our happy-offering unto what is better.

verses.sa:
श्येनोऽसि गायत्रच्छन्दा अनु त्वा रभे ।
स्वस्ति मा सं वहास्य यज्ञस्योदृचि स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
shyeno'si gayatrachchhanda anu tva rabhe |
svasti ma sam vahasya yajnasyodrichi svaha ||
verses.en: A falcon art thou, with gāyatrá for meter; I take hold after thee; carry me along to welfare at the close (udṛ́c) of this offering: hail!

verses.sa:
ऋभुरसि जगच्छन्दा अनु त्वा रभे ।
स्वस्ति मा सं वहास्य यज्ञस्योदृचि स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
ribhurasi jagachchhanda anu tva rabhe |
svasti ma sam vahasya yajnasyodrichi svaha ||
verses.en: A Ribhu art thou, with jágat for meter; I take hold etc. etc.

verses.sa:
वृषासि त्रिष्टुप्छन्दा अनु त्वा रभे ।
स्वस्ति मा सं वहास्य यज्ञस्योदृचि स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
vrishasi trishtupchhanda anu tva rabhe |
svasti ma sam vahasya yajnasyodrichi svaha ||
verses.en: A bull art thou, with triṣṭúbh for meter; I take hold etc. etc.

verses.sa:
नहि ते अग्ने तन्वः क्रूरमानंश मर्त्यः ।
कपिर्बभस्ति तेजनं स्वं जरायु गौरिव ॥
verses.rom:
nahi te agne tanvah kruramanamsha martyah |
kapirbabhasti tejanam svam jarayu gauriva ||
verses.en: Surely no mortal, O Agni, hath attained the cruelty of thy self (tanū́). The ape gnaws (bhas) the shaft (téjana), as a cow her own after-birth.

verses.sa:
मेष इव वै सं च वि चोर्वच्यसे यदुत्तरद्रावुपरश्च खादतः ।
शीर्ष्णा शिरोऽप्ससाप्सो अर्दयन्न् अंशून् बभस्ति हरितेभिरासभिः ॥
verses.rom:
mesha iva vai sam cha vi chorvachyase yaduttaradravuparashcha khadatah |
shirshna shiro'psasapso ardayann amshun babhasti haritebhirasabhih ||
verses.en: Like a ram, thou art bent both together and wide apart, when in the upper wood [the upper] and the lower stone devour; exciting (ard) head with head, breast (ápsas) with breast, he gnaws the soma-stalks (aṅçu) with green mouths.

verses.sa:
सुपर्णा वाचमक्रतोप द्यव्याखरे कृष्णा इषिरा अनर्तिषुः ।
नि यन् नियन्ति उपरस्य निष्कृतिं पुरू रेतो दधिरे सूर्यश्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
suparna vachamakratopa dyavyakhare krishna ishira anartishuh |
ni yan niyanti uparasya nishkritim puru reto dadhire suryashritah ||
verses.en: The eagles have uttered (kṛ) their voice close in the sky; in the lair (ākhará) the black lively ones have danced; when they come down to the removal of the lower [stone], they have assumed much seed, they that resort to the sun.

verses.sa:
हतं तर्दं समङ्कमाखुमश्विना छिन्तं शिरो अपि पृष्टीः शृणीतम् ।
यवान् नेददान् अपि नह्यतं मुखमथाभयं कृणुतं धान्याय ॥
verses.rom:
hatam tardam samankamakhumashvina chhintam shiro api prishtih shrinitam |
yavan nedadan api nahyatam mukhamathabhayam krinutam dhanyaya ||
verses.en: Smite, O Açvins, the borer, the samān̄ká, the rat; split their head; crush in their ribs; lest they eat the barley, shut up their mouth; then make fearlessness for the grain.

verses.sa:
तर्द है पतङ्ग है जभ्य हा उपक्वस ।
ब्रह्मेवासंस्थितं हविरनदन्त इमान् यवान् अहिंसन्तो अपोदित ॥
verses.rom:
tarda hai patanga hai jabhya ha upakvasa |
brahmevasamsthitam haviranadanta iman yavan ahimsanto apodita ||
verses.en: Hey, borer! hey, locust! hey, grinder, upakvasa! as a priest (brahman) an unfinished oblation, not eating this barley, go up away, doing no harm.

verses.sa:
तर्दापते वघापते तृष्टजम्भा आ शृणोत मे ।
य आरण्या व्यद्वरा ये के च स्थ व्यद्वरास्तान्त्सर्वान् जम्भयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
tardapate vaghapate trishtajambha a shrinota me |
ya aranya vyadvara ye ke cha stha vyadvarastantsarvan jambhayamasi ||
verses.en: O lord of borers, lord of vághā's! with arid jaws do ye (pl.) listen to me: what devourers (vyadvará) there are of the forest, and whatever devourers ye are, all them do we grind up.

verses.sa:
वायोः पूतः पवित्रेण प्रत्यङ्सोमो अति द्रुतः ।
इन्द्रस्य युजः सखा ॥
verses.rom:
vayoh putah pavitrena pratyansomo ati drutah |
indrasya yujah sakha ||
verses.en: Purified with Vāyu's purifier, Soma [hath] run over opposite (pratyán̄), Indra's suitable companion.

verses.sa:
आपो अस्मान् मातरः सूदयन्तु घृतेन नो घृतप्वः पुनन्तु ।
विश्वं हि रिप्रं प्रवहन्ति देवीरुदिदाभ्यः शुचिरा पूत एमि ॥
verses.rom:
apo asman matarah sudayantu ghritena no ghritapvah punantu |
vishvam hi ripram pravahanti devirudidabhyah shuchira puta emi ||
verses.en: Let the mother waters further (sūd) us; let the ghee-purifying ones purify us with ghee; since the heavenly ones carry forth all evil (riprá), forth from them, indeed, I come clean, purified.

verses.sa:
यत्किं चेदं वरुण दैव्ये जनेऽभिद्रोहं मनुष्याश्चरन्ति ।
अचित्त्या चेत्तव धर्म युयोपिम मा नस्तस्मादेनसो देव रीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
yatkim chedam varuna daivye jane'bhidroham manushyashcharanti |
achittya chettava dharma yuyopima ma nastasmadenaso deva ririshah ||
verses.en: Whatever, O Varuṇa, that is hateful to the people of the gods human beings practise here, if without intention we have obstructed thine ordinances (dhármān), do not, O god, harm us for that sin.

verses.sa:
उत्सूर्यो दिव एति पुरो रक्षांसि निजूर्वन् ।
आदित्यः पर्वतेभ्यो विश्वदृष्टो अदृष्टहा ॥
verses.rom:
utsuryo diva eti puro rakshamsi nijurvan |
adityah parvatebhyo vishvadrishto adrishtaha ||
verses.en: The sun goes up from the sky, burning down in front the demons; he, the Āditya, from the mountains, seen of all, slayer of the unseen.

verses.sa:
नि गावो गोष्ठे असदन् नि मृगासो अविक्षत ।
न्यूर्मयो नदीनां न्यदृष्टा अलिप्सत ॥
verses.rom:
ni gavo goshthe asadan ni mrigaso avikshata |
nyurmayo nadinam nyadrishta alipsata ||
verses.en: The kine have sat down in the stall; the wild beasts have gone to rest (ni-viç); the waves of the streams, the unseen ones, have disappeared (ni-lip).

verses.sa:
आयुर्ददं विपश्चितं श्रुतां कण्वस्य वीरुधम् ।
आभारिषं विश्वभेषजीमस्यादृष्टान् नि शमयत् ॥
verses.rom:
ayurdadam vipashchitam shrutam kanvasya virudham |
abharisham vishvabheshajimasyadrishtan ni shamayat ||
verses.en: The life (ā́yus)-giving, inspired (vipaçcít), famous plant of Kaṇva, the all-healing one, have I brought; may it quench this man's unseen ones.

verses.sa:
द्यौश्च म इदं पृथिवी च प्रचेतसौ शुक्रो बृहन् दक्षिणया पिपर्तु ।
अनु स्वधा चिकितां सोमो अग्निर्वायुर्नः पातु सविता भगश्च ॥
verses.rom:
dyaushcha ma idam prithivi cha prachetasau shukro brihan dakshinaya pipartu |
anu svadha chikitam somo agnirvayurnah patu savita bhagashcha ||
verses.en: Let both the sky now and the earth, forethoughtful—let the bright (çukrá) great one, by the sacrificial gift, rescue (pṛ) me; let the svadhā́ favor (anu-ci) [me, let] Soma, Agni; let Vāyu protect us, [let] Savitar and Bhaga.

verses.sa:
पुनः प्राणः पुनरात्मा न ऐतु पुनश्चक्षुः पुनरसुर्न ऐतु ।
वैश्वानरो नो अदब्धस्तनूपा अन्तस्तिष्ठाति दुरितानि विश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
punah pranah punaratma na aitu punashchakshuh punarasurna aitu |
vaishvanaro no adabdhastanupa antastishthati duritani vishva ||
verses.en: Again let breath, again let soul (ātmán) come unto us; again let sight, again let spirit (ásu) come unto us; let Vāiçvānara, our unharmed body-protector, stand between [us and] all difficulties.

verses.sa:
सं वर्चसा पयसा सं तनूभिरगन्महि मनसा सं शिवेन ।
त्वष्टा नो अत्र वरीयः कृणोत्वनु नो मार्ष्टु तन्वो यद्विरिष्टम् ॥
verses.rom:
sam varchasa payasa sam tanubhiraganmahi manasa sam shivena |
tvashta no atra variyah krinotvanu no marshtu tanvo yadvirishtam ||
verses.en: We have become united with splendor, with fatness (páyas), with bodies (tanū́), with propitious mind; let Tvashṭar make for us here wider room; let him smooth down what of our body is torn apart.

verses.sa:
इदं तद्युज उत्तरमिन्द्रं शुम्भाम्यष्टये ।
अस्य क्षत्रं श्रियं महीं वृष्टिरिव वर्धया तृणम् ॥
verses.rom:
idam tadyuja uttaramindram shumbhamyashtaye |
asya kshatram shriyam mahim vrishtiriva vardhaya trinam ||
verses.en: Now do I adorn this man as superior to his fellow, for attainment of Indra; do thou increase his authority, his great fortune, as the rain the grass.

verses.sa:
अस्मै क्षत्रमग्नीषोमावस्मै धारयतं रयिम् ।
इमं राष्ट्रस्याभीवर्गे कृणुतं युज उत्तरम् ॥
verses.rom:
asmai kshatramagnishomavasmai dharayatam rayim |
imam rashtrasyabhivarge krinutam yuja uttaram ||
verses.en: For him, O Agni-and-Soma, maintain ye dominion, for him wealth; in the sphere of royalty make ye him superior to his fellow.

verses.sa:
सबन्धुश्चासबन्धुश्च यो अस्माँ अभिदासति ।
सर्वं तं रन्धयासि मे यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
sabandhushchasabandhushcha yo asman abhidasati |
sarvam tam randhayasi me yajamanaya sunvate ||
verses.en: Whoever, both related and unrelated, assails us—every such one mayest thou make subject to me, the sacrificer, the soma-presser.

verses.sa:
ये पन्थानो बहवो देवयाना अन्तरा द्यावापृथिवी संचरन्ति ।
तेषामज्यानिं यतमो वहाति तस्मै मा देवाः परि दत्तेह सर्वे ॥
verses.rom:
ye panthano bahavo devayana antara dyavaprithivi samcharanti |
teshamajyanim yatamo vahati tasmai ma devah pari datteha sarve ||
verses.en: The many paths, traveled by the gods, that go between heaven-and-earth—whichever of them shall carry [one] to unscathedness, to that one, O gods, do ye all here give me over.

verses.sa:
ग्रीष्मो हेमन्तः शिशिरो वसन्तः शरद्वर्षाः स्विते नो दधात ।
आ नो गोषु भजता प्रजायां निवात इद्वः शरणे स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
grishmo hemantah shishiro vasantah sharadvarshah svite no dadhata |
a no goshu bhajata prajayam nivata idvah sharane syama ||
verses.en: Hot season, winter, cool season, spring, autumn, rains—do ye set us in welfare (svitá); portion ye us in kine, in progeny; may we verily be in your windless shelter.

verses.sa:
इदावत्सराय परिवत्सराय संवत्सराय कृणुता बृहन् नमः ।
तेषां वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियानामपि भद्रे सौ मनसे स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
idavatsaraya parivatsaraya samvatsaraya krinuta brihan namah |
tesham vayam sumatau yajniyanamapi bhadre sau manase syama ||
verses.en: Unto the idā-year, the pari-year, the sam-year, pay ye great homage; may we be in the favor of these worshipful ones, likewise in their auspicious well-willing.

verses.sa:
मा नो देवा अहिर्वधीत्सतोकान्त्सहपूरुषान् ।
संयतं न वि ष्परद्व्यात्तं न सं यमन् नमो देवजनेभ्यः ।
नमोऽस्त्वसिताय नमस्तिरश्चिराजये ।
स्वजाय बभ्रवे नमो नमो देवजनेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
ma no deva ahirvadhitsatokantsahapurushan |
samyatam na vi shparadvyattam na sam yaman namo devajanebhyah |
namo'stvasitaya namastirashchirajaye |
svajaya babhrave namo namo devajanebhyah ||

verses.sa:
सं ते हन्मि दता दतः समु ते हन्वा हनू ।
सं ते जिह्वया जिह्वां सं वास्नाह आस्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
sam te hanmi data datah samu te hanva hanu |
sam te jihvaya jihvam sam vasnaha asyam ||

prose.en:
1. Let not the snake, O gods, slay us with our offspring, with our men (púruṣa); what is shut together may it not unclose; what is open may it not shut together: homage to the god-people.

2. Homage be to the black [snake], homage to the cross-lined, homage to the brown constrictor; homage to the god-people.

3. I smite thy teeth together with tooth, thy (two) jaws together with jaw, thy tongue together with tongue, thy mouth, O snake, together with mouth.

verses.sa:
इदमिद्वा उ भेषजमिदं रुद्रस्य भेषजम् ।
येनेषुमेकतेजनां शतशल्यामपब्रवत् ॥
verses.rom:
idamidva u bheshajamidam rudrasya bheshajam |
yeneshumekatejanam shatashalyamapabravat ||
verses.en: This verily is a remedy; this is Rudra's remedy; wherewith one may spell away (apa-brū) the one-shafted (-téjana), hundred-tipped arrow.

verses.sa:
जालाषेणाभि षिञ्चत जालाषेणोप सिञ्चत ।
जालाषमुग्रं भेषजं तेन नो मृड जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
jalashenabhi shinchata jalashenopa sinchata |
jalashamugram bheshajam tena no mrida jivase ||
verses.en: Pour ye on with the jālāṣá; pour in with the jālāṣá; the jālāṣá is a formidable remedy; with it do thou be gracious to us, unto life (jīvás).

verses.sa:
शं च नो मयश्च नो मा च नः किं चनाममत्।
क्षमा रपो विश्वं नो अस्तु भेषजं सर्वं नो अस्तु भेषजम् ॥
verses.rom:
sham cha no mayashcha no ma cha nah kim chanamamat|
kshama rapo vishvam no astu bheshajam sarvam no astu bheshajam ||
verses.en: [Be there] both weal for us and kindness (máyas) for us, and let nothing whatever ail (am) us; down with [our] complaint (rápas)! be every remedy ours; be all remedy ours.

verses.sa:
यशसं मेन्द्रो मघवान् कृणोतु यशसं द्यावापृथिवी उभे इमे ।
यशसं मा देवः सविता कृणोतु प्रियो दातुर्दक्षिणाया इह स्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
yashasam mendro maghavan krinotu yashasam dyavaprithivi ubhe ime |
yashasam ma devah savita krinotu priyo daturdakshinaya iha syam ||
verses.en: Glorious let the bounteous Indra make me; glorious both heaven-and-earth here; glorious let god Savitar make me; may I be dear here to the giver of the sacrificial gift.

verses.sa:
यथेन्द्रो द्यावापृथिव्योर्यशस्वान् यथाप ओषधीषु यशस्वतीः ।
एवा विश्वेषु देवेषु वयं सर्वेषु यशसः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
yathendro dyavaprithivyoryashasvan yathapa oshadhishu yashasvatih |
eva vishveshu deveshu vayam sarveshu yashasah syama ||
verses.en: As Indra is possessed of glory in heaven-and-earth, as the waters are possessed of glory in the herbs, so among all the gods may we, among all, be glorious.

verses.sa:
यशा इन्द्रो यशा अग्निर्यशाः सोमो अजायत ।
यशा विश्वस्य भूतस्याहमस्मि यशस्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
yasha indro yasha agniryashah somo ajayata |
yasha vishvasya bhutasyahamasmi yashastamah ||
verses.en: Glorious was Indra, glorious was Agni, glorious was Soma born; glorious, of all existence am I most glorious.

verses.sa:
अनडुद्भ्यस्त्वं प्रथमं धेनुभ्यस्त्वमरुन्धति ।
अधेनवे वयसे शर्म यच्छ चतुष्पदे ॥
verses.rom:
anadudbhyastvam prathamam dhenubhyastvamarundhati |
adhenave vayase sharma yachchha chatushpade ||
verses.en: To the draft-oxen do thou first, to the milch kine do thou, O arundhatī́, to the non-milch cow, in order to vigor (váyas), to four-footed creatures do thou yield protection.

verses.sa:
शर्म यच्छत्वोषधिः सह देवीररुन्धती ।
करत्पयस्वन्तं गोष्ठमयक्ष्मामुत पूरुषान् ॥
verses.rom:
sharma yachchhatvoshadhih saha devirarundhati |
karatpayasvantam goshthamayakshmamuta purushan ||
verses.en: Let the herb, the arundhatī́, allied with the gods (?), yield protection; may it make the cow-stall rich in milk, and the men (púruṣa) free from disease (yákṣma).

verses.sa:
विश्वरूपां सुभगामच्छावदामि जीवलाम् ।
सा नो रुद्रस्यास्तां हेतिं दूरं नयतु गोभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvarupam subhagamachchhavadami jivalam |
sa no rudrasyastam hetim duram nayatu gobhyah ||
verses.en: I appeal to the all-formed, well-portioned, vivifying one; let it conduct the hurled missile of Rudra far away from our kine.

verses.sa:
अयमा यात्यर्यमा पुरस्ताद्विषितस्तुपः ।
अस्या इच्छन्न् अग्रुवै पतिमुत जायामजानये ॥
verses.rom:
ayama yatyaryama purastadvishitastupah |
asya ichchhann agruvai patimuta jayamajanaye ||
verses.en: Here cometh Aryaman, with locks -stupá loosened in front, seeking a husband for this spinster, and a wife for a wifeless one.

verses.sa:
अश्रमदियमर्यमन्न् अन्यासां समनं यती ।
अङ्गो न्वर्यमन्न् अस्या अन्याः समनमायति ॥
verses.rom:
ashramadiyamaryamann anyasam samanam yati |
ango nvaryamann asya anyah samanamayati ||
verses.en: This woman, O Aryaman, hath toiled, going to other women's assembly; now, O Aryaman, shall another woman come to her assembly.

verses.sa:
धाता दाधार पृथिवीं धाता द्यामुत सूर्यम् ।
धातास्या अग्रुवै पतिं दधातु प्रतिकाम्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhata dadhara prithivim dhata dyamuta suryam |
dhatasya agruvai patim dadhatu pratikamyam ||
verses.en: The creator (dhātár) sustains the earth; the creator [sustains] the sky and the sun; let the creator assign (dhā) to this spinster a husband that is according to her wish.

verses.sa:
मह्यमापो मधुमदेरयन्तां मह्यं सूरो अभरज्ज्योतिषे कम् ।
मह्यं देवा उत विश्वे तपोजा मह्यं देवः सविता व्यचो धात् ॥
verses.rom:
mahyamapo madhumaderayantam mahyam suro abharajjyotishe kam |
mahyam deva uta vishve tapoja mahyam devah savita vyacho dhat ||
verses.en: To me let the waters send what has sweetness; to me the sun brought [it] in order to light; to me the gods, and all those born of penance—to me let god Savitar assign expansion vyácas.

verses.sa:
अहं विवेच पृथिवीमुत द्यामहमृतूंरजनयं सप्त साकम् ।
अहं सत्यमनृतं यद्वदाम्यहं दैवीं परि वाचं विशश्च ॥
verses.rom:
aham vivecha prithivimuta dyamahamritumrajanayam sapta sakam |
aham satyamanritam yadvadamyaham daivim pari vacham vishashcha ||
verses.en: I expanded (?) earth and heaven, I generated the seasons, seven together; I speak true what is untrue; I encompass (pári) divine speech and people (víças).

verses.sa:
अहं जजान पृथिवीमुत द्यामहमृतूंरजनयं सप्त सिन्धून् ।
अहं सत्वमनृतं यद्वदामि यो अग्नीषोमावजुषे सखाया ॥
verses.rom:
aham jajana prithivimuta dyamahamritumrajanayam sapta sindhun |
aham satvamanritam yadvadami yo agnishomavajushe sakhaya ||
verses.en: I generated earth and heaven; I generated the seasons, the seven rivers; I speak true what is untrue (?): [I] who enjoyed Agni-and-Soma as companions.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरो रश्मिभिर्नः पुनातु वातः प्राणेनेषिरो नभोभिः ।
द्यावापृथिवी पयसा पयस्वती ऋतावरी यज्ञिये न पुनीताम् ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanaro rashmibhirnah punatu vatah praneneshiro nabhobhih |
dyavaprithivi payasa payasvati ritavari yajniye na punitam ||
verses.en: Let Vāiçvānara (Agni) by his rays purify us, the wind, lively with mists (? nábhas), by his breath; let heaven-and-earth, rich in milk, righteous, worshipful, purify us by milk.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरीं सूनृतामा रभध्वं यस्या आशास्तन्वो वीतपृष्ठाः ।
तया गृणन्तः सधमादेषु वयं स्याम पतयो रयीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanarim sunritama rabhadhvam yasya ashastanvo vitaprishthah |
taya grinantah sadhamadeshu vayam syama patayo rayinam ||
verses.en: Take ye hold upon the pleasantness of Vāiçvānara, of which the regions are the smooth-backed bodies; with that, singing in joint revelings, may we be lords of wealth (pl.).

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरीं वर्चस आ रभध्वं शुद्धा भवन्तः शुचयः पावकाः ।
इहेडया सधमादं मदन्तो ज्योक्पश्येम सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanarim varchasa a rabhadhvam shuddha bhavantah shuchayah pavakah |
ihedaya sadhamadam madanto jyokpashyema suryamuchcharantam ||
verses.en: Take ye hold upon that (f.) of Vāiçvānara in order to splendor, becoming cleansed, clear, purifying; here, reveling in joint reveling with Iḍā, may we long see the sun going up.

verses.sa:
यत्ते देवी निर्ऋतिराबबन्ध दाम ग्रीवास्वविमोक्यं यत्।
तत्ते वि ष्याम्यायुषे वर्चसे बलायादोमदमन्नमद्धि प्रसूतः ॥
verses.rom:
yatte devi nirritirababandha dama grivasvavimokyam yat|
tatte vi shyamyayushe varchase balayadomadamannamaddhi prasutah ||
verses.en: The tie that the divine Nirṛti (perdition) bound upon thy neck, [and] that was unreleasable, that do I untie for thee, in order to long life (ā́yus), splendor, strength; do thou, quickened (pra-su), eat uninjurious (?) food.

verses.sa:
नमोऽस्तु ते निर्ऋते तिग्मतेजोऽयस्मयान् वि चृता बन्धपाशान् ।
यमो मह्यं पुनरित्त्वां ददाति तस्मै यमाय नमो अस्तु मृत्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
namo'stu te nirrite tigmatejo'yasmayan vi chrita bandhapashan |
yamo mahyam punarittvam dadati tasmai yamaya namo astu mrityave ||
verses.en: Homage be to thee, O Nirṛti, thou of keen keenness; unfasten the bond-fetters of iron. Yama verily giveth thee back to me; to that Yama, to death, be homage.

verses.sa:
अयस्मये द्रुपदे बेधिष इहाभिहितो मृत्युभिर्ये सहस्रम् ।
यमेन त्वं पितृभिः संविदान उत्तमं नाकमधि रोहयेमम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayasmaye drupade bedhisha ihabhihito mrityubhirye sahasram |
yamena tvam pitribhih samvidana uttamam nakamadhi rohayemam ||
verses.en: Thou wast bound here to an iron post (drupadá), bridled with deaths that are a thousand. Do thou, in concord with Yama, with the Fathers, make this man ascend to the highest firmament.

verses.sa:
संसमिद्युवसे वृषन्न् अग्ने विश्वान्यर्य आ ।
इडस्पदे समिध्यसे स नो वसून्या भर ॥
verses.rom:
samsamidyuvase vrishann agne vishvanyarya a |
idaspade samidhyase sa no vasunya bhara ||
verses.en: Thou collectest together for thyself, O Agni, bull, all things from the foe (?); thou art kindled in the track of sacrifice (íḍ); do thou bring to us good things.

verses.sa:
सं जानीध्वं सं पृच्यध्वं सं वो मनांसि जानताम् ।
देवा भागं यथा पूर्वे संजानाना उपासते ॥
verses.rom:
sam janidhvam sam prichyadhvam sam vo manamsi janatam |
deva bhagam yatha purve samjanana upasate ||
verses.en: Do ye concur; be ye closely combined; let your minds be concurrent, as the gods of old sat concurrent about their portion.

verses.sa:
समानो मन्त्रः समितिः समानी समानं व्रतं सह चित्तमेषाम् ।
समानेन वो हविषा जुहोमि समानं चेतो अभिसंविशध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
samano mantrah samitih samani samanam vratam saha chittamesham |
samanena vo havisha juhomi samanam cheto abhisamvishadhvam ||
verses.en: [Be] their counsel (mántra) the same, their gathering the same, their course (vratá) the same, their intent alike (sahá); I offer for you with the same oblation; do ye enter together into the same thought (cétas).

verses.sa:
समानी व आकूतिः समाना हृदयानि वः ।
समानमस्तु वो मनः यथा वः सुसहासति ॥
verses.rom:
samani va akutih samana hridayani vah |
samanamastu vo manah yatha vah susahasati ||
verses.en: Be your design the same, your hearts the same, your mind the same, that it may be well for you together.

verses.sa:
अव मन्युरवायताव बाहू मनोयुजा ।
पराशर त्वं तेषां पराञ्चं शुष्ममर्दयाधा नो रयिमा कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
ava manyuravayatava bahu manoyuja |
parashara tvam tesham parancham shushmamardayadha no rayima kridhi ||
verses.en: Down (áva) [be] the fury, down the drawn [arrow], down the two mind-yoked arms. O demolisher (parāçará), do thou vex (ard) away the vehemence (çúṣma) of them; then get us wealth.

verses.sa:
निर्हस्तेभ्यो नैर्हस्तं यं देवाः शरुमस्यथ ।
वृश्चामि शत्रूणां बाहून् अनेन हविषाऽहम् ॥
verses.rom:
nirhastebhyo nairhastam yam devah sharumasyatha |
vrishchami shatrunam bahun anena havisha'ham ||
verses.en: The handless shaft, O gods, which ye cast at the handless ones—I hew [off] the arms of the foes with this oblation.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रश्चकार प्रथमं नैर्हस्तमसुरेभ्यः ।
जयन्तु सत्वानो मम स्थिरेणेन्द्रेण मेदिना ॥
verses.rom:
indrashchakara prathamam nairhastamasurebhyah |
jayantu satvano mama sthirenendrena medina ||
verses.en: Indra made the handless one first for the Asuras. Let my warriors conquer by means of stanch Indra as ally (medín).

verses.sa:
निर्हस्तः शत्रुरभिदासन्न् अस्तु ये सेनाभिर्युधमायन्त्यस्मान् ।
समर्पयेन्द्र महता वधेन द्रात्वेषामघहारो विविद्धः ॥
verses.rom:
nirhastah shatrurabhidasann astu ye senabhiryudhamayantyasman |
samarpayendra mahata vadhena dratveshamaghaharo vividdhah ||
verses.en: Handless be the assailing foe—they who come with armies to fight us; make them, O Indra, collide with the great weapon; let their evildoer (? aghahārá) run (drā), pierced through.

verses.sa:
आतन्वाना आयच्छन्तोऽस्यन्तो ये च धावथ ।
निर्हस्ताः शत्रवः स्थनेन्द्रो वोऽद्य पराशरीत् ॥
verses.rom:
atanvana ayachchhanto'syanto ye cha dhavatha |
nirhastah shatravah sthanendro vo'dya parasharit ||
verses.en: Ye who run (dhāv) stringing [the bow], drawing [the arrow] (ā-yam), hurling—handless are ye, O foes; Indra hath now demolished you.

verses.sa:
निर्हस्ताः सन्तु शत्रवोऽङ्गैषां म्लापयामसि ।
अथैषामिन्द्र वेदांसि शतशो वि भजामहै ॥
verses.rom:
nirhastah santu shatravo'ngaisham mlapayamasi |
athaishamindra vedamsi shatasho vi bhajamahai ||
verses.en: Handless be the foes; their limbs we make to relax (mlā); then will we, O Indra, share among us their possessions hundred-fold.

verses.sa:
परि वर्त्मानि सर्वत इन्द्रः पूषा च सस्रतुः ।
मुह्यन्त्वद्यामूः सेना अमित्राणां परस्तराम् ॥
verses.rom:
pari vartmani sarvata indrah pusha cha sasratuh |
muhyantvadyamuh sena amitranam parastaram ||
verses.en: Everywhere about the routes Indra and Pūshan have gone; let yonder armies of our enemies today be confounded further away.

verses.sa:
मूढा अमित्राश्चरताशीर्षाण इवाहयः ।
तेषां वो अग्निमूढानामिन्द्रो हन्तु वरंवरम् ॥
verses.rom:
mudha amitrashcharatashirshana ivahayah |
tesham vo agnimudhanamindro hantu varamvaram ||
verses.en: Go about confounded, ye enemies, like headless snakes; of you there, confounded by Agni, let Indra slay each best man (vára).

verses.sa:
ऐषु नह्य वृषाजिनं हरिणस्य भियं कृधि ।
पराङमित्र एषत्वर्वाची गौरुपेषतु ॥
verses.rom:
aishu nahya vrishajinam harinasya bhiyam kridhi |
paranamitra eshatvarvachi gaurupeshatu ||
verses.en: Fasten thou, as bull, the skin upon them; make the fear of the fallow-deer; let the enemy hasten (eṣ) away; let the cow hasten hither to us.

verses.sa:
आयमगन्त्सविता क्षुरेणोष्णेन वाय उदकेनेहि ।
आदित्या रुद्रा वसव उन्दन्तु सचेतसः सोमस्य राज्ञो वपत प्रचेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
ayamagantsavita kshurenoshnena vaya udakenehi |
aditya rudra vasava undantu sachetasah somasya rajno vapata prachetasah ||
verses.en: Savitar here hath come with razor; come, O Vāyu, with hot water; let the Ādityas, the Rudras, the Vasus, wet [him] in accordance; do ye, forethoughtful, shave [the head] of king Soma.

verses.sa:
अदितिः श्मश्रु वपत्वाप उन्दन्तु वर्चसा ।
चिकित्सतु प्रजापतिर्दीर्घायुत्वाय चक्षसे ॥
verses.rom:
aditih shmashru vapatvapa undantu varchasa |
chikitsatu prajapatirdirghayutvaya chakshase ||
verses.en: Let Aditi shave the beard; let the waters wet [it] with splendor; let Prajāpati nurse (cikits) [it], in order to length of life, to sight.

verses.sa:
येनावपत्सविता क्षुरेण सोमस्य राज्ञो वरुणस्य विद्वान् ।
तेन ब्रह्माणो वपतेदमस्य गोमान् अश्ववान् अयमस्तु प्रजावान् ॥
verses.rom:
yenavapatsavita kshurena somasya rajno varunasya vidvan |
tena brahmano vapatedamasya goman ashvavan ayamastu prajavan ||
verses.en: With what razor the knowing Savitar shaved [the head] of king Soma, of Varuṇa, therewith, ye priests (brahmán), shave [it] now of this man; be he rich in kine, in horses, in progeny.

verses.sa:
गिरावरगराटेषु हिरन्ये गोषु यद्यशः ।
सुरायां सिच्यमानायां कीलाले मधु तन् मयि ॥
verses.rom:
giravaragarateshu hiranye goshu yadyashah |
surayam sichyamanayam kilale madhu tan mayi ||
verses.en: What glory [is] in the mountain, in the aragárāṭas, in gold, in kine, in strong-drink when poured out, [what] honey in sweet-drink, [be] that in me.

verses.sa:
अश्विना सारघेण मा मधुनाङ्क्तं शुभस्पती ।
यथा भर्गस्वतीं वाचमावदानि जनामनु ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina saraghena ma madhunanktam shubhaspati |
yatha bhargasvatim vachamavadani janamanu ||
verses.en: O ye Açvins, lords of beauty! anoint me with the honey of bees, that I may speak brilliant words among the people.

verses.sa:
मयि वर्चो अथो यशोऽथो यज्ञस्य यत्पयः ।
तन् मयि प्रजापतिर्दिवि द्यामिव दृंहतु ॥
verses.rom:
mayi varcho atho yasho'tho yajnasya yatpayah |
tan mayi prajapatirdivi dyamiva drimhatu ||
verses.en: In me [be] splendor, also glory, also the fatness (páyas) that belongs to the offering; let Prajāpati fix (dṛṅh) that in me, as the heaven in the sky.

verses.sa:
यथा मांसं यथा सुरा यथाक्षा अधिदेवने ।
यथा पुंसो वृषण्यत स्त्रियां निहन्यते मनः ।
एवा ते अघ्न्ये मनोऽधि वत्से नि हन्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha mamsam yatha sura yathaksha adhidevane |
yatha pumso vrishanyata striyam nihanyate manah |
eva te aghnye mano'dhi vatse ni hanyatam ||
verses.en: As flesh, as strong-drink, as dice on the gambling-board; as of a lustful man the mind is fastened (ni-han) on a woman—-so let thy mind, O inviolable one (aghnyā́), be fastened on thy calf.

verses.sa:
यथा हस्ती हस्तिन्याः पदेन पदमुद्युजे ।
यथा पुंसो वृषण्यत स्त्रियां निहन्यते मनः ।
एवा ते अघ्न्ये मनोऽधि वत्से नि हन्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha hasti hastinyah padena padamudyuje |
yatha pumso vrishanyata striyam nihanyate manah |
eva te aghnye mano'dhi vatse ni hanyatam ||
verses.en: As the elephant strains foot with foot of the she-elephant; as of a lustful man etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा प्रधिर्यथोपधिर्यथा नभ्यं प्रधावधि ।
यथा पुंसो वृषण्यत स्त्रियां निहन्यते मनः ।
एवा ते अघ्न्ये मनोऽधि वत्से नि हन्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha pradhiryathopadhiryatha nabhyam pradhavadhi |
yatha pumso vrishanyata striyam nihanyate manah |
eva te aghnye mano'dhi vatse ni hanyatam ||
verses.en: As the felly (pradhí), as the rim (upadhí), as the nave upon the felly; as of a lustful man etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यदन्नमद्मि बहुधा विरूपं हिरण्यमश्वमुत गामजामविम् ।
यदेव किं च प्रतिजग्रहाहमग्निष्टद्धोता सुहुतं कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
yadannamadmi bahudha virupam hiranyamashvamuta gamajamavim |
yadeva kim cha pratijagrahahamagnishtaddhota suhutam krinotu ||
verses.en: What food of various form I eat oftentimes (bahudhā́)—gold, horse, also cow, she-goat, sheep, just whatsoever I have accepted—let Agni the offerer (hótar) make that well-offered.

verses.sa:
यन् मा हुतमहुतमाजगाम दत्तं पितृभिरनुमतं मनुष्यैः ।
यस्मान् मे मन उदिव रारजीत्यग्निष्टद्धोता सुहुतं कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
yan ma hutamahutamajagama dattam pitribhiranumatam manushyaih |
yasman me mana udiva rarajityagnishtaddhota suhutam krinotu ||
