verses.en: Whatever, offered [or] unoffered, hath come to me, given by the Fathers, assented to by human beings (manuṣyà), what my mind is as it were excited at—let Agni the offerer make that well-offered.

verses.sa:
यदन्नमद्म्यनृतेन देवा दास्यन्न् अदास्यन्न् उत संगृणामि ।
वैश्वानरस्य महतो महिम्ना शिवं मह्यं मधुमदस्त्वन्नम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadannamadmyanritena deva dasyann adasyann uta samgrinami |
vaishvanarasya mahato mahimna shivam mahyam madhumadastvannam ||
verses.en: What food I eat unrighteously, O gods, and promise, intending to give [or] not intending to give—by the greatness of the great Vāiçvānara let [it] be propitious honeyed food for me.

verses.sa:
यथासितः प्रथयते वशामनु वपूंषि कृण्वन्न् असुरस्य मायया ।
एवा ते शेपः सहसायमर्कोऽङ्गेनाङ्गं संसमकं कृणोतु ॥
verses.rom:
yathasitah prathayate vashamanu vapumshi krinvann asurasya mayaya |
eva te shepah sahasayamarko'ngenangam samsamakam krinotu ||
verses.en: As the black snake spreads himself at pleasure, making wondrous forms (vápus), by the Asura's magic (māyá), so let this arid suddenly make thy member altogether correspondent (? sáṁsamaka), limb with limb.

verses.sa:
यथा पसस्तायादरं वातेन स्थूलभं कृतम् ।
यावत्परस्वतः पसस्तावत्ते वर्धतां पसः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha pasastayadaram vatena sthulabham kritam |
yavatparasvatah pasastavatte vardhatam pasah ||
verses.en: As the member of the tayādara is made big by the wind—as great as is the member of the párasvant, so great let thy member grow.

verses.sa:
यावदङ्गीनं पारस्वतं हास्तिनं गार्दभं च यत्।
यावदश्वस्य वाजिनस्तावत्ते वर्धतां पसः ॥
verses.rom:
yavadanginam parasvatam hastinam gardabham cha yat|
yavadashvasya vajinastavatte vardhatam pasah ||
verses.en: As much of a limb as is that of the párasvant, that of the elephant, and that of the ass—as great as of the vigorous (vājín) horse, so great let thy member grow.

verses.sa:
एह यातु वरुणः सोमो अग्निर्बृहस्पतिर्वसुभिरेह यातु ।
अस्य श्रियमुपसंयात सर्व उग्रस्य चेत्तुः संमनसः सजाताः ॥
verses.rom:
eha yatu varunah somo agnirbrihaspatirvasubhireha yatu |
asya shriyamupasamyata sarva ugrasya chettuh sammanasah sajatah ||
verses.en: Let Varuṇa come here, Soma, Agni; let Brihaspati with the Vasus come here; come ye together, [his] fellows, all of you, like-minded, unto the fortune of this stern corrector (ugrá cettṛ́).

verses.sa:
यो वः शुष्मो हृदयेष्वन्तराकूतिर्या वो मनसि प्रविष्टा ।
तान्त्सीवयामि हविषा घृतेन मयि सजाता रमतिर्वो अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
yo vah shushmo hridayeshvantarakutirya vo manasi pravishta |
tantsivayami havisha ghritena mayi sajata ramatirvo astu ||
verses.en: The vehemence (çúṣma) that is within your hearts, the design that has entered into your mind—that I frustrate with the oblation, the ghee; in me, O [my] fellows, be your satisfaction (ramáti).

verses.sa:
इहैव स्त माप याताध्यस्मत्पूषा परस्तादपथं वः कृणोतु ।
वास्तोष्पतिरनु वो जोहवीतु मयि सजाता रमतिः वो अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
ihaiva sta mapa yatadhyasmatpusha parastadapatham vah krinotu |
vastoshpatiranu vo johavitu mayi sajata ramatih vo astu ||
verses.en: Be ye just here; go not away from us; let Pūshan make [it] pathless for you in the distance; let the lord of the dwelling (vā́stu) call aloud after you; in me, O [my] fellows, be your satisfaction.

verses.sa:
सं वः पृच्यन्तां तन्वः सं मनांसि समु व्रता ।
सं वोऽयं ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्भगः सं वो अजीगमत् ॥
verses.rom:
sam vah prichyantam tanvah sam manamsi samu vrata |
sam vo'yam brahmanaspatirbhagah sam vo ajigamat ||
verses.en: Together let your bodies be mixed (pṛc), together your minds, together your courses; together hath this Brahmaṇaspati, together hath Bhaga made you come.

verses.sa:
संज्ञपनं वो मनसोऽथो संज्ञपनं हृदः ।
अथो भगस्य यच्छ्रान्तं तेन संज्ञपयामि वः ॥
verses.rom:
samjnapanam vo manaso'tho samjnapanam hridah |
atho bhagasya yachchhrantam tena samjnapayami vah ||
verses.en: Concurrence of the mind for you, also concurrence of the heart, also what of Bhaga is wearied (çrāntá)—therewith I make you concur.

verses.sa:
यथादित्या वसुभिः सम्बभूवुर्मरुद्भिरुग्रा अहृणीयमानाः ।
एवा त्रिणामन्न् अहृणीयमान इमान् जनान्त्संमनसस्कृधीह ॥
verses.rom:
yathaditya vasubhih sambabhuvurmarudbhirugra ahriniyamanah |
eva trinamann ahriniyamana iman janantsammanasaskridhiha ||
verses.en: As the Ādityas, severe (ugrá), not bearing enmity, united with the Vasus, with the Maruts, so, O three-named one, not bearing enmity, do thou make these people here like-minded.

verses.sa:
निरमुं नुद ओकसः सपत्नो यः पृतन्यति ।
नैर्बाध्येन हविषेन्द्र एनं पराशरीत् ॥
verses.rom:
niramum nuda okasah sapatno yah pritanyati |
nairbadhyena havishendra enam parasharit ||
verses.en: I thrust yon man out of home, the rival who fights [us], with the oblation of ejectment; Indra hath demolished him.

verses.sa:
परमां तं परावतमिन्द्रो नुदतु वृत्रहा ।
यतो न पुनरायति शश्वतीभ्यः समाभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
paramam tam paravatamindro nudatu vritraha |
yato na punarayati shashvatibhyah samabhyah ||
verses.en: Let Indra, Vritra-slayer, thrust him to the most distant distance, whence he shall not come back, through constant years (sámā).

verses.sa:
एतु तिस्रः परावत एतु पञ्च जनामति ।
एतु तिस्रोऽति रोचना यतो न पुनरायति ।
शश्वतीभ्यः समाभ्यो यावत्सूर्यो असद्दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
etu tisrah paravata etu pancha janamati |
etu tisro'ti rochana yato na punarayati |
shashvatibhyah samabhyo yavatsuryo asaddivi ||
verses.en: Let him go [beyond] three distances; let him go beyond the five peoples; let him go beyond the three shining spaces, whence he shall not come back, through constant years, so long as the sun shall be in the sky.

verses.sa:
य एनं परिषीदन्ति समादधति चक्षसे ।
संप्रेद्धो अग्निर्जिह्वाभिरुदेतु हृदयादधि ॥
verses.rom:
ya enam parishidanti samadadhati chakshase |
sampreddho agnirjihvabhirudetu hridayadadhi ||
verses.en: They who sit about him, who pile on [fuel] in order to beholding [him]—let Agni, fully kindled, with his tongues arise out of [their] heart.

verses.sa:
अग्नेः साम्तपनस्याहमायुषे पदमा रभे ।
अद्धातिर्यस्य पश्यति धूममुद्यन्तमास्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
agneh samtapanasyahamayushe padama rabhe |
addhatiryasya pashyati dhumamudyantamasyatah ||
verses.en: Of the heating (? sāṁtapaná) Agni I take hold of the track (? padá), in order to length of life (ā́yus)—out of whose mouth the soothsayer (addhātí) sees the smoke arising.

verses.sa:
यो अस्य समिधं वेद क्षत्रियेण समाहिताम् ।
नाभिह्वारे पदं नि दधाति स मृत्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
yo asya samidham veda kshatriyena samahitam |
nabhihvare padam ni dadhati sa mrityave ||
verses.en: He who knoweth the fuel of him, piled on by the kṣatríya—he setteth not the foot (padá) in detriment unto death.

verses.sa:
नैनं घ्नन्ति पर्यायिणो न सन्नामव गच्छति ।
अग्नेर्यः क्षत्रियो विद्वान् नाम गृह्नाति आयुषे ॥
verses.rom:
nainam ghnanti paryayino na sannamava gachchhati |
agneryah kshatriyo vidvan nama grihnati ayushe ||
verses.en: They that go about (paryāyín) do not slay him, he goes not down to the dead (? sanná)—the kṣatríya who, knowing, takes the name of Agni unto length of life.

verses.sa:
अस्थाद्द्यौरस्थात्पृथिव्यस्थाद्विश्वमिदं जगत्।
आस्थाने पर्वता अस्थु स्थाम्न्यश्वामतिष्ठिपम् ॥
verses.rom:
asthaddyaurasthatprithivyasthadvishvamidam jagat|
asthane parvata asthu sthamnyashvamatishthipam ||
verses.en: The heaven hath stood; the earth hath stood; all this living world hath stood; on their base (āsthána) the mountains have stood; I have made the horses stand in their station.

verses.sa:
य उदानत्परायणं य उदानण्न्यायनम् ।
आवर्तनं निवर्तनं यो गोपा अपि तं हुवे ॥
verses.rom:
ya udanatparayanam ya udanannyayanam |
avartanam nivartanam yo gopa api tam huve ||
verses.en: He who hath attained the going away, he who hath attained the coming in, the turning hither, the turning in—he who is herdsman, on him I call.

verses.sa:
जातवेदो नि वर्तय शतं ते सन्त्वावृतः ।
सहस्रं त उपावृतस्ताभिर्नः पुनरा कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
jatavedo ni vartaya shatam te santvavritah |
sahasram ta upavritastabhirnah punara kridhi ||
verses.en: O Jātavedas, cause to turn in; be thy turners hither a hundred, thy turners this way a thousand; with them get for us again.

verses.sa:
तेन भूतेन हविषायमा प्यायतां पुनः ।
जायां यामस्मा आवाक्षुस्तां रसेनाभि वर्धताम् ॥
verses.rom:
tena bhutena havishayama pyayatam punah |
jayam yamasma avakshustam rasenabhi vardhatam ||
verses.en: By this actual (? bhūtá) oblation let this man be filled up again; the wife that they have brought to him, let him grow superior (abhi-vṛdh) to her by essence (rása).

verses.sa:
अभि वर्धतां पयसाभि राष्ट्रेण वर्धताम् ।
रय्या सहस्रवर्चसेमौ स्तामनुपक्षितौ ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vardhatam payasabhi rashtrena vardhatam |
rayya sahasravarchasemau stamanupakshitau ||
verses.en: Let him grow superior to [her] by fatness (páyas), let him grow superior to [her] by royalty; by wealth of thousand-fold splendor let these two be unexhausted.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा जायामजनयत्त्वष्टास्यै त्वां पतिम् ।
त्वष्टा सहस्रमायुंषि दीर्घमायुः कृणोतु वाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvashta jayamajanayattvashtasyai tvam patim |
tvashta sahasramayumshi dirghamayuh krinotu vam ||
verses.en: Tvashṭar generated the wife, Tvashṭar [generated] thee as husband for her; let Tvashṭar make for you two a thousand life-times (ā́yus), a long life-time.

verses.sa:
अयं नो नभसस्पतिः संस्फानो अभि रक्षतु ।
असमातिं गृहेषु नः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam no nabhasaspatih samsphano abhi rakshatu |
asamatim griheshu nah ||
verses.en: Let the lord of the cloud (nábhas) here, the fattener, protect us, [grant] unequalledness (?) in our houses.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो नभसस्पते ऊर्जं गृहेसु धारय ।
आ पुष्टमेत्वा वसु ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no nabhasaspate urjam grihesu dharaya |
a pushtametva vasu ||
verses.en: Do thou, O lord of the cloud, maintain for us sustenance (ū́rj) in our houses; let prosperity, let good (vásu) come.

verses.sa:
देव संस्फान सहस्रापोषस्येशिषे ।
तस्य नो रास्व तस्य नो धेहि तस्य ते भक्तिवांसः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
deva samsphana sahasraposhasyeshishe |
tasya no rasva tasya no dhehi tasya te bhaktivamsah syama ||
verses.en: O divine fattener, thou art master of thousand-fold prosperity; bestow upon us of that; assign to us of that; of that from thee may we be sharers.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिक्षेण पतति विश्वा भूतावचाकशत्।
शुनो दिव्यस्य यन् महस्तेना ते हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
antarikshena patati vishva bhutavachakashat|
shuno divyasya yan mahastena te havisha vidhema ||
verses.en: He flies through the atmosphere, looking down upon all existences; what the greatness is of the heavenly dog, with that oblation would we pay worship to thee.

verses.sa:
ये त्रयः कालकाञ्जा दिवि देवा इव श्रिताः ।
तान्त्सर्वान् अह्व ऊतयेऽस्मा अरिष्टतातये ॥
verses.rom:
ye trayah kalakanja divi deva iva shritah |
tantsarvan ahva utaye'sma arishtatataye ||
verses.en: The three kālakāñjás that are set (çritá) in the sky like gods—all them I called on for aid, for this man's unharmedness.

verses.sa:
अप्सु ते जन्म दिवि ते सधस्थं समुद्रे अन्तर्महिमा ते पृथिव्याम् ।
शुनो दिव्यस्य यन् महस्तेना ते हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
apsu te janma divi te sadhastham samudre antarmahima te prithivyam |
shuno divyasya yan mahastena te havisha vidhema ||
verses.en: In the waters [is] thy birth, in heaven thy station, within the ocean thy greatness, on the earth; what the greatness is of the heavenly dog, with that oblation would we pay worship to thee.

verses.sa:
यन्तासि यच्छसे हस्तावप रक्षांसि सेधसि ।
प्रजां धनं च गृह्णानः परिहस्तो अभूदयम् ॥
verses.rom:
yantasi yachchhase hastavapa rakshamsi sedhasi |
prajam dhanam cha grihnanah parihasto abhudayam ||
verses.en: Thou art a holder, thou boldest (yam) the two hands, thou drivest away the demons. Seizing (grah) progeny and riches, this hath become a hand-clasp (parihastá).

verses.sa:
परिहस्त वि धारय योनिं गर्भाय धातवे ।
मर्यादे पुत्रमा धेहि तं त्वमा गमयागमे ॥
verses.rom:
parihasta vi dharaya yonim garbhaya dhatave |
maryade putrama dhehi tam tvama gamayagame ||
verses.en: O hand-clasp, hold apart the womb, in order to placing of the embryo; O thou sign (? maryā́dā), put in a son; him do thou make to come, thou comer (? ā́gamā).

verses.sa:
यं परिहस्तमबिभरदितिः पुत्रकाम्या ।
त्वष्टा तमस्या आ बध्नाद्यथा पुत्रं जनाद् ॥
verses.rom:
yam parihastamabibharaditih putrakamya |
tvashta tamasya a badhnadyatha putram janad ||
verses.en: The hand-clasp that Aditi wore [when] desiring a son—may Tvashṭar bind that on for her, saying "that she may give birth to a son."

verses.sa:
आगच्छत आगतस्य नाम गृह्णाम्यायतः ।
इन्द्रस्य वृत्रघ्नो वन्वे वासवस्य शतक्रतोः ॥
verses.rom:
agachchhata agatasya nama grihnamyayatah |
indrasya vritraghno vanve vasavasya shatakratoh ||
verses.en: I take the name of the arriving, the arrived, the coming one; Indra the Vritra-slayer I win (van), him of the Vasus, of a hundred-fold power.

verses.sa:
येन सूर्यां सावित्रीमश्विनोहतुः पथा ।
तेन मामब्रवीद्भगो जायामा वहतादिति ॥
verses.rom:
yena suryam savitrimashvinohatuh patha |
tena mamabravidbhago jayama vahataditi ||
verses.en: By what road the Açvins carried Sūryā, daughter of Savitar, by that, Bhaga said to me, do thou bring a wife.

verses.sa:
यस्तेऽङ्कुशो वसुदानो बृहन्न् इन्द्र हिरण्ययः ।
तेना जनीयते जायां मह्यं धेहि शचीपते ॥
verses.rom:
yaste'nkusho vasudano brihann indra hiranyayah |
tena janiyate jayam mahyam dhehi shachipate ||
verses.en: The good-giving, great, golden hook that is thine, O Indra—with that, O lord of might (çácī-), assign thou a wife to me who seek a wife.

verses.sa:
अपचितः प्र पतत सुपर्णो वसतेरिव ।
सूर्यः कृणोतु भेषजं चन्द्रमा वोऽपोच्छतु ॥
verses.rom:
apachitah pra patata suparno vasateriva |
suryah krinotu bheshajam chandrama vo'pochchhatu ||
verses.en: O apacíts, fly forth, like a bird (suparṇá) from its nest; let the sun make remedy; let the moon shine you away.

verses.sa:
एन्येका श्येन्येका कृष्णैका रोहिणी द्वे ।
सर्वासामग्रभं नामावीरघ्नीरपेतन ॥
verses.rom:
enyeka shyenyeka krishnaika rohini dve |
sarvasamagrabham namaviraghnirapetana ||
verses.en: One [is] spotted, one whitish (çyénī), one black, two red; of all have I taken the name; go ye away, not slaying [our] men.

verses.sa:
असूतिका रामायण्यपचित्प्र पतिष्यति ।
ग्लौरितः प्र पतिष्यति स गलुन्तो नशिष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
asutika ramayanyapachitpra patishyati |
glauritah pra patishyati sa galunto nashishyati ||
verses.en: Barren shall the apacít, daughter of the black one, fly forth; the boil (glāú) shall fly forth from here; it shall disappear from the neck (? galuntás).

verses.sa: वीहि स्वामाहुतिं जुषाणो मनसा स्वाहा मनसा यदिदं जुहोमि ॥
verses.rom: vihi svamahutim jushano manasa svaha manasa yadidam juhomi ||
verses.en: Partake (vī) of [thine] own oblation, enjoying with the mind; hail! as now I make oblation with the mind.

verses.sa:
यस्यास्त आसनि घोरे जुहोम्येषां बद्धानामवसर्जनाय कम् ।
भूमिरिति त्वाभिप्रमन्वते जना निर्ऋतिरिति त्वाहं परि वेद सर्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
yasyasta asani ghore juhomyesham baddhanamavasarjanaya kam |
bhumiriti tvabhipramanvate jana nirritiriti tvaham pari veda sarvatah ||
verses.en: Thou in whose terrible mouth I make oblation, in order to the release of these bound ones; people think of thee as "earth"; I know thee completely as "perdition" (nírṛti).

verses.sa:
भूते हविष्मती भवैष ते भागो यो अस्मासु ।
मुञ्चेमान् अमून् एनसः स्वाहा ॥
verses.rom:
bhute havishmati bhavaisha te bhago yo asmasu |
muncheman amun enasah svaha ||
verses.en: O earth (?), be thou rich in oblations; this is thy share which is in us; free these [and] those from sin: hail!

verses.sa:
एवो ष्वस्मन् निर्ऋतेऽनेहा त्वमयस्मयान् वि चृता बन्धपाशान् ।
यमो मह्यं पुनरित्त्वां ददाति तस्मै यमाय नमो अस्तु मृत्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
evo shvasman nirrite'neha tvamayasmayan vi chrita bandhapashan |
yamo mahyam punarittvam dadati tasmai yamaya namo astu mrityave ||
verses.en: So, O perdition, do thou, free from envy, kindly unfasten from us the bond-fetters of iron. Yama verily giveth thee back to me; to that Yama, to death, be homage.

verses.sa:
अयस्मये द्रुपदे बेधिष इहाभिहितो मृत्युभिर्ये सहस्रम् ।
यमेन त्वं पितृभिः संविदान उत्तमं नाकमधि रोहयेमम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayasmaye drupade bedhisha ihabhihito mrityubhirye sahasram |
yamena tvam pitribhih samvidana uttamam nakamadhi rohayemam ||
verses.en: Thou wast bound here to an iron post, bridled with deaths that are a thousand; do thou, in concord with Yama, with the Fathers, make this man ascend to the highest firmament.

verses.sa:
वरणो वारयाता अयं देवो वनस्पतिः ।
यक्ष्मो यो अस्मिन्न् आविष्टस्तमु देवा अवीवरन् ॥
verses.rom:
varano varayata ayam devo vanaspatih |
yakshmo yo asminn avishtastamu deva avivaran ||
verses.en: The varaṇá, this divine forest-tree, shall ward off (vāray-); the yákṣma that has entered into this man—that have the gods warded off.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य वचसा वयं मित्रस्य वरुणस्य च ।
देवानां सर्वेषां वाचा यक्ष्मं ते वारयामहे ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya vachasa vayam mitrasya varunasya cha |
devanam sarvesham vacha yakshmam te varayamahe ||
verses.en: With the word (vácas) of Indra, of Mitra, and of Varuṇa, with the voice (vā́c) of all the gods, do we ward off thy yákṣma.

verses.sa:
यथा वृत्र इमा आपस्तस्तम्भ विश्वधा यतीः ।
एवा ते अग्निना यक्ष्मं वैश्वानरेण वारये ॥
verses.rom:
yatha vritra ima apastastambha vishvadha yatih |
eva te agnina yakshmam vaishvanarena varaye ||
verses.en: As Vritra stopped (stambh) these waters [when] going in all directions, so, by means of Agni Vāiçvānara, do I ward off thy yákṣma.

verses.sa:
वृषेन्द्रस्य वृषा दिवो वृषा पृथिव्या अयम् ।
वृषा विश्वस्य भूतस्य त्वमेकवृषो भव ॥
verses.rom:
vrishendrasya vrisha divo vrisha prithivya ayam |
vrisha vishvasya bhutasya tvamekavrisho bhava ||
verses.en: Chief (vṛ́ṣan) of Indra, chief of heaven, chief of earth is this man, chief of all existence; do thou be sole chief.

verses.sa:
समुद्र ईशे स्रवतामग्निः पृथिव्या वशी ।
चन्द्रमा नक्षत्राणामीशे त्वमेकवृषो भव ॥
verses.rom:
samudra ishe sravatamagnih prithivya vashi |
chandrama nakshatranamishe tvamekavrisho bhava ||
verses.en: The ocean is master of the streams; Agni is controler of the earth; the moon is master of the asterisms; do thou be sole chief.

verses.sa:
सम्राडस्यसुराणां ककुन् मनुष्याणाम् ।
देवानामर्धभागसि त्वमेकवृषो भव ॥
verses.rom:
samradasyasuranam kakun manushyanam |
devanamardhabhagasi tvamekavrisho bhava ||
verses.en: Universal ruler art thou of Asuras, summit of human beings; part-sharer of the gods art thou; do thou be sole chief.

verses.sa:
आ त्वाहार्षमन्तरभूर्ध्रुवस्तिष्ठाविचाचलत्।
विशस्त्वा सर्वा वाञ्छन्तु मा त्वद्राष्ट्रमधि भ्रशत् ॥
verses.rom:
a tvaharshamantarabhurdhruvastishthavichachalat|
vishastva sarva vanchhantu ma tvadrashtramadhi bhrashat ||
verses.en: I have taken thee; thou hast become within; stand thou fixed, not unsteady; let all the people (víças) want thee; let not the kingdom fall away from thee.

verses.sa:
इहैवैधि माप च्योष्ठाः पर्वत इवाविचाचलत्।
इन्द्र इवेह ध्रुवस्तिष्ठेह राष्ट्रमु धारय ॥
verses.rom:
ihaivaidhi mapa chyoshthah parvata ivavichachalat|
indra iveha dhruvastishtheha rashtramu dharaya ||
verses.en: Be thou just here; be not moved away; like a mountain, not unsteady; O Indra, stand thou fixed just here; here do thou maintain royalty.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र एतमदीधरत्ध्रुवं ध्रुवेण हविषा ।
तस्मै सोमो अधि ब्रवदयं च ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
indra etamadidharatdhruvam dhruvena havisha |
tasmai somo adhi bravadayam cha brahmanaspatih ||
verses.en: Indra hath maintained this man fixed by a fixed oblation; him may Soma bless, and Brahmaṇaspati here.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवा द्यौर्ध्रुवा पृथिवी ध्रुवं विश्वमिदं जगत्।
ध्रुवासः पर्वता इमे ध्रुवो राजा विशामयम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhruva dyaurdhruva prithivi dhruvam vishvamidam jagat|
dhruvasah parvata ime dhruvo raja vishamayam ||
verses.en: Fixed [is] the sky, fixed the earth, fixed all this world of living beings (jágat), fixed these mountains; fixed [is] this king of the people (viçā́m).

verses.sa:
ध्रुवं ते राजा वरुणो ध्रुवं देवो बृहस्पतिः ।
ध्रुवं त इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च राष्ट्रं धारयतां ध्रुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhruvam te raja varuno dhruvam devo brihaspatih |
dhruvam ta indrashchagnishcha rashtram dharayatam dhruvam ||
verses.en: Fixed for thee let king Varuṇa, fixed let divine Brihaspati, fixed for thee let both Indra and Agni maintain royalty fixed.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवोऽच्युतः प्र मृणीहि शत्रून् छत्रूयतोऽधरान् पादयस्व ।
सर्वा दिशः संमनसः सध्रीचीर्ध्रुवाय ते समितिः कल्पतामिह ॥
verses.rom:
dhruvo'chyutah pra mrinihi shatrun chhatruyato'dharan padayasva |
sarva dishah sammanasah sadhrichirdhruvaya te samitih kalpatamiha ||
verses.en: Fixed, unmoved, do thou slaughter the foes; make them that play the foe fall below [thee]; [be] all the quarters (díç) like-minded, concordant (sadhryàñc); let the gathering (sámiti) here suit (kḷp) thee [who art] fixed.

verses.sa:
इदं यत्प्रेण्यः शिरो दत्तं सोमेन वृष्ण्यम् ।
ततः परि प्रजातेन हार्दिं ते शोचयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
idam yatprenyah shiro dattam somena vrishnyam |
tatah pari prajatena hardim te shochayamasi ||
verses.en: This head that is love's (? preṇí), virility given by Soma—by what is engendered out of that, do we pain (çocaya) thy heart.

verses.sa:
शोचयामसि ते हार्दिं शोचयामसि ते मनः ।
वातं धूम इव सध्र्यङ्मामेवान्वेतु ये मनः ॥
verses.rom:
shochayamasi te hardim shochayamasi te manah |
vatam dhuma iva sadhryanmamevanvetu ye manah ||
verses.en: We pain thy heart; we pain thy mind; as smoke the wind, close upon it (sadhryàñc), so let thy mind go after me.

verses.sa:
मह्यं त्वा मित्रावरुणौ मह्यं देवी सरस्वती ।
मह्यं त्वा मध्यं भूम्या उभावन्तौ समस्यताम् ॥
verses.rom:
mahyam tva mitravarunau mahyam devi sarasvati |
mahyam tva madhyam bhumya ubhavantau samasyatam ||
verses.en: Unto me let Mitra-and-Varuṇa, unto me divine Sarasvatī, unto me let the middle of the earth, let both [its] ends fling (sam-as) thee.

verses.sa:
यां ते रुद्र इषुमास्यदङ्गेभ्यो हृदयाय च ।
इदं तामद्य त्वद्वयं विषूचीं वि वृहामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yam te rudra ishumasyadangebhyo hridayaya cha |
idam tamadya tvadvayam vishuchim vi vrihamasi ||
verses.en: The arrow that Rudra hurled at thee, at thy limbs and heart, that do we now thus eject asunder from thee.

verses.sa:
यास्ते शतं धमनयोऽङ्गान्यनु विष्ठिताः ।
तासां ते सर्वासां वयं निर्विषाणि ह्वयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yaste shatam dhamanayo'nganyanu vishthitah |
tasam te sarvasam vayam nirvishani hvayamasi ||
verses.en: The hundred tubes that are thine, distributed along thy limbs, of all these of thine do we call out the poisons.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते रुद्रास्यते नमः प्रतिहितायै ।
नमो विसृज्यमानायै नमो निपतितायै ॥
verses.rom:
namaste rudrasyate namah pratihitayai |
namo visrijyamanayai namo nipatitayai ||
verses.en: Homage to thee, O Rudra, when hurling; homage to [thine arrow] when aimed (prátihita); homage to it when let fly; homage to it when having hit.

verses.sa:
इमं यवमष्टायोगैः षड्योगेभिरचर्कृषुः ।
तेना ते तन्वो रपोऽपाचीनमप व्यये ॥
verses.rom:
imam yavamashtayogaih shadyogebhiracharkrishuh |
tena te tanvo rapo'pachinamapa vyaye ||
verses.en: This barley they plowed mightily with yokes of eight, with yokes of six; therewith I unwrap away the complaint (rápas) of thy body.

verses.sa:
न्यग्वातो वाति न्यक् तपति सूर्यः ।
नीचीनमघ्न्या दुहे न्यग्भवतु ते रपः ॥
verses.rom:
nyagvato vati nyak tapati suryah |
nichinamaghnya duhe nyagbhavatu te rapah ||
verses.en: Downward blows the wind; downward burns the sun; downward the inviolable [cow] milks; downward be thy complaint.

verses.sa:
आप इद्वा उ भेषजीरापो अमीवचातनीः ।
आपो विश्वस्य भेषजीस्तास्ते कृण्वन्तु भेषजम् ॥
verses.rom:
apa idva u bheshajirapo amivachatanih |
apo vishvasya bheshajistaste krinvantu bheshajam ||
verses.en: The waters verily are remedial; the waters are disease-expelling; the waters are remedial of everything; let them make remedy for thee.

verses.sa:
वातरंहा भव वाजिन् युजमान इन्द्रस्य याहि प्रसवे मनोजवाः ।
युञ्जन्तु त्वा मरुतो विश्ववेदस आ ते त्वस्ता पत्सु जवं दधातु ॥
verses.rom:
vataramha bhava vajin yujamana indrasya yahi prasave manojavah |
yunjantu tva maruto vishvavedasa a te tvasta patsu javam dadhatu ||
verses.en: Be thou, O steed (vājín), of wind-swiftness, being harnessed (yuj) go in Indra's impulse, with mind-quickness; let the all-possessing Maruts harness thee; let Tvashṭar put quickness in thy feet.

verses.sa:
जवस्ते अर्वन् निहितो गुहा यः श्येने वाते उत योऽचरत्परीत्तः ।
तेन त्वं वाजिन् बलवान् बलेनाजिं जय समने परयिष्णुः ॥
verses.rom:
javaste arvan nihito guha yah shyene vate uta yo'charatparittah |
tena tvam vajin balavan balenajim jaya samane parayishnuh ||
verses.en: The quickness, O courser, that is put in thee in secret, also that went about committed to the hawk, to the wind—with that strength do thou, O steed, being strong, win the race, rescuing in the conflict.

verses.sa:
तनूष्टे वाजिन् तन्वं नयन्ती वाममस्मभ्यं धावतु शर्म तुभ्यम् ।
अह्रुतो महो धरुणाय देवो दिवीव ज्योतिः स्वमा मिमीयात् ॥
verses.rom:
tanushte vajin tanvam nayanti vamamasmabhyam dhavatu sharma tubhyam |
ahruto maho dharunaya devo diviva jyotih svama mimiyat ||
verses.en: Let thy body, O steed, conducting a body, run pleasance (vāmá) for us, protection for thyself; uninjured, great, a god for maintaining, may he set up his own light in the sky, as it were.

verses.sa:
यमो मृत्युरघमारो निर्ऋथो बभ्रुः शर्वोऽस्ता नीलशिखण्डः ।
देवजनाः सेनयोत्तस्थिवांसस्ते अस्माकं परि वृञ्जन्तु वीरान् ॥
verses.rom:
yamo mrityuraghamaro nirritho babhruh sharvo'sta nilashikhandah |
devajanah senayottasthivamsaste asmakam pari vrinjantu viran ||
verses.en: Yama, death, the evil-killer, the destroyer, the brown Çarva, the blue-locked archer, the god-folk that have arisen with their army—let them avoid our heroes.

verses.sa:
मनसा होमैर्हरसा घृतेन शर्वायास्त्र उत राज्ञे भवाय ।
नमस्येभ्यो नम एभ्यः कृणोम्यन्यत्रास्मदघविषा नयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
manasa homairharasa ghritena sharvayastra uta rajne bhavaya |
namasyebhyo nama ebhyah krinomyanyatrasmadaghavisha nayantu ||
verses.en: With mind, with libations, with flame (? háras), with ghee, unto the archer Çarva and unto king Bhava—to them (pl.), who are deserving of homage, I pay homage; let them conduct those of evil poison away from us.

verses.sa:
त्रायध्वं नो अघविषाभ्यो वधाद्विश्वे देवा मरुतो विश्ववेदसः ।
अग्नीषोमा वरुणः पूतदक्षा वातापर्जन्ययोः सुमतौ स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
trayadhvam no aghavishabhyo vadhadvishve deva maruto vishvavedasah |
agnishoma varunah putadaksha vataparjanyayoh sumatau syama ||
verses.en: Save ye us from them of evil poison, from the deadly weapon, O all ye gods, ye all-possessing Maruts; Agni-and-Soma, Varuṇa of purified skill; may we be in the favor of Vāta-and-Parjanya.

verses.sa:
सं वो मनांसि सं व्रता समाकूतीर्नमामसि ।
अमी ये विव्रता स्थन तान् वः सं नमयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
sam vo manamsi sam vrata samakutirnamamasi |
ami ye vivrata sthana tan vah sam namayamasi ||
verses.en: We bend together your minds, together your courses, together your designs; ye yonder who are of discordant courses, we make you bend [them] together here.

verses.sa:
अहं गृभ्णामि मनसा मनांसि मम चित्तमनु चित्तेभिरेत ।
मम वशेषु हृदयानि वः कृणोमि मम यातमनुवर्त्मान एत ॥
verses.rom:
aham gribhnami manasa manamsi mama chittamanu chittebhireta |
mama vasheshu hridayani vah krinomi mama yatamanuvartmana eta ||
verses.en: I seize [your] minds with [my] mind; come after my intent with [your] intents; I put your hearts in my control; come with [your] tracks following my motion.

verses.sa:
ओते मे द्यावापृथिवी ओता देवी सरस्वती ।
ओतौ म इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च र्ध्यास्मेदं सरस्वति ॥
verses.rom:
ote me dyavaprithivi ota devi sarasvati |
otau ma indrashchagnishcha rdhyasmedam sarasvati ||
verses.en: Worked in for me [are] heaven-and-earth; worked in [is] divine Sarasvatī; worked in for me [are] both Indra and Agni; may we be successful here, O Sarasvatī.

verses.sa:
अश्वत्थो देवसदनस्तृतीयस्यामितो दिवि ।
तत्रामृतस्य चक्षणं देवाः कुष्ठमवन्वत ॥
verses.rom:
ashvattho devasadanastritiyasyamito divi |
tatramritasya chakshanam devah kushthamavanvata ||
verses.en: The açvatthá, seat of the gods, in the third heaven from here; there the gods won the kúṣṭha, the sight of immortality.

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययी नौरचरद्धिरण्यबन्धना दिवि ।
तत्रामृतस्य पुष्पं देवाः कुष्ठमवन्वत ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyayi nauracharaddhiranyabandhana divi |
tatramritasya pushpam devah kushthamavanvata ||
verses.en: A golden ship, of golden tackle, moved about in the sky; there the gods won the kúṣṭha, the flower of immortality.

verses.sa:
गर्भो अस्योषधीनां गर्भो हिमवतामुत ।
गर्भो विश्वस्य भूतस्येमं मे अगदं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
garbho asyoshadhinam garbho himavatamuta |
garbho vishvasya bhutasyemam me agadam kridhi ||
verses.en: Thou art the young (gárbha) of herbs; the young also of the snowy [mountains], the young of all existence; make thou this man free from disease for me.

verses.sa:
या ओषधयः सोमराज्ञीर्बह्वीः शतविचक्षणाः ।
बृहस्पतिप्रसूतास्ता नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
ya oshadhayah somarajnirbahvih shatavichakshanah |
brihaspatiprasutasta no munchantvamhasah ||
verses.en: The herbs whose king is Soma, numerous, of hundred-fold aspect (? vicakṣaṇa), impelled by Brihaspati—let them free us from distress.

verses.sa:
मुञ्चन्तु मा शपथ्यादथो वरुण्यादुत ।
अथो यमस्य पड्वीशाद्विश्वस्माद्देवकिल्बिषात् ॥
verses.rom:
munchantu ma shapathyadatho varunyaduta |
atho yamasya padvishadvishvasmaddevakilbishat ||
verses.en: Let them free me from that which comes from a curse, then also from that which is of Varuṇa, then from Yama's fetter, from all offense against the gods.

verses.sa:
यच्चक्षुषा मनसा यच्च वाचोपारिम जाग्रतो यत्स्वपन्तः ।
सोमस्तानि स्वधया नः पुनातु ॥
verses.rom:
yachchakshusha manasa yachcha vachoparima jagrato yatsvapantah |
somastani svadhaya nah punatu ||
verses.en: If (yát) with eye, with mind, and if with speech we have offended (upa-ṛ) waking, if sleeping, let Soma purify those things for us with svadhā́.

verses.sa:
अभिभूर्यज्ञो अभिभूरग्निरभिभूः सोमो अभिभूरिन्द्रः ।
अभ्यहं विश्वाः पृतना यथासान्येवा विधेमाग्निहोत्रा इदं हविः ॥
verses.rom:
abhibhuryajno abhibhuragnirabhibhuh somo abhibhurindrah |
abhyaham vishvah pritana yathasanyeva vidhemagnihotra idam havih ||
verses.en: An overcomer (abhibhū́) [is] the sacrifice, an overcomer Agni, an overcomer Soma, an overcomer Indra; that I may overcome (abhi-as) all fighters, so would we, Agni-offerers, pay worship with this oblation.

verses.sa:
स्वधास्तु मित्रावरुणा विपश्चिता प्रजावत्क्षत्रं मधुनेह पिन्वतम् ।
बाधेथां दूरं निर्ऋतिं पराचैः कृतं चिदेनः प्र मुमुक्तमस्मत् ॥
verses.rom:
svadhastu mitravaruna vipashchita prajavatkshatram madhuneha pinvatam |
badhetham duram nirritim parachaih kritam chidenah pra mumuktamasmat ||
verses.en: Be there svadhā́, O Mitra-and-Varuṇa, inspired ones; fatten (pinv) ye here with honey our dominion, rich in progeny; drive off perdition far away; put away from us any committed sin.

verses.sa:
इमं वीरमनु हर्षध्वमुग्रमिन्द्रं सखायो अनु सं रभध्वम् ।
ग्रामजितं गोजितं वज्रबाहुं जयन्तमज्म प्रमृणन्तमोजसा ॥
verses.rom:
imam viramanu harshadhvamugramindram sakhayo anu sam rabhadhvam |
gramajitam gojitam vajrabahum jayantamajma pramrinantamojasa ||
verses.en: Be ye excited after this formidable hero; take hold, O companions, after Indra, the troop-conqueror, kine-conqueror, thunderbolt-armed, conquering in the course (ájman), slaughtering with force.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो जयाति न परा जयाता अधिराजो राजसु राजयातै ।
चर्कृत्य ईड्यो वन्द्यश्चोपसद्यो नमस्य्श्भवेह ॥
verses.rom:
indro jayati na para jayata adhirajo rajasu rajayatai |
charkritya idyo vandyashchopasadyo namasyshbhaveha ||
verses.en: May Indra conquer, may he not be conquered; may he king it as over-king among kings; be thou here one to be famed, to be praised, to be greeted, to be waited on, and to be reverenced.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्राधिराजः श्रवस्युस्त्वं भूरभिभूतिर्जनानाम् ।
त्वं दैवीर्विश इमा वि राजायुष्मत्क्षत्रमजरं ते अस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindradhirajah shravasyustvam bhurabhibhutirjananam |
tvam daivirvisha ima vi rajayushmatkshatramajaram te astu ||
verses.en: Thou, O Indra, art over-king, ambitious (çravasyú), thou art the overcomer of people; do thou rule over these folk (viçás) of the gods; long-lived, unfading (ajára) dominion be thine.

verses.sa:
प्राच्या दिशस्त्वमिन्द्रासि राजोतोदीच्या दिशो वृत्रहन् छत्रुहोऽसि ।
यत्र यन्ति स्रोत्यास्तज्जितं ते दक्षिणतो वृषभ एषि हव्यः ॥
verses.rom:
prachya dishastvamindrasi rajotodichya disho vritrahan chhatruho'si |
yatra yanti srotyastajjitam te dakshinato vrishabha eshi havyah ||
verses.en: Of the eastern quarter thou, O Indra, art king; also of the northern quarter art thou, O Vritra-slayer, slayer of foes; where the streams go, that is thy conquest; in the south, as bull, thou goest worthy of invocation.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वेन्द्र वरिमतः पुरा त्वांहूरणाद्धुवे ।
ह्वयाम्युग्रं चेत्तारं पुरुणामानमेकजम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tvendra varimatah pura tvamhuranaddhuve |
hvayamyugram chettaram purunamanamekajam ||
verses.en: Unto thee, O Indra, on account of width, thee against (purā́) distress I call; I call on the stern corrector, the many-named, sole-born.

verses.sa:
यो अद्य सेन्यो वधो जिघांसन् न उदीरते ।
इन्द्रस्य तत्र बाहू समन्तं परि दद्मः ॥
verses.rom:
yo adya senyo vadho jighamsan na udirate |
indrasya tatra bahu samantam pari dadmah ||
verses.en: The hostile (? sénya) weapon that goes up today, desiring to slay us—in that case we put completely about us Indra's two arms.

verses.sa:
परि दद्म इन्द्रस्य बाहू समन्तं त्रातुस्त्रायतां नः ।
देव सवितः सोम राजन्त्सुमनसं मा कृणु स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
pari dadma indrasya bahu samantam tratustrayatam nah |
deva savitah soma rajantsumanasam ma krinu svastaye ||
verses.en: We put completely about the two arms of Indra the savior; let him save us. God Savitar! king Soma! make thou me well-willing, in order to well-being.

verses.sa:
देवा अदुः सूर्यो द्यौरदात्पृथिव्यदात्।
तिस्रः सरस्वतिरदुः सचित्ता विषदूषणम् ॥
verses.rom:
deva aduh suryo dyauradatprithivyadat|
tisrah sarasvatiraduh sachitta vishadushanam ||
verses.en: The gods have given, the sun has given, the sky has given, the earth has given, the three Sarasvatīs have given, accordant, the poison-spoiler.

verses.sa:
यद्वो देवा उपजीका आसिञ्चन् धन्वन्युदकम् ।
तेन देवप्रसूतेनेदं दूषयता विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadvo deva upajika asinchan dhanvanyudakam |
tena devaprasutenedam dushayata visham ||
verses.en: The water which the gods poured for you, O upajī́kās, on the waste, with that, which is impelled by the gods, spoil ye this poison.

verses.sa:
असुराणां दुहितासि सा देवानामसि स्वसा ।
दिवस्पृथिव्याः संभूता सा चकर्थारसं विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
asuranam duhitasi sa devanamasi svasa |
divasprithivyah sambhuta sa chakartharasam visham ||
verses.en: Thou art daughter of the Asuras; thou, the same, art sister of the gods; arisen from the sky, from the earth, thou hast made the poison sapless.

verses.sa:
आ वृषायस्व श्वसिहि वर्धस्व प्रथयस्व च ।
यथाङ्गं वर्धतां शेपस्तेन योषितमिज्जहि ॥
verses.rom:
a vrishayasva shvasihi vardhasva prathayasva cha |
yathangam vardhatam shepastena yoshitamijjahi ||
verses.en: Play thou the bull, blow, increase and spread; let thy member increase limb by limb; with it smite the woman.

verses.sa:
येन कृषं वाजयन्ति येन हिन्वन्त्यातुरम् ।
तेनास्य ब्रह्मणस्पते धनुरिवा तानया पसः ॥
verses.rom:
yena krisham vajayanti yena hinvantyaturam |
tenasya brahmanaspate dhanuriva tanaya pasah ||
verses.en: Wherewith they invigorate one who is lean, wherewith they incite (hi) one who is ill—with that, O Brahmaṇaspati, make thou his member taut like a bow.

verses.sa:
आहं तनोमि ते पसो अधि ज्यामिव धन्वनि ।
क्रमस्व ऋष इव रोहितमनवग्लायता सदा ॥
verses.rom:
aham tanomi te paso adhi jyamiva dhanvani |
kramasva risha iva rohitamanavaglayata sada ||
verses.en: I make thy member taut, like a bowstring on a bow; mount, as it were a stag a doe, unrelaxingly always.

verses.sa:
यथायं वाहो अश्विना समैति सं च वर्तते ।
एवा मामभि ते मनः समैतु सं च वर्तताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yathayam vaho ashvina samaiti sam cha vartate |
eva mamabhi te manah samaitu sam cha vartatam ||
verses.en: As this draft-horse (vāhá), O Açvins, comes together and moves together [with his mate], so unto me let thy mind come together and move together.

verses.sa:
आहं खिदामि ते मनो राजाश्वः पृष्ट्यामिव ।
रेष्मछिन्नं यथा तृणं मयि ते वेष्टतां मनः ॥
verses.rom:
aham khidami te mano rajashvah prishtyamiva |
reshmachhinnam yatha trinam mayi te veshtatam manah ||
verses.en: I drag along (ā-khid) thy mind, as a king-horse a side-mare (?); like grass cut by a whirlwind, let thy mind twine itself to me.

verses.sa:
आञ्जनस्य मदुघस्य कुष्ठस्य नलदस्य च ।
तुरो भगस्य हस्ताभ्यामनुरोधनमुद्भरे ॥
verses.rom:
anjanasya madughasya kushthasya naladasya cha |
turo bhagasya hastabhyamanurodhanamudbhare ||
verses.en: Of ointment, of madúgha, of kúṣṭha, and of nard, by the hands of Bhaga, I bring up quick a means of subjection.

verses.sa:
संदानं वो बृहस्पतिः संदानं सविता करत्।
संदानं मित्रो अर्यमा संदानं भगो अश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
samdanam vo brihaspatih samdanam savita karat|
samdanam mitro aryama samdanam bhago ashvina ||
verses.en: Tying-together may Brihaspati, tying-together may Savitar make for you; tying-together may Mitra, Aryaman, tying-together may Bhaga, the Açvins [make].

verses.sa:
सं परमान्त्समवमान् अथो सं द्यामि मध्यमान् ।
इन्द्रस्तान् पर्यहार्दाम्ना तान् अग्ने सं द्या त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
sam paramantsamavaman atho sam dyami madhyaman |
indrastan paryahardamna tan agne sam dya tvam ||
verses.en: I tie together the highest, together the lowest, also together the middle ones; Indra hath encompassed them with a tie; do thou, Agni, tie them together.

verses.sa:
अमी ये युधमायन्ति केतून् कृत्वानीकशः ।
इन्द्रस्तान् पर्यहार्दाम्न तान् अग्ने सं द्या त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
ami ye yudhamayanti ketun kritvanikashah |
indrastan paryahardamna tan agne sam dya tvam ||
verses.en: They yonder who come to fight, having made their ensigns, in troops—Indra hath encompassed them with a tie; do thou, Agni, tie them together.

verses.sa:
आदानेन संदानेनामित्रान् आ द्यामसि ।
अपाना ये चैषां प्राणा असुनासून्त्समछिदन् ॥
verses.rom:
adanena samdanenamitran a dyamasi |
apana ye chaisham prana asunasuntsamachhidan ||
verses.en: With tying-up, with tying-together, we tie up the enemies; the expirations and breaths of them, lives with life (ásu) have I cut off.

verses.sa:
इदमादानमकरं तपसेन्द्रेण संशितम् ।
अमित्रा येऽत्र नः सन्ति तान् अग्न आ द्या त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
idamadanamakaram tapasendrena samshitam |
amitra ye'tra nah santi tan agna a dya tvam ||
verses.en: This tying-up have I made, sharpened up with fervor by Indra; our enemies that are here—them, O Agni, do thou tie up.

verses.sa:
ऐनान् द्यतामिन्द्राग्नी सोमो राजा च मेदिनौ ।
इन्द्रो मरुत्वान् आदानममित्रेभ्यः कृणोतु नः ॥
verses.rom:
ainan dyatamindragni somo raja cha medinau |
indro marutvan adanamamitrebhyah krinotu nah ||
verses.en: Let Indra-and-Agni tie them up, and king Soma, allied; let Indra with the Maruts make tying-up for our enemies.

verses.sa:
यथा मनो मनस्केतैः परापतत्याशुमत्।
एवा त्वं कासे प्र पत मनसोऽनु प्रवाय्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha mano manasketaih parapatatyashumat|
eva tvam kase pra pata manaso'nu pravayyam ||

verses.sa:
यथा बाणः सुसंशितः परापतत्याशुमत्।
एवा त्वं कासे प्र पत पृथिव्या अनु संवतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha banah susamshitah parapatatyashumat|
eva tvam kase pra pata prithivya anu samvatam ||

verses.sa:
यथा सूर्यस्य रश्मयः परापतन्त्याशुमत्।
एवा त्वं कासे प्र पत समुद्रस्यानु विक्षरम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha suryasya rashmayah parapatantyashumat|
eva tvam kase pra pata samudrasyanu viksharam ||

prose.en:
1. As the mind with mind-aims flies away swiftly, so do thou, O cough, fly forth, after the forth-driving (?) of the mind.

3. As the sun's rays fly away swiftly, so do thou, O cough, fly forth, after the outflow of the ocean.

verses.sa:
आयने ते परायणे दूर्वा रोहन्तु पुष्पिणीः ।
उत्सो वा तत्र जायतां ह्रदो वा पुण्डरीकवान् ॥
verses.rom:
ayane te parayane durva rohantu pushpinih |
utso va tatra jayatam hrado va pundarikavan ||
verses.en: In thy course hither, [thy] course away, let the flowery dū́rvā grow; either let a fountain spring up there, or a pond rich in lotuses.

verses.sa:
अपामिदं न्ययनं समुद्रस्य निवेशनम् ।
मध्ये ह्रदस्य नो गृहाः पराचीना मुखा कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
apamidam nyayanam samudrasya niveshanam |
madhye hradasya no grihah parachina mukha kridhi ||
verses.en: This is the down-course of the waters, the abode (nivéçana) of the ocean; in the midst of a pool are our houses: turn thy faces away.

verses.sa:
हिमस्य त्वा जरायुणा शाले परि व्ययामसि ।
शीतह्रदा हि नो भुवोऽग्निष्कृणोतु भेषजम् ॥
verses.rom:
himasya tva jarayuna shale pari vyayamasi |
shitahrada hi no bhuvo'gnishkrinotu bheshajam ||
verses.en: With a fetal envelop of snow, O house, do we envelop thee; for mayest thou be for us having a cool pond; let Agni make a remedy.

verses.sa:
विश्वजित्त्रायमाणायै मा परि देहि ।
त्रायमाणे द्विपाच्च सर्वं नो रक्ष चतुष्पाद् यच्च नः स्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvajittrayamanayai ma pari dehi |
trayamane dvipachcha sarvam no raksha chatushpad yachcha nah svam ||
verses.en: O all-conqueror (viçvajít), commit me to rescuer; O rescuer, protect both all our bipeds, and whatever quadrupeds are ours.

verses.sa:
त्रायमाणे विश्वजिते मा परि देहि ।
विश्वजिद्द्विपाच्च सर्वं नो रक्ष चतुष्पाड्यच्च नः स्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
trayamane vishvajite ma pari dehi |
vishvajiddvipachcha sarvam no raksha chatushpadyachcha nah svam ||
verses.en: O rescuer, commit me to all-conqueror; O all-conqueror, protect both all etc. etc.

verses.sa:
विश्वजित्कल्याण्यै मा परि देहि ।
कल्याणि द्विपाच्च सर्वं नो रक्ष चतुष्पाद् यच्च नः स्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvajitkalyanyai ma pari dehi |
kalyani dvipachcha sarvam no raksha chatushpad yachcha nah svam ||
verses.en: O all-conqueror, commit me to beauty; O beauty, protect both all etc. etc.

verses.sa:
कल्याणि सर्वविदे मा परि देहि ।
सर्वविद्द्विपाच्च सर्वं नो रक्ष चतुष्पाद् यच्च नः स्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
kalyani sarvavide ma pari dehi |
sarvaviddvipachcha sarvam no raksha chatushpad yachcha nah svam ||
verses.en: O beauty, commit me to all-possessor; O all-possessor, protect both all etc. etc.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो मेधे प्रथमा गोभिरश्वेभिरा गहि ।
त्वं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिस्त्वं नो असि यज्ञिया ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no medhe prathama gobhirashvebhira gahi |
tvam suryasya rashmibhistvam no asi yajniya ||
verses.en: Do thou, O wisdom (medhā́), come first to us, with kine, with horses, thou with the sun's rays; thou art worshipful to us.

verses.sa:
मेधामहं प्रथमां ब्रह्मण्वतीं ब्रह्मजूतामृषिष्टुताम् ।
प्रपीतां ब्रह्मचारिभिर्देवानामवसे हुवे ॥
verses.rom:
medhamaham prathamam brahmanvatim brahmajutamrishishtutam |
prapitam brahmacharibhirdevanamavase huve ||
verses.en: I call first, unto the aid of the gods, wisdom filled with bráhman, quickened by bráhman, praised by seers, drunk of (?) by Vedic students.

verses.sa:
यां मेधामृभवो विदुर्यां मेधामसुरा विदुः ।
ऋषयो भद्रां मेधां यां विदुस्तां मय्या वेशयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yam medhamribhavo viduryam medhamasura viduh |
rishayo bhadram medham yam vidustam mayya veshayamasi ||
verses.en: The wisdom that the Ribhus know, the wisdom that the Asuras know, the excellent wisdom that the seers know—that do we cause to enter into me.

verses.sa:
यामृषयो भूतकृतो मेधां मेधाविनो विदुः ।
तया मामद्य मेधयाग्ने मेधाविनं कृणु ॥
verses.rom:
yamrishayo bhutakrito medham medhavino viduh |
taya mamadya medhayagne medhavinam krinu ||
verses.en: The wisdom that the being-making seers, possessed of wisdom, know—with that wisdom do thou make me today, O Agni, possessed of wisdom.

verses.sa:
मेधां सायं मेधां प्रातर्मेधां मध्यन्दिनं परि ।
मेधां सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्वचसा वेशयामहे ॥
verses.rom:
medham sayam medham pratarmedham madhyandinam pari |
medham suryasya rashmibhirvachasa veshayamahe ||
verses.en: Wisdom at evening, wisdom in the morning, wisdom about noon, wisdom by the sun's rays, by the spell (vácas), do we make enter into us.

verses.sa:
पिप्पली क्षिप्तभेषज्युतातिविद्धभेषजी ।
तां देवाः समकल्पयन्न् इयं जीवितवा अलम् ॥
verses.rom:
pippali kshiptabheshajyutatividdhabheshaji |
tam devah samakalpayann iyam jivitava alam ||
verses.en: The berry (pippalī́), remedy for what is bruised (? kṣiptá), and remedy for what is pierced—that did the gods prepare (sam-kalpay-) that is sufficient for life.

verses.sa:
पिप्पल्यः समवदन्तायतीर्जननादधि ।
यं जीवमश्नवामहै न स रिष्याति पूरुषः ॥
verses.rom:
pippalyah samavadantayatirjananadadhi |
yam jivamashnavamahai na sa rishyati purushah ||
verses.en: The berries talked together, coming from their birth: whomever we shall reach living, that man shall not be harmed.

verses.sa:
असुरास्त्वा न्यखनन् देवास्त्वोदवपन् पुनः ।
वातीकृतस्य भेषजीमथो क्षिप्तस्य भेषजीम् ॥
verses.rom:
asurastva nyakhanan devastvodavapan punah |
vatikritasya bheshajimatho kshiptasya bheshajim ||
verses.en: The Asuras dug thee in; the gods cast thee up again, a remedy for the vātī́kṛta, likewise a remedy for what is bruised.

verses.sa:
प्रत्नो हि कमीड्यो अध्वरेषु सनाच्च होता नव्यश्च सत्सि ।
स्वां चाग्ने तन्वं पिप्रायस्वास्मभ्यं च सौभगमा यजस्व ॥
verses.rom:
pratno hi kamidyo adhvareshu sanachcha hota navyashcha satsi |
svam chagne tanvam piprayasvasmabhyam cha saubhagama yajasva ||
verses.en: Since, an ancient one, to be praised at the sacrifices, thou sittest as hótar both of old and recent—do thou, O Agni, both gratify thine own self, and bestow (ā-yaj) good fortune on us.

verses.sa:
ज्येष्ठघ्न्यां जातो विचृतोर्यमस्य मूलबर्हणात्परि पाह्येनम् ।
अत्येनं नेषद्दुरितानि विश्वा दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय ॥
verses.rom:
jyeshthaghnyam jato vichritoryamasya mulabarhanatpari pahyenam |
atyenam neshadduritani vishva dirghayutvaya shatasharadaya ||
verses.en: Born in jyeṣṭhaghnī́, in Yama's two Unfasteners (vicṛ́t)—do thou protect him from the Uprooter (mūlabárhaṇa); may he conduct him across all difficulties unto long life, of a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
व्याघ्रेऽह्न्यजनिष्ट वीरो नक्षत्रजा जायमानः सुवीरः ।
स मा वधीत्पितरं वर्धमानो मा मातरं प्र मिनीज्जनित्रीम् ॥
verses.rom:
vyaghre'hnyajanishta viro nakshatraja jayamanah suvirah |
sa ma vadhitpitaram vardhamano ma mataram pra minijjanitrim ||
verses.en: On the tiger day hath been born the hero, asterism-born, being born rich in heroes; let him not, increasing, slay his father; let him not harm his mother that gave him birth.

verses.sa:
इमं मे अग्ने पुरुषं मुमुग्ध्ययं यो बद्धः सुयतो लालपीति ।
अतोऽधि ते कृणवद्भागधेयं यदानुन्मदितोऽसति ॥
verses.rom:
imam me agne purusham mumugdhyayam yo baddhah suyato lalapiti |
ato'dhi te krinavadbhagadheyam yadanunmadito'sati ||
verses.en: Free thou this man for me, O Agni, who here bound, well-restrained, cries loudly; thenceforth shall he make for thee a portion, when he shall be uncrazed.

verses.sa:
अग्निष्टे नि शमयतु यदि ते मन उद्युतम् ।
कृणोमि विद्वान् भेषजं यथानुन्मदितोऽससि ॥
verses.rom:
agnishte ni shamayatu yadi te mana udyutam |
krinomi vidvan bheshajam yathanunmadito'sasi ||
verses.en: Let Agni quiet [it] down for thee, if thy mind is excited (ud-yu); I, knowing, make a remedy, that thou mayest be uncrazed.

verses.sa:
देवैनसादुन्मदितमुन्मत्तं रक्षसस्परि ।
कृणोमि विद्वान् भेषजं यदानुन्मदितोऽसति ॥
verses.rom:
devainasadunmaditamunmattam rakshasaspari |
krinomi vidvan bheshajam yadanunmadito'sati ||
verses.en: Crazed from sin against the gods, crazed from a demon—I, knowing, make a remedy, when he shall be uncrazed.

verses.sa:
पुनस्त्वा दुरप्सरसः पुनरिन्द्रः पुनर्भगः ।
पुनस्त्वा दुर्विश्वे देवा यथानुन्मदितोऽससि ॥
verses.rom:
punastva durapsarasah punarindrah punarbhagah |
punastva durvishve deva yathanunmadito'sasi ||
verses.en: May the Apsarases give thee again, may Indra again, may Bhaga again; may all the gods give thee again, that thou mayest be uncrazed.

verses.sa:
मा ज्येष्ठं वधीदयमग्न एषां मूलबर्हणात्परि पाह्येनम् ।
स ग्राह्याः पाशान् वि चृत प्रजानन् तुभ्यं देवा अनु जानन्तु विश्वे ॥
verses.rom:
ma jyeshtham vadhidayamagna esham mulabarhanatpari pahyenam |
sa grahyah pashan vi chrita prajanan tubhyam deva anu janantu vishve ||
verses.en: Let not this one, O Agni, slay the oldest of them; protect him from uprooting; do thou, foreknowing, unfasten the bonds of the seizure (grā́hi); let all the gods assent to thee.

verses.sa:
उन् मुञ्च पाशांस्त्वमग्न एषां त्रयस्त्रिभिरुत्सिता येभिरासन् ।
स ग्राह्याः पाशान् वि चृत प्रजानन् पितापुत्रौ मातरं मुञ्च सर्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
un muncha pashamstvamagna esham trayastribhirutsita yebhirasan |
sa grahyah pashan vi chrita prajanan pitaputrau mataram muncha sarvan ||
verses.en: Do thou, O Agni, loosen up the bonds of them, the three with which they three were tied up; do thou, foreknowing, unfasten the bonds of the seizure; free all—father, son, mother.

verses.sa:
येभिः पाशैः परिवित्तो विबद्धोऽङ्गेअङ्ग आर्पित उत्सितश्च ।
वि ते मुच्यन्तं विमुचो हि सन्ति भ्रूणघ्नि पूषन् दुरितानि मृक्ष्व ॥
verses.rom:
yebhih pashaih parivitto vibaddho'ngeanga arpita utsitashcha |
vi te muchyantam vimucho hi santi bhrunaghni pushan duritani mrikshva ||
verses.en: With what bonds the overslaughed one is bound apart, applied and tied up on each limb—let them be released, for they are releasers; wipe off difficulties, O Pūshan, on the embryo-slayer.

verses.sa:
त्रिते देवा अमृजतैतदेनस्त्रित एनन् मनुष्येषु ममृजे ।
ततो यदि त्वा ग्राहिरानशे तां ते देवा ब्रह्मणा नाशयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
trite deva amrijataitadenastrita enan manushyeshu mamrije |
tato yadi tva grahiranashe tam te deva brahmana nashayantu ||
verses.en: On Trita the gods wiped off that sin; Trita wiped it off on human beings; if from that the seizure hath reached thee, let the gods make it disappear for thee by the incantation bráhman).

verses.sa:
मरीचीर्धूमान् प्र विशानु पाप्मन्न् उदारान् गच्छोत वा नीहारान् ।
नदीनं फेनामनु तान् वि नश्य भ्रूणघ्नि पूषन् दुरितानि मृक्ष्व ॥
verses.rom:
marichirdhuman pra vishanu papmann udaran gachchhota va niharan |
nadinam phenamanu tan vi nashya bhrunaghni pushan duritani mrikshva ||
verses.en: Enter thou after the beams, the smokes, O evil; go unto the mists or also the fogs; disappear along those foams of the rivers: wipe off difficulties, O Pūshan, on the embryo-slayer.

verses.sa:
द्वादशधा निहितं त्रितस्यापमृष्टं मनुष्यैनसानि ।
ततो यदि त्वा ग्राहिरानशे तां ते देवा ब्रह्मणा नाशयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
dvadashadha nihitam tritasyapamrishtam manushyainasani |
tato yadi tva grahiranashe tam te deva brahmana nashayantu ||
verses.en: Twelvefold is deposited what was wiped off by Trita—sins of human beings; if from that the seizure hath reached thee, let the gods make it disappear for thee by the incantation.

verses.sa:
यद्देवा देवहेडनं देवासश्चकृम वयम् ।
आदित्यास्तस्मान् नो युयमृतस्य ऋतेन मुञ्चत ॥
verses.rom:
yaddeva devahedanam devasashchakrima vayam |
adityastasman no yuyamritasya ritena munchata ||
verses.en: O gods! whatever cause of the wrath of the gods we, O gods, have committed—from that do ye, O Ādityas, release us by right of right (ṛtá).

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य ऋतेनादित्या यजत्रा मुञ्चतेह नः ।
यज्ञं यद्यज्ञवाहसः शिक्षन्तो नोपशेकिम ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya ritenaditya yajatra munchateha nah |
yajnam yadyajnavahasah shikshanto nopashekima ||
verses.en: By right of right, O Ādityas, worshipful ones, release ye us here, in that, O ye carriers of the sacrifice, we, desirous of accomplishing (çak) the sacrifice, have not accomplished it.

verses.sa:
मेदस्वता यजमानाः स्रुचाज्यानि जुह्वतः ।
अकामा विश्वे वो देवाः शिक्षन्तो नोप शेकिम ॥
verses.rom:
medasvata yajamanah sruchajyani juhvatah |
akama vishve vo devah shikshanto nopa shekima ||
verses.en: Sacrificing with what is rich in fat, making oblations of sacrificial butter (ā́jya) with the spoon, without desire, to you, O all gods, desirous of accomplishing we have not been able to accomplish.

verses.sa:
यद्विद्वांसो यदविद्वांस एनांसि चकृमा वयम् ।
यूयं नस्तस्मान् मुञ्चत विश्वे देवाः सजोषसः ॥
verses.rom:
yadvidvamso yadavidvamsa enamsi chakrima vayam |
yuyam nastasman munchata vishve devah sajoshasah ||
verses.en: If knowing, if unknowing, we have committed sins, do ye free us from that, O all gods, accordant.

verses.sa:
यदि जाग्रद्यदि स्वपन्न् एन एनस्योऽकरम् ।
भूतं मा तस्माद्भव्यं च द्रुपदादिव मुञ्चताम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadi jagradyadi svapann ena enasyo'karam |
bhutam ma tasmadbhavyam cha drupadadiva munchatam ||
verses.en: If waking, if sleeping, I sinful have committed sin, let what is and what is to be free me from that, as from a post (drupadá).

verses.sa:
द्रुपदादिव मुमुचानः स्विन्नः स्नात्वा मलादिव ।
पूतं पवित्रेणेवाज्यं विश्वे शुम्भन्तु मैनसः ॥
verses.rom:
drupadadiva mumuchanah svinnah snatva maladiva |
putam pavitrenevajyam vishve shumbhantu mainasah ||
verses.en: Being freed as if from a post, as one that has sweated from filth on bathing, like sacrificial butter purified by a purifier—let all cleanse (çumbh) me of sin.

verses.sa:
यद्यामं चक्रुर्निखनन्तो अग्रे कार्षीवणा अन्नविदो न विद्यया ।
वैवस्वते राजनि तज्जुहोम्यथ यज्ञियं मधुमदस्तु नोऽन्नम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadyamam chakrurnikhananto agre karshivana annavido na vidyaya |
vaivasvate rajani tajjuhomyatha yajniyam madhumadastu no'nnam ||
verses.en: What that was Yama's the Kārshīvaṇas made, digging down in the beginning, food-acquiring, not with knowledge, that I make an oblation unto the king, Vivasvant's son; so let our food be sacrificial (yajñíya), rich in sweet.

verses.sa:
वैवस्वतः कृणवद्भागधेयं मधुभागो मधुना सं सृजाति ।
मातुर्यदेन इषितं न आगन् यद्वा पिताऽपराद्धो जिहीदे ॥
verses.rom:
vaivasvatah krinavadbhagadheyam madhubhago madhuna sam srijati |
maturyadena ishitam na agan yadva pita'paraddho jihide ||
verses.en: Vivasvant's son shall make [us] an apportionment; having a portion of sweet, he shall unite [us] with sweet—whatever sin of [our] mother's, sent forth, hath come to us, or what [our] father, wronged,* hath done in wrath.

verses.sa:
यदीदं मातुर्यदि पितुर्नः परि भ्रातुः पुत्राच्चेतस एन आगन् ।
यावन्तो अस्मान् पितरः सचन्ते तेषां सर्वेषां शिवो अस्तु मन्युः ॥
verses.rom:
yadidam maturyadi piturnah pari bhratuh putrachchetasa ena agan |
yavanto asman pitarah sachante tesham sarvesham shivo astu manyuh ||
verses.en: If from [our] mother or if from our father, forth from brother, from son, from thought (cétas), this sin hath come to [us]—as many Fathers as have fastened on (sac) us, of them all be the fury propitious [to us].

verses.sa:
अपमित्यमप्रतीत्तं यदस्मि यमस्य येन बलिना चरामि ।
इदं तदग्ने अनृणो भवामि त्वं पाशान् विचृतं वेत्थ सर्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
apamityamapratittam yadasmi yamasya yena balina charami |
idam tadagne anrino bhavami tvam pashan vichritam vettha sarvan ||
verses.en: What I eat (?) that is borrowed, that is not given back; with what tribute of Yama I go about—now, O Agni, I become guiltless (anṛṇá) as to that; thou knowest how to unfasten all fetters.

verses.sa:
इहैव सन्तः प्रति दद्म एनज्जीवा जीवेभ्यो नि हराम एनत्।
अपमित्य धान्यं यज्जघसाहमिदं तदग्ने अनृणो भवामि ॥
verses.rom:
ihaiva santah prati dadma enajjiva jivebhyo ni harama enat|
apamitya dhanyam yajjaghasahamidam tadagne anrino bhavami ||
verses.en: Being just here we give it back; living, we pay it in (ni-hṛ) for the living; what grain I have devoured having borrowed [it], now, O Agni, I become guiltless as to that.

verses.sa:
अनृणा अस्मिन्न् अनृणाः परस्मिन् तृतीये लोके अनृणाः स्याम ।
ये देवयानाः पितृयाणश्च लोकाः सर्वान् पथो अनृणा आ क्षियेम ॥
verses.rom:
anrina asminn anrinah parasmin tritiye loke anrinah syama |
ye devayanah pitriyanashcha lokah sarvan patho anrina a kshiyema ||
verses.en: Guiltless in this [world], guiltless in the higher, guiltless in the third world may we be; the worlds traversed by the gods and traversed by the Fathers—all the roads may we abide in guiltless.

verses.sa:
यद्धस्ताभ्यां चकृम किल्बिषाण्यक्षाणां गत्नुमुपलिप्समानाः ।
उग्रंपश्ये उग्रजितौ तदद्याप्सरसावनु दत्तामृणं नः ॥
verses.rom:
yaddhastabhyam chakrima kilbishanyakshanam gatnumupalipsamanah |
ugrampashye ugrajitau tadadyapsarasavanu dattamrinam nah ||
verses.en: If (yát) with our hands we have done offenses, desiring to take up the course (?) of the dice, let the two Apsarases, fierce-(ugrá-)seeing, fierce-conquering, forgive today that guilt (ṛṇá) of ours.

verses.sa:
उग्रंपश्ये राष्ट्रभृत्किल्बिषाणि यदक्षवृत्तमनु दत्तं न एतत्।
ऋणान् नो न ऋणमेर्त्समानो यमस्य लोके अधिरज्जुरायत् ॥
verses.rom:
ugrampashye rashtrabhritkilbishani yadakshavrittamanu dattam na etat|
rinan no na rinamertsamano yamasya loke adhirajjurayat ||
verses.en: O fierce-seeing one! realm-bearing one! [our] offenses, what happened at the dice—forgive ye that to us; may there not come in Yama's world one having a rope on, desiring to win from us debt (ṛṇá) from debt.

verses.sa:
यस्मा ऋणं यस्य जायामुपैमि यं याचमानो अभ्यैमि देवाः ।
ते वाचं वादिषुर्मोत्तरां मद्देवपत्नी अप्सरसावधीतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasma rinam yasya jayamupaimi yam yachamano abhyaimi devah |
te vacham vadishurmottaram maddevapatni apsarasavadhitam ||
verses.en: To whom [I owe] debt, whose wife I approach, to whom I go begging (yāc), O gods—let them not speak words superior to me; ye (two) Apsarases, wives of gods, take notice!

verses.sa:
यददीव्यन्न् ऋणमहं कृणोम्यदास्यन्न् अग्ने उत संगृणामि ।
वैश्वानरो नो अधिपा वसिष्ठ उदिन् नयाति सुकृतस्य लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadadivyann rinamaham krinomyadasyann agne uta samgrinami |
vaishvanaro no adhipa vasishtha udin nayati sukritasya lokam ||
verses.en: If (yát), not playing, I make debt, also, O Agni, promise (sam-gṛ) not intending to give, may Vāiçvānara, our best over-ruler, verily lead us up to the world of the well-done.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानराय प्रति वेदयामि यदि ऋणं संगरो देवतासु ।
स एतान् पाशान् विचृतं वेद सर्वान् अथ पक्वेन सह सं भवेम ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanaraya prati vedayami yadi rinam samgaro devatasu |
sa etan pashan vichritam veda sarvan atha pakvena saha sam bhavema ||
verses.en: I make it known to Vāiçvānara, if [there is on my part] promise of debt to the deities; he knows how to unfasten all these bonds; so may we be united with what is cooked (pakvá).

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरः पविता मा पुनातु यत्संगरमभिधावाम्याशाम् ।
अनाजानन् मनसा याचमानो यत्तत्रैनो अप तत्सुवामि ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanarah pavita ma punatu yatsamgaramabhidhavamyasham |
anajanan manasa yachamano yattatraino apa tatsuvami ||
verses.en: Let Vāiçvānara the purifier purify me, if (yát) I run against a promise, an expectation (ācā́), not acknowledging, begging with my mind; what sin is therein, that I impel away.

verses.sa:
यदन्तरिक्षं पृथिवीमुत द्यां यन् मातरं पितरं वा जिहिंसिम ।
अयं तस्माद्गार्हपत्यो नो अग्निरुदिन् नयाति सुकृतस्य लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadantariksham prithivimuta dyam yan mataram pitaram va jihimsima |
ayam tasmadgarhapatyo no agnirudin nayati sukritasya lokam ||
verses.en: If (yát) atmosphere, earth, and sky, if father or mother we have injured (hiṅs), may this householder's-fire lead us up from that to the world of the well-done.

verses.sa:
भूमिर्मातादितिर्नो जनित्रं भ्रातान्तरिक्षमभिशस्त्या नः ।
द्यौर्नः पिता पित्र्याच्छं भवाति जामिमृत्वा माव पत्सि लोकात् ॥
verses.rom:
bhumirmataditirno janitram bhratantarikshamabhishastya nah |
dyaurnah pita pitryachchham bhavati jamimritva mava patsi lokat ||
verses.en: May mother earth, Aditi our birthplace, brother atmosphere, [save] us from imprecation; may our father heaven be weal to us from paternal [guilt]; having gone to my relatives (jāmí), let me not fall down from [their?] world.

verses.sa:
यत्रा सुहार्दः सुकृतो मदन्ति विहाय रोगं तन्वः स्वायाः ।
अश्लोना अङ्गैरह्रुताः स्वर्गे तत्र पश्येम पितरौ च पुत्रान् ॥
verses.rom:
yatra suhardah sukrito madanti vihaya rogam tanvah svayah |
ashlona angairahrutah svarge tatra pashyema pitarau cha putran ||
verses.en: Where the well-hearted, the well-doing revel, having abandoned disease of their own selves, not lame with their limbs, undamaged in heaven (svargá)—there may we see [our] parents and sons.

verses.sa:
विषाणा पाशान् वि ष्याध्यस्मद्य उत्तमा अधमा वारुणा ये ।
दुष्वप्न्यं दुरितं नि ष्वास्मदथ गछेम सुकृतस्य लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishana pashan vi shyadhyasmadya uttama adhama varuna ye |
dushvapnyam duritam ni shvasmadatha gachhema sukritasya lokam ||
verses.en: An untier, do thou untie off us the fetters that are highest, lowest, that are Varuṇa's; remove (nis-sū) from us evil-dreaming [and] difficulty; then may we go to the world of the well-done.

verses.sa:
यद्दारुणि बध्यसे यच्च रज्ज्वां यद्भूम्यां बध्यसे यच्च वाचा ।
अयं तस्माद्गार्हपत्यो नो अग्निरुदिन् नयाति सुकृतस्य लोकम् ॥
verses.rom:
yaddaruni badhyase yachcha rajjvam yadbhumyam badhyase yachcha vacha |
ayam tasmadgarhapatyo no agnirudin nayati sukritasya lokam ||
verses.en: If (yát) thou art bound in wood, and if in a rope; if thou art bound in the earth, and if by a spell (vā́c)—may this householder's-fire lead us up from that to the world of the well-done.

verses.sa:
उदगातां भगवती विचृतौ नाम तारके ।
प्रेहामृतस्य यच्छतां प्रैतु बद्धकमोचनम् ॥
verses.rom:
udagatam bhagavati vichritau nama tarake |
prehamritasya yachchhatam praitu baddhakamochanam ||
verses.en: Arisen are the two blessed stars named the Unfasteners; let them bestow here of immortality (amṛ́ta); let the releaser of the bound advance.

verses.sa:
वि जिहीष्व लोकं कृणु बन्धान् मुञ्चासि बद्धकम् ।
योन्या इव प्रच्युतो गर्भः पथः सर्वामनु क्षिय ॥
verses.rom:
vi jihishva lokam krinu bandhan munchasi baddhakam |
yonya iva prachyuto garbhah pathah sarvamanu kshiya ||
verses.en: Go thou apart; make room; mayest thou free the bound one from the bond; like a young fallen out of the womb, do thou dwell along all roads.

verses.sa:
एतं भागं परि ददामि विद्वान् विश्वकर्मन् प्रथमजा ऋतस्य ।
अस्माभिर्दत्तं जरसः परस्तादछिन्नं तन्तुमनु सं तरेम ॥
verses.rom:
etam bhagam pari dadami vidvan vishvakarman prathamaja ritasya |
asmabhirdattam jarasah parastadachhinnam tantumanu sam tarema ||
verses.en: This portion I, knowing, make over [to thee], O Viçvakarman, first-born of right; by us [is it] given, beyond old age; along an unbroken line may we pass (tṛ) together.

verses.sa:
ततं तन्तुमन्वेके तरन्ति येषां दत्तं पित्र्यमायनेन ।
अबन्ध्वेके ददतः प्रयच्छन्तो दातुं चेच्छिक्षान्त्स स्वर्ग एव ॥
verses.rom:
tatam tantumanveke taranti yesham dattam pitryamayanena |
abandhveke dadatah prayachchhanto datum chechchhikshantsa svarga eva ||
verses.en: Some pass along the extended line, of whom what is the Fathers' [was] given in course (? ā́yanena); some, without relatives, giving, bestowing—if they be able to give, that is very heaven.

verses.sa:
अन्वारभेथामनुसंरभेथामेतं लोकं श्रद्दधानाः सचन्ते ।
यद्वां पक्वं परिविष्टमग्नौ तस्य गुप्तये दम्पती सं श्रयेथाम् ॥
verses.rom:
anvarabhethamanusamrabhethametam lokam shraddadhanah sachante |
yadvam pakvam parivishtamagnau tasya guptaye dampati sam shrayetham ||
verses.en: Take ye (both) hold after, take hold together after; to this world they that have faith attach themselves (sac); what cooked [offering] of yours is served up in the fire, combine ye, O husband and wife, in order to the guarding of it.

verses.sa:
यज्ञं यन्तं मनसा बृहन्तमन्वारोहामि तपसा सयोनिः ।
उपहूता अग्ने जरसः परस्तात्तृतीये नाके सधमादं मदेम ॥
verses.rom:
yajnam yantam manasa brihantamanvarohami tapasa sayonih |
upahuta agne jarasah parastattritiye nake sadhamadam madema ||
verses.en: The great sacrifice, as it goes, with mind, I ascend after, with fervor (? tápas), of like origin; being called upon, O Agni, may we, beyond old age, revel in joint reveling in the third firmament.

verses.sa:
शुद्धाः पूता योषितो यज्ञिया इमा ब्रह्मणां हस्तेषु प्रपृथक्सादयामि ।
यत्काम इदमभिषिञ्चामि वोऽहमिन्द्रो मरुत्वान्त्स ददातु तन् मे ॥
verses.rom:
shuddhah puta yoshito yajniya ima brahmanam hasteshu praprithaksadayami |
yatkama idamabhishinchami vo'hamindro marutvantsa dadatu tan me ||
verses.en: These cleansed, purified, worshipful maidens I seat in separate succession in the hands of the priests (brahmán); with what desire I now pour you on, let Indra here with the Maruts grant me that.

verses.sa:
एतं सधस्थाः परि वो ददामि यं शेवधिमावहाज्जातवेदः ।
अन्वागन्ता यजमानः स्वस्ति तं स्म जानीत परमे व्योमन् ॥
verses.rom:
etam sadhasthah pari vo dadami yam shevadhimavahajjatavedah |
anvaganta yajamanah svasti tam sma janita parame vyoman ||
verses.en: This one, O ye associates (? sadhástha), I deliver to you, whom Jātavedas shall carry [as] a treasure; the sacrificer follows after well-being; him do ye recognize in the highest firmament.

verses.sa:
जानीत स्मैनं परमे व्योमन् देवाः सधस्था विद लोकमत्र ।
अन्वागन्ता यजमानः स्वस्तीष्टापूर्तं स्म कृणुताविरस्मै ॥
verses.rom:
janita smainam parame vyoman devah sadhastha vida lokamatra |
anvaganta yajamanah svastishtapurtam sma krinutavirasmai ||
verses.en: Recognize ye him in the highest firmament; ye divine associates, ye know [his] world there; the sacrificer follows after well-being; make ye what he has offered and bestowed plain for him.

verses.sa:
देवाः पितरः पितरो देवाः ।
यो अस्मि सो अस्मि ॥
verses.rom:
devah pitarah pitaro devah |
yo asmi so asmi ||
verses.en: O gods! O Fathers! O Fathers! O gods! who I am, he am I.

verses.sa:
स पचामि स ददामि ।
स यजे स दत्तान् मा यूषम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa pachami sa dadami |
sa yaje sa dattan ma yusham ||
verses.en: He do I cook, he do I give, he do I offer; [as] he, let me not be parted from what is given.

verses.sa:
नाके राजन् प्रति तिष्ठ तत्रैतत्प्रति तिष्ठतु ।
विद्धि पूर्तस्य नो राजन्त्स देव सुमना भव ॥
verses.rom:
nake rajan prati tishtha tatraitatprati tishthatu |
viddhi purtasya no rajantsa deva sumana bhava ||
verses.en: In the firmament, O king, stand firm; there let this stand firm; know of what we have bestowed, O king; do thou, O god, be well-willing.

verses.sa:
दिवो नु मां बृहतो अन्तरिक्षादपां स्तोको अभ्यपप्तद्रसेन ।
समिन्द्रियेन पयसाहमग्ने छन्दोभिर्यज्ञैः सुकृतां कृतेन ॥
verses.rom:
divo nu mam brihato antarikshadapam stoko abhyapaptadrasena |
samindriyena payasahamagne chhandobhiryajnaih sukritam kritena ||
verses.en: From the sky now, from the great atmosphere, a drop of water hath fallen upon me with essence (rása); with Indra's power, with milk,

verses.sa:
यदि वृक्षादभ्यपप्तत्फलं तद्यद्यन्तरिक्षात्स उ वायुरेव ।
यत्रास्पृक्षत्तन्वो यच्च वासस आपो नुदन्तु निर्ऋतिं पराचैः ॥
verses.rom:
yadi vrikshadabhyapaptatphalam tadyadyantarikshatsa u vayureva |
yatrasprikshattanvo yachcha vasasa apo nudantu nirritim parachaih ||
verses.en: If from a tree it hath fallen upon [me], that is fruit; if from the atmosphere, that is merely Vāyu; on whatever part of my body, and what part of my garment, it hath touched, let the waters thrust perdition away.

verses.sa:
अभ्यञ्जनं सुरभि सा समृद्धिर्हिरण्यं वर्चस्तदु पूत्रिममेव ।
सर्वा पवित्रा वितताध्यस्मत्तन् मा तारीन् निर्ऋतिर्मो अरातिः ॥
verses.rom:
abhyanjanam surabhi sa samriddhirhiranyam varchastadu putrimameva |
sarva pavitra vitatadhyasmattan ma tarin nirritirmo aratih ||
verses.en: A fragrant ointment, a success is that; gold, splendor, just purifying is that. All purifiers [are] stretched out from us; let not perdition pass that, nor the niggard.

verses.sa:
वनस्पते वीड्वङ्गो हि भूया अस्मत्सखा प्रतरणः सुवीरः ।
गोभिः संनद्धो असि वीडयस्वास्थाता ते जयतु जेत्वानि ॥
verses.rom:
vanaspate vidvango hi bhuya asmatsakha prataranah suvirah |
gobhih samnaddho asi vidayasvasthata te jayatu jetvani ||

verses.sa:
दिवस्पृथिव्याः पर्योज उद्भृतं वनस्पतिभ्यः पर्याभृतं सहः ।
अपामोज्मानं परि गोभिरावृतमिन्द्रस्य वज्रं हविषा रथं यज ॥
verses.rom:
divasprithivyah paryoja udbhritam vanaspatibhyah paryabhritam sahah |
apamojmanam pari gobhiravritamindrasya vajram havisha ratham yaja ||

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्यौजो मरुतामनीकं मित्रस्य गर्भो वरुणस्य नाभिः ।
स इमां नो हव्यदातिं जुषाणो देव रथ प्रति हव्या गृभाय ॥
verses.rom:
indrasyaujo marutamanikam mitrasya garbho varunasya nabhih |
sa imam no havyadatim jushano deva ratha prati havya gribhaya ||

prose.en:
2. Forth from heaven, from earth [is its] force brought up; forth from forest-trees [is its] power brought hither; to the force of the waters, brought forth hither by the kine, to Indra's thunderbolt, the chariot, do thou sacrifice with oblation.

3. Indra's force, the Maruts' front (ánīka), Mitra's embryo, Varuṇa's navel—do thou, enjoying this oblation-giving of ours, O divine chariot, accept the oblations.

verses.sa:
उप श्वासय पृथिवीमुत द्यं पुरुत्रा ते वन्वतां विष्ठितं जगत्।
स दुन्दुभे सजूरिन्द्रेण देवैर्दूराद्दवीयो अप सेध शत्रून् ॥
verses.rom:
upa shvasaya prithivimuta dyam purutra te vanvatam vishthitam jagat|
sa dundubhe sajurindrena devairduraddaviyo apa sedha shatrun ||
verses.en: Blast thou unto heaven and earth; in many places let them win for thee the scattered living creatures (jágat); do thou, O drum, allied with Indra [and] the gods, drive away our foes further than far.

verses.sa:
आ क्रन्दय बलमोजो न आ धा अभि ष्टन दुरिता बाधमानः ।
अप सेध दुन्दुभे दुछुनामित इन्द्रस्य मुष्टिरसि वीडयस्व ॥
verses.rom:
a krandaya balamojo na a dha abhi shtana durita badhamanah |
apa sedha dundubhe duchhunamita indrasya mushtirasi vidayasva ||
verses.en: Resound thou at [them]; mayest thou assign strength [and] force to us; thunder against [them], forcing off difficulties; drive, O drum, misfortune away from here; Indra's fist art thou; be stout.

verses.sa:
प्रामूं जयाभीमे जयन्तु केतुमद्दुन्दुभिर्वावदीतु ।
समश्वपर्णाः पतन्तु नो नरोऽस्माकमिन्द्र रथिनो जयन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
pramum jayabhime jayantu ketumaddundubhirvavaditu |
samashvaparnah patantu no naro'smakamindra rathino jayantu ||
verses.en: Conquer thou those yonder; let these here conquer; let the drum speak loud vāvad- [and] clear; let our horse-winged heroes fly together; let our chariot-men, O Indra, conquer.

verses.sa:
विद्रधस्य बलासस्य लोहितस्य वनस्पते ।
विसल्पकस्यौषधे मोच्छिषः पिशितं चन ॥
verses.rom:
vidradhasya balasasya lohitasya vanaspate |
visalpakasyaushadhe mochchhishah pishitam chana ||
verses.en: Of the vidradhá, of the red balā́sa, O forest-tree, of the visálpaka, O herb, do thou not leave even a bit (? piçitá).

verses.sa:
यौ ते बलास तिष्ठतः कक्षे मुष्कावपश्रितौ ।
वेदाहं तस्य भेषजं चीपुद्रुरभिचक्षणम् ॥
verses.rom:
yau te balasa tishthatah kakshe mushkavapashritau |
vedaham tasya bheshajam chipudrurabhichakshanam ||
verses.en: The two testicles that are thine, O balā́sa, laid away in thine armpit (? kákṣa)—I know the remedy for that, the cīpúdru, a looking-upon.

verses.sa:
यो अङ्ग्यो यः कर्ण्यो यो अक्ष्योर्विसल्पकः ।
वि वृहामो विसल्पकं विद्रधं हृदयामयम् ।
परा तमज्ञातं यक्ष्ममधराञ्चं सुवामसि ॥
verses.rom:
yo angyo yah karnyo yo akshyorvisalpakah |
vi vrihamo visalpakam vidradham hridayamayam |
para tamajnatam yakshmamadharancham suvamasi ||
verses.en: The visálpaka that is of the limbs, that is of the ears, that is in the eyes—we eject the visálpaka, the vidradhá, the heart-disease; we impel away downward that unknown yákṣma.

verses.sa:
शकधूमं नक्षत्राणि यद्राजानमकुर्वत ।
भद्राहमस्मै प्रायच्छन् इदं राष्ट्रमसादिति ॥
verses.rom:
shakadhumam nakshatrani yadrajanamakurvata |
bhadrahamasmai prayachchhan idam rashtramasaditi ||
verses.en: When the asterisms made the çakadhū́ma their king, they bestowed on him auspicious (bhadrá-) day, saying "This shall be [his] royalty."

verses.sa:
भद्राहं नो मध्यंदिने भद्राहं सायमस्तु नः ।
भद्राहं नो अह्नां प्राता रात्री भद्राहमस्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
bhadraham no madhyamdine bhadraham sayamastu nah |
bhadraham no ahnam prata ratri bhadrahamastu nah ||
verses.en: Auspicious day ours at noon, auspicious day be ours at evening, auspicious day ours in the morning of the days; be night auspicious day for us.

verses.sa:
अहोरात्राभ्यां नक्षत्रेभ्यः सूर्याचन्द्रमसाभ्याम् ।
भद्राहमस्मभ्यं राजन् छकधूम त्वं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
ahoratrabhyam nakshatrebhyah suryachandramasabhyam |
bhadrahamasmabhyam rajan chhakadhuma tvam kridhi ||
verses.en: From day-and-night, from the asterisms, from sun-and-moon, do thou, O king çakadhū́ma, make auspicious day for us.

verses.sa:
यो नो भद्राहमकरः सायं नक्तमथो दिवा ।
तस्मै ते नक्षत्रराज शकधूम सदा नमः ॥
verses.rom:
yo no bhadrahamakarah sayam naktamatho diva |
tasmai te nakshatraraja shakadhuma sada namah ||
verses.en: Thou who hast made auspicious day for us at evening, by night, also by day—to thee as such, O çakadhū́ma, king of the asterisms, [be] always homage.

verses.sa:
भगेन मा शांशपेन साकमिन्द्रेण मेदिना ।
कृणोमि भगिनं माप द्रान्त्वरातयः ॥
verses.rom:
bhagena ma shamshapena sakamindrena medina |
krinomi bhaginam mapa drantvaratayah ||
verses.en: Me with a portion (bhága) of çiṅçápā, together with Indra [as] ally, I make myself portioned; let the niggards run away.

verses.sa:
येन वृक्षामभ्यभवो भगेन वर्चसा सह ।
तेन मा भगिनं कृण्वप द्रान्त्वरातयः ॥
verses.rom:
yena vrikshamabhyabhavo bhagena varchasa saha |
tena ma bhaginam krinvapa drantvaratayah ||
verses.en: With what portion thou didst overcome the trees, together with splendor, therewith make me portioned; let the niggards run away.

verses.sa:
यो अन्धो यः पुनःसरो भगो वृक्षेष्वाहितः ।
तेन मा भगिनं कृण्वप द्रान्त्वरातयः ॥
verses.rom:
yo andho yah punahsaro bhago vriksheshvahitah |
tena ma bhaginam krinvapa drantvaratayah ||
verses.en: The portion that is blind, that is reverted (pinaḥsará), set in the trees—therewith make me portioned; let the niggards run away.

verses.sa:
रथजितां राथजितेयीनामप्सरसामयं स्मरः ।
देवाः प्र हिणुत स्मरमसौ मामनु शोचतु ॥
verses.rom:
rathajitam rathajiteyinamapsarasamayam smarah |
devah pra hinuta smaramasau mamanu shochatu ||
verses.en: Of the Apsarases, chariot-conquering, belonging to the chariot-conquering, [is] this the love (smará): ye gods, send forth love; let yon [man] burn for (anu-çuc) me.

verses.sa:
असौ मे स्मरतादिति प्रियो मे स्मरतादिति ।
देवाः प्र हिणुत स्मरमसौ मामनु शोचतु ॥
verses.rom:
asau me smarataditi priyo me smarataditi |
devah pra hinuta smaramasau mamanu shochatu ||
verses.en: Let yon [man] love (smṛ) me; being dear, let him love me: ye gods, send etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यथा मम स्मरादसौ नामुष्याहं कदा चन ।
देवाः प्र हिणुत स्मरमसौ मामनु शोचतु ॥
verses.rom:
yatha mama smaradasau namushyaham kada chana |
devah pra hinuta smaramasau mamanu shochatu ||
verses.en: That yon [man] may love me, not I him at any time, ye gods, send etc. etc.

verses.sa:
उन् मादयत मरुत उदन्तरिक्ष मादय ।
अग्न उन् मादया त्वमसौ मामनु शोचतु ॥
verses.rom:
un madayata maruta udantariksha madaya |
agna un madaya tvamasau mamanu shochatu ||
verses.en: Craze (un-māday-) [him], O Maruts; O atmosphere, craze [him]; O Agni, do thou craze [him]; let yon [man] burn for me.

verses.sa:
नि शीर्षतो नि पत्तत आध्यो नि तिरामि ते ।
देवाः प्र हिणुत स्मरमसौ मामनु शोचतु ॥
verses.rom:
ni shirshato ni pattata adhyo ni tirami te |
devah pra hinuta smaramasau mamanu shochatu ||
verses.en: Down from the head, down from the feet, thy longings (ādhī́) I draw down. Ye gods, send forth love; let yon [man] burn for me.

verses.sa:
अनुमतेऽन्विदं मन्यस्वाकूते समिदं नमः ।
देवाः प्र हिणुत स्मरमसौ मामनु शोचतु ॥
verses.rom:
anumate'nvidam manyasvakute samidam namah |
devah pra hinuta smaramasau mamanu shochatu ||
verses.en: O Anumati, assent to (anu-man) this; O design (ā́kūti), mayest thou constrain (sam-nam) this. Ye gods, send etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यद्धावसि त्रियोजनं पञ्चयोजनमाश्विनम् ।
ततस्त्वं पुनरायसि पुत्राणां नो असः पिता ॥
verses.rom:
yaddhavasi triyojanam panchayojanamashvinam |
tatastvam punarayasi putranam no asah pita ||
verses.en: If (yát) thou runnest three leagues, five leagues, a horseman's day's journey, thence shalt thou come back; thou shalt be father of our sons.

verses.sa:
यं देवाः स्मरमसिञ्चन्न् अप्स्वन्तः शोशुचानं सहाध्या ।
तं ते तपामि वरुणस्य धर्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
yam devah smaramasinchann apsvantah shoshuchanam sahadhya |
tam te tapami varunasya dharmana ||
verses.en: The love that the gods poured within the waters, greatly burning, together with longing—that I heat for thee by Varuṇa's ordinance (dhárman).

verses.sa:
यं विश्वे देवाः स्मरमसिञ्चन्न् अप्स्वन्तः शोशुचानं सहाध्या ।
तं ते तपामि वरुणस्य धर्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
yam vishve devah smaramasinchann apsvantah shoshuchanam sahadhya |
tam te tapami varunasya dharmana ||
verses.en: The love that all the gods poured etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यमिन्द्राणी स्मरमसिञ्चदप्स्वन्तः शोशुचानं सहाध्या ।
तं ते तपामि वरुणस्य धर्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
yamindrani smaramasinchadapsvantah shoshuchanam sahadhya |
tam te tapami varunasya dharmana ||
verses.en: The love that Indrāṇī poured etc. etc.

verses.sa:
यमिन्द्राग्नी स्मरमसिञ्चतामप्स्वन्तः शोशुचानं सहाध्या ।
तं ते तपामि वरुणस्य धर्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
yamindragni smaramasinchatamapsvantah shoshuchanam sahadhya |
tam te tapami varunasya dharmana ||
verses.en: The love that Indra-and-Agni poured etc. etc.,

verses.sa:
यं मित्रावरुणौ स्मरमसिञ्चतामप्स्वन्तः शोशुचानं सहाध्या ।
तं ते तपामि वरुणस्य धर्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
yam mitravarunau smaramasinchatamapsvantah shoshuchanam sahadhya |
tam te tapami varunasya dharmana ||
verses.en: The love that Mitra-and-Varuṇa poured etc. etc.

verses.sa:
य इमां देवो मेखलामाबबन्ध यः संननाह य उ नो युयोज ।
यस्य देवस्य प्रशिषा चरामः स पारमिच्छात्स उ नो वि मुञ्चात् ॥
verses.rom:
ya imam devo mekhalamababandha yah samnanaha ya u no yuyoja |
yasya devasya prashisha charamah sa paramichchhatsa u no vi munchat ||
verses.en: The god that bound on this girdle, that fastened [it] together (sam-nah), and that joined (yuj) [it] for us, the god by whose instruction we move—may he seek the further shore, and may he release us.

verses.sa:
आहुतास्यभिहुत ऋषीणामस्यायुधम् ।
पूर्वा व्रतस्य प्राश्नती वीरघ्नी भव मेखले ॥
verses.rom:
ahutasyabhihuta rishinamasyayudham |
purva vratasya prashnati viraghni bhava mekhale ||
verses.en: Offered to art thou, offered unto; thou art the weapon of the seers (ṛṣi); partaking (pra-aç) first of the vow (vratá), be thou a hero-slayer, O girdle.

verses.sa:
मृत्योरहं ब्रह्मचारी यदस्मि निर्याचन् भूतात्पुरुषं यमाय ।
तमहं ब्रह्मणा तपसा श्रमेणानयैनं मेखलया सिनामि ॥
verses.rom:
mrityoraham brahmachari yadasmi niryachan bhutatpurusham yamaya |
tamaham brahmana tapasa shramenanayainam mekhalaya sinami ||
verses.en: Since I am death's student (brahmacārín), soliciting from existence (? bhūtá) a man (púruṣa) for Yama, him do I, by incantation (bráhman), by fervor, by toil, tie with this girdle.

verses.sa:
श्रद्धाया दुहिता तपसोऽधि जाता स्वसा ऋषीणां भूतकृतां बभूव ।
सा नो मेखले मतिमा धेहि मेधामथो नो धेहि तप इन्द्रियं च ॥
verses.rom:
shraddhaya duhita tapaso'dhi jata svasa rishinam bhutakritam babhuva |
sa no mekhale matima dhehi medhamatho no dhehi tapa indriyam cha ||
verses.en: Daughter of faith, born out of fervor, sister of the being-making seers was she; do thou, O girdle, assign to us thought (matí), wisdom; also assign to us fervor and Indra's power.

verses.sa:
यां त्वा पूर्वे भूतकृत ऋषयः परिबेधिरे ।
सा त्वं परि ष्वजस्व मां दीर्घायुत्वाय मेखले ॥
verses.rom:
yam tva purve bhutakrita rishayah paribedhire |
sa tvam pari shvajasva mam dirghayutvaya mekhale ||
verses.en: Thou whom the ancient being-making seers bound about, do thou embrace me, in order to length of life, O girdle.

verses.sa:
अयं वज्रस्तर्पयतामृतस्यावास्य राष्ट्रमप हन्तु जीवितम् ।
शृणातु ग्रीवाः प्र शृणातूष्णिहा वृत्रस्येव शचीपतिः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vajrastarpayatamritasyavasya rashtramapa hantu jivitam |
shrinatu grivah pra shrinatushniha vritrasyeva shachipatih ||
verses.en: Let this thunderbolt gratify itself with right (? ṛtásya), let it smite down his kingdom, away his life; let it crush [his] neck, crush up his nape, as Cachīpati of Vritra.

verses.sa:
अधरोऽधर उत्तरेभ्यो गूढः पृथिव्या मोत्सृपत्।
वज्रेणावहतः शयाम् ॥
verses.rom:
adharo'dhara uttarebhyo gudhah prithivya motsripat|
vajrenavahatah shayam ||
verses.en: Beneath, beneath them that are above, hidden, may he not creep out of the earth; let him lie smitten down by the thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
यो जिनाति तमन्विच्छ यो जिनाति तमिज्जहि ।
जिनतो वज्र त्वं सीमन्तमन्वञ्चमनु पातय ॥
verses.rom:
yo jinati tamanvichchha yo jinati tamijjahi |
jinato vajra tvam simantamanvanchamanu pataya ||
verses.en: Whoever scathes, him seek thou after; whoever scathes, him smite; the crown of the scather, O thunderbolt, do thou cause to fall following after.

verses.sa:
यदश्नामि बलं कुर्व इत्थं वज्रमा ददे ।
स्कन्धान् अमुष्य शातयन् वृत्रस्येव शचीपतिः ॥
verses.rom:
yadashnami balam kurva ittham vajrama dade |
skandhan amushya shatayan vritrasyeva shachipatih ||
verses.en: When (yát) I eat, I make strength; thus do I take the thunderbolt, cutting to pieces (çat) the shoulders of him yonder, as Cachīpati of Vritra.

verses.sa:
यत्पिबामि सं पिबामि समुद्र इव संपिबः ।
प्राणान् अमुष्य संपाय सं पिबामो अमुं वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatpibami sam pibami samudra iva sampibah |
pranan amushya sampaya sam pibamo amum vayam ||
verses.en: When I drink, I drink up, an up-drinker like the ocean; drinking up the breath of him yonder, we drink him up.

verses.sa:
