यद्गिरामि सं गिरामि समुद्र इव संगिरः ।
प्राणान् अमुष्य संगीर्य सं गिरामो अमुं वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadgirami sam girami samudra iva samgirah |
pranan amushya samgirya sam giramo amum vayam ||
verses.en: When I swallow, I swallow up, a swallower-up like the ocean; swallowing up the breath of him yonder, we swallow him up.

verses.sa:
देवी देव्यामधि जाता पृथिव्यामस्योषधे ।
तां त्वा नितत्नि केशेभ्यो दृंहणाय खनामसि ॥
verses.rom:
devi devyamadhi jata prithivyamasyoshadhe |
tam tva nitatni keshebhyo drimhanaya khanamasi ||
verses.en: Thou art born divine on the divine one, [namely] the earth, O herb; thee here, O down-stretcher, we dig in order to fix the hair.

verses.sa: दृंह प्रत्नान् जनयाजातान् जातान् उ वर्षीयसस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom: drimha pratnan janayajatan jatan u varshiyasaskridhi ||
verses.en: Fix thou the old ones, generate those unborn, and make longer those born.

verses.sa:
यस्ते केशोऽवपद्यते समूलो यश्च वृश्चते ।
इदं तं विश्वभेषज्याभि षिञ्चामि वीरुधा ॥
verses.rom:
yaste kesho'vapadyate samulo yashcha vrishchate |
idam tam vishvabheshajyabhi shinchami virudha ||
verses.en: What hair of thine falls down, and what one is hewn off with its root, upon it I now pour with the all-healing plant.

verses.sa:
यां जमदग्निरखनद्दुहित्रे केशवर्धनीम् ।
तां वीतहव्य आभरदसितस्य गृहेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yam jamadagnirakhanadduhitre keshavardhanim |
tam vitahavya abharadasitasya grihebhyah ||
verses.en: [The herb] which Jamadagni dug for his daughter, [as] hair-increaser, that one Vītahavya brought from Asita's houses.

verses.sa:
अभीशुना मेया आसन् व्यामेनानुमेयाः ।
केशा नडा इव वर्धन्तां शीर्ष्णस्ते असिताः परि ॥
verses.rom:
abhishuna meya asan vyamenanumeyah |
kesha nada iva vardhantam shirshnaste asitah pari ||
verses.en: To be measured with a rein were they, to be after-measured with a fathom: let the black hairs grow out of thy head like reeds.

verses.sa:
दृंह मूलमाग्रं यच्छ वि मध्यं यामयौषधे ।
केशा नडा इव वर्धन्तां शीर्ष्णस्ते असिताः परि ॥
verses.rom:
drimha mulamagram yachchha vi madhyam yamayaushadhe |
kesha nada iva vardhantam shirshnaste asitah pari ||
verses.en: Fix thou the root, stretch the. end, make the middle stretch out, O herb; let the black hairs grow out of thy head like reeds.

verses.sa:
त्वं वीरुधां श्रेष्ठतमाभिश्रुतास्योषधे ।
इमं मे अद्य पुरुषं क्लीबमोपशिनं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam virudham shreshthatamabhishrutasyoshadhe |
imam me adya purusham klibamopashinam kridhi ||
verses.en: Thou art listened to, O herb, as the most best of plants; make thou now this man for me impotent (klībá), opaçá-wearing.

verses.sa:
क्लीबं कृध्योपशिनमथो कुरीरिणं कृधि ।
अथास्येन्द्रो ग्रावभ्यामुभे भिनत्त्वाण्ड्यौ ॥
verses.rom:
klibam kridhyopashinamatho kuririnam kridhi |
athasyendro gravabhyamubhe bhinattvandyau ||
verses.en: Do thou make him impotent, opaçá-wearing, likewise make him kurī́ra-wearing; then let Indra with the (two) pressing-stones split both his testicles.

verses.sa:
क्लीब क्लीबं त्वाकरं वध्रे वध्रिं त्वाकरमरसारसं त्वाकरम् ।
कुरीरमस्य शीर्षणि कुम्बं चाधिनिदध्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
kliba klibam tvakaram vadhre vadhrim tvakaramarasarasam tvakaram |
kuriramasya shirshani kumbam chadhinidadhmasi ||
verses.en: Impotent one, I have made thee impotent; eunuch (vádhri), I have made thee eunuch; sapless one, I have made thee sapless; the kurī́ra and the kúmba we set down upon his head.

verses.sa:
ये ते नाड्यौ देवकृते ययोस्तिष्ठति वृष्ण्यम् ।
ते ते भिनद्मि शम्ययामुष्या अधि मुष्कयोः ॥
verses.rom:
ye te nadyau devakrite yayostishthati vrishnyam |
te te bhinadmi shamyayamushya adhi mushkayoh ||
verses.en: The two god-made tubes that [are] thine, in which stands thy virility, those I split for thee with a peg, on yon woman's loins (muṣká).

verses.sa:
यथा नडं कशिपुने स्त्रियो भिन्दन्त्यश्मना ।
एवा भिनद्मि ते शेपोऽमुष्या अधि मुष्कयोः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha nadam kashipune striyo bhindantyashmana |
eva bhinadmi te shepo'mushya adhi mushkayoh ||
verses.en: As women split reeds with a stone for a cushion, so do I split thy member, on yon woman's loins.

verses.sa:
न्यस्तिका रुरोहिथ सुभगंकरणी मम ।
शतं तव प्रतानास्त्रयस्त्रिंशन् नितानाः ॥
तया सहस्रपर्ण्या हृदयं शोषयामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
nyastika rurohitha subhagamkarani mama |
shatam tava pratanastrayastrimshan nitanah ||
taya sahasraparnya hridayam shoshayami te ||
verses.en: Nyastikā́ hast thou grown up, my good-fortune maker; a hundred [are] thy forth-stretchers, three and thirty thy down-stretchers. With this thousand-leafed [herb] I make dry thy heart.

verses.sa:
शुष्यतु मयि ते हृदयमथो शुष्यत्वास्यम् ।
अथो नि शुष्य मां कामेनाथो शुष्कास्या चर ॥
verses.rom:
shushyatu mayi te hridayamatho shushyatvasyam |
atho ni shushya mam kamenatho shushkasya chara ||
verses.en: Let thy heart dry up on me, then let [thy] mouth dry up; then dry thou up by loving me; then go thou about dry-mouthed.

verses.sa:
संवननी समुष्पला बभ्रु कल्याणि सं नुद ।
अमूं च मां च सं नुद समानं हृदयं कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
samvanani samushpala babhru kalyani sam nuda |
amum cha mam cha sam nuda samanam hridayam kridhi ||
verses.en: A conciliator, a love-awakener (?), do thou, O brown, beauteous one, push together; push together both yon woman and me; make [our] heart the same.

verses.sa:
यथोदकमपपुषोऽपशुष्यत्यास्यम् ।
एवा नि शुष्य मां कामेनाथो शुष्कास्या चर ॥
verses.rom:
yathodakamapapusho'pashushyatyasyam |
eva ni shushya mam kamenatho shushkasya chara ||
verses.en: As the mouth of one who has not drunk water dries away, so dry thou up by loving me, then go thou about dry-mouthed.

verses.sa:
यथा नकुलो विछिद्य संदधात्यहिं पुनः ।
एवा कामस्य विछिन्नं सं धेहि वीर्यावति ॥
verses.rom:
yatha nakulo vichhidya samdadhatyahim punah |
eva kamasya vichhinnam sam dhehi viryavati ||
verses.en: As a mongoos, having cut apart, puts together again a snake, so, O powerful [herb], put together the divided of love.

verses.sa:
यौ व्याघ्राववरूढौ जिघत्सतः पितरं मातरं च ।
तौ दन्तं ब्रह्मणस्पते शिवौ कृणु जातवेदः ॥
verses.rom:
yau vyaghravavarudhau jighatsatah pitaram mataram cha |
tau dantam brahmanaspate shivau krinu jatavedah ||
verses.en: The (two) tigers that, having grown down, desire to devour father and mother—those (two) teeth, O Brahmaṇaspati, make thou propitious, O Jātavedas.

verses.sa:
व्रीहिमत्तं यवमत्तमथो माषमथो तिलम् ।
एष वां भागो निहितो रत्नधेयाय दन्तौ मा हिंसिष्टं पितरं मातरं च ॥
verses.rom:
vrihimattam yavamattamatho mashamatho tilam |
esha vam bhago nihito ratnadheyaya dantau ma himsishtam pitaram mataram cha ||
verses.en: Eat ye (two) rice; eat ye barley; then beans, then sesame; this is your deposited (níhita) portion for treasuring, ye (two) teeth; do not injure father and mother.

verses.sa:
उपहूतौ सयुजौ स्योनौ दन्तौ सुमङ्गलौ ।
अन्यत्र वां घोरं तन्वः परैतु दन्तौ मा हिंसिष्टं पितरं मातरं च ॥
verses.rom:
upahutau sayujau syonau dantau sumangalau |
anyatra vam ghoram tanvah paraitu dantau ma himsishtam pitaram mataram cha ||
verses.en: Invoked [are] the two conjoint, pleasant, very propitious teeth; let what is terrible of your selves (tanū́) go away elsewhere, ye teeth; do not injure father and mother.

verses.sa:
वायुरेनाः समाकरत्त्वष्टा पोषाय ध्रियताम् ।
इन्द्र आभ्यो अधि ब्रवद्रुद्रो भूम्ने चिकित्सतु ॥
verses.rom:
vayurenah samakarattvashta poshaya dhriyatam |
indra abhyo adhi bravadrudro bhumne chikitsatu ||
verses.en: May Vāyu collect them; let Tvashṭar stay fast in order to [their] prosperity; may Indra bless them; let Rudra take care for [their] numbers.

verses.sa:
लोहितेन स्वधितिना मिथुनं कर्णयोः कृधि ।
अकर्तामश्विना लक्ष्म तदस्तु प्रजया बहु ॥
verses.rom:
lohitena svadhitina mithunam karnayoh kridhi |
akartamashvina lakshma tadastu prajaya bahu ||
verses.en: With the red knife (svádhiti), make thou a pair (mithuná) on [their] two ears; the Açvins have made the mark; be that numerous by progeny.

verses.sa:
यथा चक्रुर्देवासुरा यथा मनुष्या उत ।
एवा सहस्रपोषाय कृणुतं लक्ष्माश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
yatha chakrurdevasura yatha manushya uta |
eva sahasraposhaya krinutam lakshmashvina ||
verses.en: As the gods and Asuras made [it], as human beings also, so, O Açvins, make ye the mark, in order to thousand-fold prosperity.

verses.sa:
उच्छ्रयस्व बहुर्भव स्वेन महसा यव ।
मृणीहि विश्वा पात्राणि मा त्वा दिव्याशनिर्वधीत् ॥
verses.rom:
uchchhrayasva bahurbhava svena mahasa yava |
mrinihi vishva patrani ma tva divyashanirvadhit ||
verses.en: Rise up (ut-çri), become abundant (bahú) with thine own greatness, O barley; ruin (mṛ) all receptacles; let not the bolt from heaven smite thee.

verses.sa:
आशृण्वन्तं यवं देवं यत्र त्वाच्छावदामसि ।
तदुच्छ्रयस्व द्यौरिव समुद्र इवैध्यक्षितः ॥
verses.rom:
ashrinvantam yavam devam yatra tvachchhavadamasi |
taduchchhrayasva dyauriva samudra ivaidhyakshitah ||
verses.en: Where we appeal unto thee, the divine barley that listens, there (tát) rise up, like the sky; be unexhausted, like the ocean.

verses.sa:
अक्षितास्त उपसदोऽक्षिताः सन्तु राशयः ।
पृणन्तो अक्षिताः सन्त्वत्तारः सन्त्वक्षिताः ॥
verses.rom:
akshitasta upasado'kshitah santu rashayah |
prinanto akshitah santvattarah santvakshitah ||
verses.en: Unexhausted be thine attendants (? upasád), unexhausted thy heaps; thy bestowers be unexhausted; thy eaters be unexhausted.
